verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד זָקֵן בָּא בַּיָּמִים וַיְכַסֻּהוּ בַּבְּגָדִים וְלֹא יִחַם לוֹ׃
verses.english: Now King David was old, advanced in days can sometimes mean “years.”,and they covered him with garments, but he could not get warm.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ עֲבָדָיו יְבַקְשׁוּ לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ נַעֲרָה בְתוּלָה וְעָמְדָה לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וּתְהִי־לוֹ סֹכֶנֶת וְשָׁכְבָה בְחֵיקֶךָ וְחַם לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: So his servants said to him:Let them seek for my lord king a nubile, usually translated “virgin,” means mainly one who has passed puberty, a marriageable young woman. girl,that she may stand [in waiting] before the kingand be a caregiver the masculine version appears in Isa. 22:15, as an old term for “steward of the household.” for him;she will lie in your bosom, and my lord king will be warm.

verses.hebrew: וַיְבַקְשׁוּ נַעֲרָה יָפָה בְּכֹל גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְצְאוּ אֶת־אֲבִישַׁג הַשּׁוּנַמִּית וַיָּבִאוּ אֹתָהּ לַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: So they sought out a beautiful girl throughout all the territory of Israel,and they found Avishag trad. English ‘Abishag.” the Shunammiteand brought her to the king.

verses.hebrew: וְהַנַּעֲרָה יָפָה עַד־מְאֹד וַתְּהִי לַמֶּלֶךְ סֹכֶנֶת וַתְּשָׁרְתֵהוּ וְהַמֶּלֶךְ לֹא יְדָעָהּ׃
verses.english: Now the girl was beautiful, exceedingly so;she became a caregiver for the king, and attended him,but the king did not know her most often indicates awareness or knowledge, but can also, as here, be extended to include intimate, “biblical” knowledge: sexual relations..

verses.hebrew: וַאֲדֹנִיָּה בֶן־חַגִּית מִתְנַשֵּׂא לֵאמֹר אֲנִי אֶמְלֹךְ וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ רֶכֶב וּפָרָשִׁים וַחֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ רָצִים לְפָנָיו׃
verses.english: Meanwhile, Adoniyya trad. English ‘Adonijah.” “YHWH Is My Lord” is an ironically pious name for David’s son who will not get to rule. The name sometimes appears in fuller form, “Adoniyyahu.” son of Haggit was exalting himself, saying:I will be king!And he provided himself with chariotry and steeds,with fifty men running ahead of him.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־עֲצָבוֹ אָבִיו מִיָּמָיו לֵאמֹר מַדּוּעַ כָּכָה עָשִׂיתָ וְגַם־הוּא טוֹב־תֹּאַר מְאֹד וְאֹתוֹ יָלְדָה אַחֲרֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: Now his father had never scolded him in [all] his days, saying:For-what-reason did you do thus?And he was also exceedingly goodly in form;it was he to whom she gave birth after Avshalom trad. English ‘Absalom.”.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ דְבָרָיו עִם יוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה וְעִם אֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן וַיַּעְזְרוּ אַחֲרֵי אֲדֹנִיָּה׃
verses.english: Now his [private] words were with Yoav trad. English “Joab.” He is David’s fanatically loyal general. son of Tzeruya, and with Evyatar the priest;they provided help [to follow] after Adoniyya,

verses.hebrew: וְצָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע וְנָתָן הַנָּבִיא וְשִׁמְעִי וְרֵעִי וְהַגִּבּוֹרִים אֲשֶׁר לְדָוִד לֹא הָיוּ עִם־אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ׃
verses.english: while Tzadok the priest and Benayahu son of Yehoyada, with the meaning, central to the story, of “YHWH Knows.” Trad. English “Jehoiada.” and Natan trad. English “Nathan.” He is David’s influential court prophet (see II Sam. 7,12). the prophet and Shim’i trad. English “Shimei.” He had cursed David in the Avshalom narrative (II Sam. 16), but thus far, David has spared him. and Re’i “his friends.” and the mighty-men whobelonged to Davidwere not with Adoniyyahu.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְבַּח אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ צֹאן וּבָקָר וּמְרִיא עִם אֶבֶן הַזֹּחֶלֶת אֲשֶׁר־אֵצֶל עֵין רֹגֵל וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־כָּל־אֶחָיו בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וּלְכָל־אַנְשֵׁי יְהוּדָה עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: And Adoniyyahu sacrificed sheep and oxen and fatlingsbeside Even Ha-Zohelet/The Serpent Stone that is near En-Rogel The “Washer’s [or Fuller’s] Spring” in the Kidron Valley near Jerusalem, marking the boundary line between the territories of Benjamin and Judah. It figured previously in the spy story of II Sam. 17. ,and he invited all his brothers, the king’s sons,and all the men of Judah, the king’s court-servants,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־נָתָן הַנָּבִיא וּבְנָיָהוּ וְאֶת־הַגִּבּוֹרִים וְאֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה אָחִיו לֹא קָרָא׃
verses.english: but Natan the prophet and Benayahu and the mighty-men and Shelomo his brother he did not invite.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר נָתָן אֶל־בַּת־שֶׁבַע אֵם־שְׁלֹמֹה לֵאמֹר הֲלוֹא שָׁמַעַתְּ כִּי מָלַךְ אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ בֶן־חַגִּית וַאֲדֹנֵינוּ דָוִד לֹא יָדָע׃
verses.english: So Natan said to Bat-Sheva trad. English “Bathsheba.” David’s beloved wife. The Sheva part of her name puns with the Hebrew word for “swear [an oath],” a theme in this chapter (Walsh). mother of Shelomo, saying:Have you not heard that Adoniyyahu son of Haggit has become king,while our lord David does not know?

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לְכִי אִיעָצֵךְ נָא עֵצָה וּמַלְּטִי אֶת־נַפְשֵׁךְ וְאֶת־נֶפֶשׁ בְּנֵךְ שְׁלֹמֹה׃
verses.english: So-now,go, pray let me advise you with some advice:save your life and the life of your son Shelomo!

verses.hebrew: לְכִי וּבֹאִי אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וְאָמַרְתְּ אֵלָיו הֲלֹא־אַתָּה אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לַאֲמָתְךָ לֵאמֹר כִּי־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנֵךְ יִמְלֹךְ אַחֲרַי וְהוּא יֵשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאִי וּמַדּוּעַ מָלַךְ אֲדֹנִיָהוּ׃
verses.english: Come, go to King David and say to him:Did not you yourself, my lord king, swear to your handmaid, a wordplay that is another indication of the narrator’s “mastery of intonation” (Fishbane). , saying:Indeed, Shelomo your son will reign as king after me,he will sit on my throne?So for-what-reason has Adoniyyahu become king?

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה עוֹדָךְ מְדַבֶּרֶת שָׁם עִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַאֲנִי אָבוֹא אַחֲרַיִךְ וּמִלֵּאתִי אֶת־דְּבָרָיִךְ׃
verses.english: Here,[while] you are still speaking there with the king,I myself will come in after youand will confirm your words.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא בַת־שֶׁבֶע אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הַחַדְרָה וְהַמֶּלֶךְ זָקֵן מְאֹד וַאֲבִישַׁג הַשּׁוּנַמִּית מְשָׁרַת אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: So Bat-Sheva came to the king, into the [inner] room—now the king was exceedingly old, and Avishag the Shunammite was attending the king—

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקֹּד בַּת־שֶׁבַע וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ מַה־לָּךְ׃
verses.english: and Bat-Sheva prostrated herself, and bowed low to the king,and the king said: What is your [business]? may be a pun on malokh, “reign as king” (Walsh).

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֲדֹנִי אַתָּה נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ בַּיהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לַאֲמָתֶךָ כִּי־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנֵךְ יִמְלֹךְ אַחֲרָי וְהוּא יֵשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאִי׃
verses.english: She said to him:My lord, you yourself swore by YHWH your God to your handmaid:indeed, Shelomo your son will reign as king after me,he will sit on my throne!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה אֲדֹנִיָּה מָלָךְ וְעַתָּה אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ לֹא יָדָעְתָּ׃
verses.english: But now,here, Adoniyyahu has become king,yet you, my lord king, you do not know!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְבַּח שׁוֹר וּמְרִיא־וְצֹאן לָרֹב וַיִּקְרָא לְכָל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן וּלְיֹאָב שַׂר הַצָּבָא וְלִשְׁלֹמֹה עַבְדְּךָ לֹא קָרָא׃
verses.english: He sacrificed oxen and fatlings and sheep in abundance,and invited all the king’s sons, and Evyatar the priest,and Yoav Commander of the Armed-Forces,but Shelomo your servant he did not invite.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ עֵינֵי כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עָלֶיךָ לְהַגִּיד לָהֶם מִי יֵשֵׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא אֲדֹנִי־הַמֶּלֶךְ אַחֲרָיו׃
verses.english: As for you, my lord king, the eyes of all Israel are upon you,to tell them who will sit on the throne of my lord king after him!

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּשְׁכַב אֲדֹנִי־הַמֶּלֶךְ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וְהָיִיתִי אֲנִי וּבְנִי שְׁלֹמֹה חַטָּאִים׃
verses.english: Else it will be,when my lord king lies beside his fathers,that I and my son Shelomo will be guilty ones!

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה עוֹדֶנָּה מְדַבֶּרֶת עִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְנָתָן הַנָּבִיא בָּא׃
verses.english: Now here, while she was still speaking with the king,Natan the prophet came,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגִּידוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה נָתָן הַנָּבִיא וַיָּבֹא לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־אַפָּיו אָרְצָה׃
verses.english: and they told the king, saying:Here is Natan the prophet!He came before the king and bowed low to the king, on his nostrils to the earth,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר נָתָן אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אַתָּה אָמַרְתָּ אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ יִמְלֹךְ אַחֲרָי וְהוּא יֵשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאִי׃
verses.english: and Natan said: My lord king,you must have said: Adoniyyahu will reign as king after me,he will sit on my throne!—

verses.hebrew: כִּי יָרַד הַיּוֹם וַיִּזְבַּח שׁוֹר וּמְרִיא־וְצֹאן לָרֹב וַיִּקְרָא לְכָל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וּלְשָׂרֵי הַצָּבָא וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנָּם אֹכְלִים וְשֹׁתִים לְפָנָיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ׃
verses.english: for he went down todayand sacrificed oxen and fatlings and sheep in abundance,and invited all the king’s sons and army commanders and Evyatar the priest—now here, they are eating and drinking before him,and they said: May King Adoniyyahu live!

verses.hebrew: וְלִי אֲנִי־עַבְדֶּךָ וּלְצָדֹק הַכֹּהֵן וְלִבְנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע וְלִשְׁלֹמֹה עַבְדְּךָ לֹא קָרָא׃
verses.english: But as for me, myself your servantand Tzadok the priest and Benayahu son of Yehoyada and Shelomo your servant he did not invite.

verses.hebrew: אִם מֵאֵת אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ נִהְיָה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְלֹא הוֹדַעְתָּ אֶת־עבדיך [עַבְדְּךָ] מִי יֵשֵׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא אֲדֹנִי־הַמֶּלֶךְ אַחֲרָיו׃
verses.english: Is it from my lord king that this matter has come,while you have not made known to your servantwho will sit on my lord’s throne after him?

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר קִרְאוּ־לִי לְבַת־שָׁבַע וַתָּבֹא לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתַּעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: King David answered and said:Call Bat-Sheva to me!She came before the king and stood before the king,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׁבַע הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמַר חַי־יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר־פָּדָה אֶת־נַפְשִׁי מִכָּל־צָרָה׃
verses.english: and the king swore and said:By the life of YHWH, who has redeemed my life from every trouble:

verses.hebrew: כִּי כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לָךְ בַּיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר כִּי־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנֵךְ יִמְלֹךְ אַחֲרַי וְהוּא יֵשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאִי תַּחְתָּי כִּי כֵּן אֶעֱשֶׂה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: indeed, as I swore to you by YHWH, the God of Israel, saying:indeed, Shelomo your son will be king after me,he will sit on my throne in my place The two parallel words provide a poetic rhythm, hinting at the importance of the thought (Walsh).—indeed, thus will I do this very day!

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקֹּד בַּת־שֶׁבַע אַפַּיִם אֶרֶץ וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ וַתֹּאמֶר יְחִי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד לְעֹלָם׃
verses.english: And Bat-Sheva prostrated herself, nostrils to the earth, and bowed low to the king,and said:May my lord King David live, forever!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד קִרְאוּ־לִי לְצָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וּלְנָתָן הַנָּבִיא וְלִבְנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וַיָּבֹאוּ לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: King David said:Call to me Tzadok the priest and Natan the prophet and Benayahu son of Yehoyada!They came before the king.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לָהֶם קְחוּ עִמָּכֶם אֶת־עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנֵיכֶם וְהִרְכַּבְתֶּם אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנִי עַל־הַפִּרְדָּה אֲשֶׁר־לִי וְהוֹרַדְתֶּם אֹתוֹ אֶל־גִּחוֹן׃
verses.english: And the king said to them:Take your lord’s servants with youand have Shelomo my son mount the mule that belongs to me,and bring him down to the Gihon, “The Gusher,” the important spring just outside of Jerusalem, not far from En-Rogel. Friedman (1999) notes that a similarly named river is found in the Garden of Eden story (Gen. 2:13), and thus posits that an “original core” of the first half of the Bible was bracketed by occurrences of this name.;

verses.hebrew: וּמָשַׁח אֹתוֹ שָׁם צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וְנָתָן הַנָּבִיא לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּתְקַעְתֶּם בַּשּׁוֹפָר וַאֲמַרְתֶּם יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה׃
verses.english: Tzadok the priest is to anoint him there, along with Natan the prophet,as king over Israel.Then you are to sound-a-blast on the shofar The ram’s horn, sounded to summon people for military, official, or religious occasions. May and are to say: May King Shelomo live!

verses.hebrew: וַעֲלִיתֶם אַחֲרָיו וּבָא וְיָשַׁב עַל־כִּסְאִי וְהוּא יִמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּי וְאֹתוֹ צִוִּיתִי לִהְיוֹת נָגִיד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל־יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: You are to go up after him,and he is to come in and sit on my throne;he will be king in my place,him I have charged to be Nagid Pronounced nah-GEED, this is a term possibly indicating dynastic choice, but not identical with “king.” Others, “prince, designate.” over Israel and over Judah!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן בְּנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר אָמֵן כֵּן יֹאמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: And Benayahu son of Yehoyada answered the king and said: Amen! in Hebrew. Later, of course, it enters prayer texts, even in English. So may YHWH, the God of my lord king, declare!

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיָה יְהוָה עִם־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כֵּן יהי [יִהְיֶה] עִם־שְׁלֹמֹה וִיגַדֵּל אֶת־כִּסְאוֹ מִכִּסֵּא אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד׃
verses.english: As YHWH has been with my lord king,so may he be with Shelomo,and he may make his throne greater than the throne of my lord King David!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וְנָתָן הַנָּבִיא וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע וְהַכְּרֵתִי וְהַפְּלֵתִי וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה עַל־פִּרְדַּת הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיֹּלִכוּ אֹתוֹ עַל־גִּחוֹן׃
verses.english: So he went down, Tzadok the priest, with Natan the prophet and Benayahu son of Yehoyada,and the Kereitites and the Peleitites;they had Shelomo mount the mule of King Davidand brought him to the Gihon.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־קֶרֶן הַשֶּׁמֶן מִן־הָאֹהֶל וַיִּמְשַׁח אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה וַיִּתְקְעוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָר וַיֹּאמְרוּ כָּל־הָעָם יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה׃
verses.english: Then Tzadok the priest took a horn of oil from the Tentand anointed Shelomo,and they sounded-a-blast on the shofar;and all the people said:May King Shelomo live!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ כָל־הָעָם אַחֲרָיו וְהָעָם מְחַלְּלִים בַּחֲלִלִים וּשְׂמֵחִים שִׂמְחָה גְדוֹלָה וַתִּבָּקַע הָאָרֶץ בְּקוֹלָם׃
verses.english: And all the people went up after him;the people were piping on pipes) is onomatopoetic, and comes from a root meaning “hollow.” and rejoicing with great joy,so that the earth split at their sound.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ וְכָל־הַקְּרֻאִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וְהֵם כִּלּוּ לֶאֱכֹל וַיִּשְׁמַע יוֹאָב אֶת־קוֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר וַיֹּאמֶר מַדּוּעַ קוֹל־הַקִּרְיָה הוֹמָה׃
verses.english: Adoniyyahu heard it, and all those invited who were with him—now they had just finished eating—and [when] Yoav heard the sound of the shofar,he said:For-what-reason is the sound of the city) is more frequently found in poetry. [one of] panic?

verses.hebrew: עוֹדֶנּוּ מְדַבֵּר וְהִנֵּה יוֹנָתָן בֶּן־אֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן בָּא וַיֹּאמֶר אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ בֹּא כִּי אִישׁ חַיִל אַתָּה וְטוֹב תְּבַשֵּׂר׃
verses.english: He was still speaking,when here: Yonatan son of Evyatar the priest came.Adoniyyahu said: Come in!For you are a man of valor,and you bring good news.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן יוֹנָתָן וַיֹּאמֶר לַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ אֲבָל אֲדֹנֵינוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ־דָּוִד הִמְלִיךְ אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה׃
verses.english: Yonatan spoke up and said to Adoniyyahu:But—our lord King David has made Shelomo king!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אִתּוֹ־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶת־נָתָן הַנָּבִיא וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וְהַכְּרֵתִי וְהַפְּלֵתִי וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֹתוֹ עַל פִּרְדַּת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: The king sent with him Tzadok the priest and Natan the prophet and Benayahu son of Yehoyada,and the Kereitites and the Peleitites,and they had him mount the king’s mule,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְשְׁחוּ אֹתוֹ צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וְנָתָן הַנָּבִיא לְמֶלֶךְ בְּגִחוֹן וַיַּעֲלוּ מִשָּׁם שְׂמֵחִים וַתֵּהֹם הַקִּרְיָה הוּא הַקּוֹל אֲשֶׁר שְׁמַעְתֶּם׃
verses.english: and Tzadok the priest and Natan the prophet anointed him as king at the Gihon;they went up from there rejoicing,and the city was [as in a] panic!That is the sound that you heard.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם יָשַׁב שְׁלֹמֹה עַל כִּסֵּא הַמְּלוּכָה׃
verses.english: And even more, Shelomo is seated on the throne of the kingdom,

verses.hebrew: וְגַם־בָּאוּ עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־אֲדֹנֵינוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד לֵאמֹר יֵיטֵב אלהיך [אֱלֹהִים] אֶת־שֵׁם שְׁלֹמֹה מִשְּׁמֶךָ וִיגַדֵּל אֶת־כִּסְאוֹ מִכִּסְאֶךָ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּב׃
verses.english: and even more, the king’s servants have come to bless our lord King David, saying:May your God make Shelomo’s name better than your name,may he make his throne greater than your throne!And the king bowed low on the couch.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם־כָּכָה אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר נָתַן הַיּוֹם יֹשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאִי וְעֵינַי רֹאוֹת׃
verses.english: And even more, thus did the king say:Blessed is YHWH, the God of Israel,who has given [one] today to sit on my throne, and my eyes see it!

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּחֶרְדוּ וַיָּקֻמוּ כָּל־הַקְּרֻאִים אֲשֶׁר לַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ אִישׁ לְדַרְכּוֹ׃
verses.english: Then they trembled and arose, all those invited who were for Adoniyyahu,and each one went on his way.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ יָרֵא מִפְּנֵי שְׁלֹמֹה וַיָּקָם וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּחֲזֵק בְּקַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃
verses.english: And Adoniyyahu was in fear before Shelomo,so he arose and went and took hold of the horns of the sacrificialaltar.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לִשְׁלֹמֹה לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ יָרֵא אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וְהִנֵּה אָחַז בְּקַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֵאמֹר יִשָּׁבַע־לִי כַיּוֹם הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה אִם־יָמִית אֶת־עַבְדּוֹ בֶּחָרֶב׃
verses.english: And it was told to Shelomo, saying:Here, Adoniyyahu is in fear of King Shelomo,and here, he has taken hold of the horns of the altar, saying:Let King Shelomo swear to me this [very] day that he will not put his servant to death by the sword!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁלֹמֹה אִם יִהְיֶה לְבֶן־חַיִל לֹא־יִפֹּל מִשַּׂעֲרָתוֹ אָרְצָה וְאִם־רָעָה תִמָּצֵא־בוֹ וָמֵת׃
verses.english: So Shelomo said:If he behaves like a valiant one,not a hair of his will fall to the ground;but if any evil be found in him, then he shall die!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיֹּרִדֻהוּ מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיָּבֹא וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ שְׁלֹמֹה לֵךְ לְבֵיתֶךָ׃
verses.english: King Shelomo sent, and they brought him down from the altar;he came and bowed low to King Shelomo,and Shelomo said to him:Go back to your house!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְבוּ יְמֵי־דָוִד לָמוּת וַיְצַו אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: Now David’s days drew near to die,so he charged Shelomo his son, saying:

verses.hebrew: אָנֹכִי הֹלֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ כָּל־הָאָרֶץ וְחָזַקְתָּ וְהָיִיתָ לְאִישׁ׃
verses.english: I am about to go the way of all the earth.You are to be strong, and be a man!

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָלֶכֶת בִּדְרָכָיו לִשְׁמֹר חֻקֹּתָיו מִצְוֺתָיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו וְעֵדְוֺתָיו כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה לְמַעַן תַּשְׂכִּיל אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה וְאֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר תִּפְנֶה שָׁם׃
verses.english: You are to keep the keeping of YHWH your God,walking in his ways, keeping his laws, his commandments, his rules, and his testimonies,as it is written in the Instruction of Moshe,in order that you may cause to prosper all that you doand wherever you face,

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן יָקִים יְהוָה אֶת־דְּבָרוֹ אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר עָלַי לֵאמֹר אִם־יִשְׁמְרוּ בָנֶיךָ אֶת־דַּרְכָּם לָלֶכֶת לְפָנַי בֶּאֱמֶת בְּכָל־לְבָבָם וּבְכָל־נַפְשָׁם לֵאמֹר לֹא־יִכָּרֵת לְךָ אִישׁ מֵעַל כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: in order that YHWH may fulfill his word that he spoke to me, saying:If your sons will guard their way,walking in my presence in truth,with all their heart and with all their being,no one will [ever] be cut off from you from the throne of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לִי יוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לִשְׁנֵי־שָׂרֵי צִבְאוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר וְלַעֲמָשָׂא בֶן־יֶתֶר וַיַּהַרְגֵם וַיָּשֶׂם דְּמֵי־מִלְחָמָה בְּשָׁלֹם וַיִּתֵּן דְּמֵי מִלְחָמָה בַּחֲגֹרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר בְּמָתְנָיו וּבְנַעֲלוֹ אֲשֶׁר בְּרַגְלָיו׃
verses.english: Now even more, you yourself know what Yoav son of Tzeruya did to me,what he did to the two commanders of the armed-forces of Israel,to Avner son of Ner and to Amasa and ah-mah-SAH; David’s perceived enemies, allied to Sha’ul. They are both killed by being stabbed in the abdomen (II Sam. 3, 20). son of Yeter—he killed them,and he brought the blood of war into peacetime:he put the blood of war on his belt that is on his loins and on his sandal that is on his feet.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ כְּחָכְמָתֶךָ וְלֹא־תוֹרֵד שֵׂיבָתוֹ בְּשָׁלֹם שְׁאֹל׃
verses.english: So you are to act according to your worldly-wisdom:you must not let his gray-hair go down in peace to Sheol!

verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי בַרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי תַּעֲשֶׂה־חֶסֶד וְהָיוּ בְּאֹכְלֵי שֻׁלְחָנֶךָ כִּי־כֵן קָרְבוּ אֵלַי בְּבָרְחִי מִפְּנֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם אָחִיךָ׃
verses.english: But to the sons of Barzillai the Gil’adite you are to show loyalty;they should be among those eating at your table,for thus they came near to me [in friendship] when I ran away from Avshalom your brother.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה עִמְּךָ שִׁמְעִי בֶן־גֵּרָא בֶן־הַיְמִינִי מִבַּחֻרִים וְהוּא קִלְלַנִי קְלָלָה נִמְרֶצֶת בְּיוֹם לֶכְתִּי מַחֲנָיִם וְהוּא־יָרַד לִקְרָאתִי הַיַּרְדֵּן וָאֶשָּׁבַע לוֹ בַיהוָה לֵאמֹר אִם־אֲמִיתְךָ בֶּחָרֶב׃
verses.english: And here, with you is Shim’i son of Gera, the Binyaminite from Bahurim:he cursed me with a grievous curse on the day of my going to Mahanayim.But when he went down to meet me at the Jordan,I swore to him by YHWH, saying:If I should put you to death by the sword … !

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אַל־תְּנַקֵּהוּ כִּי אִישׁ חָכָם אָתָּה וְיָדַעְתָּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה־לּוֹ וְהוֹרַדְתָּ אֶת־שֵׂיבָתוֹ בְּדָם שְׁאוֹל׃
verses.english: But now, do not hold him clear,for you are a worldly-wise man:you know what you must do to him,so that you bring down his gray-hair in blood to Sheol!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב דָּוִד עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּעִיר דָּוִד׃
verses.english: And David lay beside his fathers,and was buried in the City of David.

verses.hebrew: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ דָּוִד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בְּחֶבְרוֹן מָלַךְ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וּבִירוּשָׁלִַם מָלַךְ שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים׃
verses.english: Now the days that David reigned as king over Israel were forty years:in Hevron he reigned as king for seven years, while in Jerusalem he reigned as king for thirty-three trad. English “Hebron.” years.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁלֹמֹה יָשַׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא דָּוִד אָבִיו וַתִּכֹּן מַלְכֻתוֹ מְאֹד׃
verses.english: And Shelomo sat on the throne of David his father,and his kingdom was exceedingly firmly-established.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ בֶן־חַגֵּית אֶל־בַּת־שֶׁבַע אֵם־שְׁלֹמֹה וַתֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלוֹם בֹּאֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: Adoniyyahu son of Haggit came to Bat-Sheva mother of Shelomo.She said:Is your coming in peace?He said:In peace.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּבָר לִי אֵלָיִךְ וַתֹּאמֶר דַּבֵּר׃
verses.english: And he said:I have a word for you.She said: Speak!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַתְּ יָדַעַתְּ כִּי־לִי הָיְתָה הַמְּלוּכָה וְעָלַי שָׂמוּ כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל פְּנֵיהֶם לִמְלֹךְ וַתִּסֹּב הַמְּלוּכָה וַתְּהִי לְאָחִי כִּי מֵיְהוָה הָיְתָה לּוֹ׃
verses.english: He said:You yourself know that mine was the kingdom,and that toward me all Israel had set their faces to be king.But the kingdom has been reversed is used several times in these books to indicate a change of leadership (Machinist 1995). and has become my brother’s,since it was from YHWH that it became his.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שְׁאֵלָה אַחַת אָנֹכִי שֹׁאֵל מֵאִתָּךְ אַל־תָּשִׁבִי אֶת־פָּנָי וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דַּבֵּר׃
verses.english: So-now,there is one request that I request of you—do not turn away my face!She said to him: Speak!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אִמְרִי־נָא לִשְׁלֹמֹה הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי לֹא־יָשִׁיב אֶת־פָּנָיִךְ וְיִתֶּן־לִי אֶת־אֲבִישַׁג הַשּׁוּנַמִּית לְאִשָּׁה׃
verses.english: He said:Pray talk to Shelomo the king—for he will not turn away your face—that he may give me Avishag the Shunammite as a wife.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר בַּת־שֶׁבַע טוֹב אָנֹכִי אֲדַבֵּר עָלֶיךָ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: Bat-Sheva said: Very well,I myself will speak regarding you to the king.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא בַת־שֶׁבַע אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לְדַבֶּר־לוֹ עַל־אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ וַיָּקָם הַמֶּלֶךְ לִקְרָאתָהּ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לָהּ וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל־כִּסְאוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם כִּסֵּא לְאֵם הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתֵּשֶׁב לִימִינוֹ׃
verses.english: So Bat-Sheva came to King Shelomo, to speak to him regarding Adoniyyahu.And the king arose to meet her, and bowed low to her;then he sat down on his throne,and he prepared a throne for the king’s mother, and she sat down at his right.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר שְׁאֵלָה אַחַת קְטַנָּה אָנֹכִי שֹׁאֶלֶת מֵאִתָּךְ אַל־תָּשֶׁב אֶת־פָּנָי וַיֹּאמֶר־לָהּ הַמֶּלֶךְ שַׁאֲלִי אִמִּי כִּי לֹא־אָשִׁיב אֶת־פָּנָיִךְ׃
verses.english: She said:There is one small request that I request of you;do not turn away my face.The king said to her:Make request, mother,for I will not turn away your face.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר יֻתַּן אֶת־אֲבִישַׁג הַשֻּׁנַמִּית לַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ אָחִיךָ לְאִשָּׁה׃
verses.english: She said:Let Avishag the Shunammite be given to Adoniyyahu your brother as a wife.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיֹּאמֶר לְאִמּוֹ וְלָמָה אַתְּ שֹׁאֶלֶת אֶת־אֲבִישַׁג הַשֻּׁנַמִּית לַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ וְשַׁאֲלִי־לוֹ אֶת־הַמְּלוּכָה כִּי הוּא אָחִי הַגָּדוֹל מִמֶּנִּי וְלוֹ וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן וּלְיוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה׃
verses.english: King Shelomo answered and said to his mother:Now why are you requesting Avishag the Shunammite for Adoniyyahu?Request the kingdom [itself] for him,for he is my brother, the one older than I!—for him and for Evyatar the priest and for Yoav son of Tzeruya!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׁבַע הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בַּיהוָה לֵאמֹר כֹּה יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִיף כִּי בְנַפְשׁוֹ דִּבֶּר אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: And King Shelomo swore by YHWH, saying:Thus may God do to me, and thus may he add:indeed, at [the cost of] his life has Adoniyyahu spoken this word!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה חַי־יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר הֱכִינַנִי ויושיביני [וַיּוֹשִׁיבַנִי] עַל־כִּסֵּא דָּוִד אָבִי וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה־לִי בַּיִת כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר כִּי הַיּוֹם יוּמַת אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ׃
verses.english: So-now, YHWH, who has established-me-firmly and seated me on the throne of David my father,and who has made me a [dynastic] house, as he promised:indeed, today Adoniyyahu will be put to death!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בְּיַד בְּנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע וַיִּפְגַּע־בּוֹ וַיָּמֹת׃
verses.english: So King Shelomo sent by the hand of Benayahu son of Yehoyada;he attacked) is used four times in this chapter (parallel perhaps to the four occasions in Samuel when David’s enemies are stabbed in the abdomen). It often means “come upon,” but can also connote violence. Older translations use “smite,” which I rejected as unnecessarily archaic. him, so that he died.

verses.hebrew: וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ עֲנָתֹת לֵךְ עַל־שָׂדֶיךָ כִּי אִישׁ מָוֶת אָתָּה וּבַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לֹא אֲמִיתֶךָ כִּי־נָשָׂאתָ אֶת־אֲרוֹן אֲדֹנָי יְהֹוִה לִפְנֵי דָּוִד אָבִי וְכִי הִתְעַנִּיתָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־הִתְעַנָּה אָבִי׃
verses.english: Now to Evyatar the priest, the king said:To Anatot, go to your fields!For you are a man [deserving] of death,but on this day I will not put you to death,since you carried the Coffer of YHWH before my father David,and since you suffered all that my father suffered.

verses.hebrew: וַיְגָרֶשׁ שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־אֶבְיָתָר מִהְיוֹת כֹּהֵן לַיהוָה לְמַלֵּא אֶת־דְּבַר יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר עַל־בֵּית עֵלִי בְּשִׁלֹה׃
verses.english: So Shelomo drove out Evyatar from being priest to YHWH,so as to fulfill the word of YHWH that he had spoken regarding the House of Eli the chief priest/leader at the beginning of the book of Samuel. at Shilo it was a major religious center in the north..

verses.hebrew: וְהַשְּׁמֻעָה בָּאָה עַד־יוֹאָב כִּי יוֹאָב נָטָה אַחֲרֵי אֲדֹנִיָּה וְאַחֲרֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם לֹא נָטָה וַיָּנָס יוֹאָב אֶל־אֹהֶל יְהוָה וַיַּחֲזֵק בְּקַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃
verses.english: Now the report came to Yoav—since Yoav had inclined after Adoniyya, though after Avshalom he had not inclined—and Yoav fled to the Tent of YHWH and took hold of the horns of the altar.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה כִּי נָס יוֹאָב אֶל־אֹהֶל יְהוָה וְהִנֵּה אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּשְׁלַח שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־בְּנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע לֵאמֹר לֵךְ פְּגַע־בּוֹ׃
verses.english: King Shelomo was told that Yoav had fled to the Tent of YHWH,and here: he was next to the altar,so Shelomo sent Benayahu son of Yehoyada, saying:Go, attack him!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא בְנָיָהוּ אֶל־אֹהֶל יְהוָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּה־אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ צֵא וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא כִּי פֹה אָמוּת וַיָּשֶׁב בְּנָיָהוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר לֵאמֹר כֹּה־דִבֶּר יוֹאָב וְכֹה עָנָנִי׃
verses.english: Benayahu came to the Tent of YHWHand said to him:Thus says the king:Come out!He said:No, for here I will die!Benayahu returned word to the king, saying:Thus spoke Yoav, and thus he answered me.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ עֲשֵׂה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר וּפְגַע־בּוֹ וּקְבַרְתּוֹ וַהֲסִירֹתָ דְּמֵי חִנָּם אֲשֶׁר שָׁפַךְ יוֹאָב מֵעָלַי וּמֵעַל בֵּית אָבִי׃
verses.english: The king said to him:Do as he spoke—attack him and then bury him,so that you may remove the causeless blood that Yoav shedfrom me and from my Father’s House.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵשִׁיב יְהוָה אֶת־דָּמוֹ עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ אֲשֶׁר פָּגַע בִּשְׁנֵי־אֲנָשִׁים צַדִּקִים וְטֹבִים מִמֶּנּוּ וַיַּהַרְגֵם בַּחֶרֶב וְאָבִי דָוִד לֹא יָדָע אֶת־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר שַׂר־צְבָא יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת־עֲמָשָׂא בֶן־יֶתֶר שַׂר־צְבָא יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: May YHWH return his blood on his head—[seeing] that he attacked two men more righteous and noble), which in the Hebrew Bible carries a wide range of meanings, physical and spiritual. than he, and killed them with the sword,while my father David did not know:Avner son of Ner, Commander of the Armed-Forces of Israel,and Amasa son of Yeter, Commander of the Armed-Forces of Judah.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁבוּ דְמֵיהֶם בְּרֹאשׁ יוֹאָב וּבְרֹאשׁ זַרְעוֹ לְעֹלָם וּלְדָוִד וּלְזַרְעוֹ וּלְבֵיתוֹ וּלְכִסְאוֹ יִהְיֶה שָׁלוֹם עַד־עוֹלָם מֵעִם יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Their bloodguilt will return on the head of Yoav and on the head of his seed, into the ages,while for David, and for his seed, and for his house, and for his throne, there will be peace for the ages from YHWH!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל בְּנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וַיִּפְגַּע־בּוֹ וַיְמִתֵהוּ וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּבֵיתוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר׃
verses.english: So Benayahu son of Yehoyada went up and attacked him, and put him to death;he was buried in his house in the wilderness.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־בְּנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע תַּחְתָּיו עַל־הַצָּבָא וְאֶת־צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן נָתַן הַמֶּלֶךְ תַּחַת אֶבְיָתָר׃
verses.english: And the king put Benayahu son of Yehoyada in his place as [The One] Over the Armed-Forces,while Tzadok the priest, the king put in place of Evyatar.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּקְרָא לְשִׁמְעִי וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בְּנֵה־לְךָ בַיִת בִּירוּשָׁלִַם וְיָשַׁבְתָּ שָׁם וְלֹא־תֵצֵא מִשָּׁם אָנֶה וָאָנָה׃
verses.english: Then the king sent and summoned Shim’iand said to him:Build yourself a house in Jerusalem and stay there;you are not to go out of there, [either] here or there.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בְּיוֹם צֵאתְךָ וְעָבַרְתָּ אֶת־נַחַל קִדְרוֹן יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע כִּי מוֹת תָּמוּת דָּמְךָ יִהְיֶה בְרֹאשֶׁךָ׃
verses.english: For it will be, on the day of your going out and crossing Wadi Kidron:know, yes, know that you will die, yes, die—your blood will be on your [own] head!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְעִי לַמֶּלֶךְ טוֹב הַדָּבָר כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה עַבְדֶּךָ וַיֵּשֶׁב שִׁמְעִי בִּירוּשָׁלִַם יָמִים רַבִּים׃
verses.english: Shim’i said to the king:The word is good;as my lord king has spoken, thus will your servant do.And Shim’i stayed in Jerusalem for many days.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים וַיִּבְרְחוּ שְׁנֵי־עֲבָדִים לְשִׁמְעִי אֶל־אָכִישׁ בֶּן־מַעֲכָה מֶלֶךְ גַּת וַיַּגִּידוּ לְשִׁמְעִי לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה עֲבָדֶיךָ בְּגַת׃
verses.english: But it was at the end of three yearsthat two of Shim’i’s servants ran off to Akhish son of Maakha, king of Gat; trad. English “Gath,” one of the five major Philistine cities near the Mediterranean coast. So Shim’i actually does not cross the Kidron, which lies in the opposite direction.,and they told Shim’i, saying:Here, your servants are at Gat!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם שִׁמְעִי וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת־חֲמֹרוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ גַּתָה אֶל־אָכִישׁ לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־עֲבָדָיו וַיֵּלֶךְ שִׁמְעִי וַיָּבֵא אֶת־עֲבָדָיו מִגַּת׃
verses.english: So Shim’i arose and saddled his donkey and went to Gat, to Akhish,to seek his servants.And Shim’i went and brought back his servants from Gat.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לִשְׁלֹמֹה כִּי־הָלַךְ שִׁמְעִי מִירוּשָׁלִַם גַּת וַיָּשֹׁב׃
verses.english: Shelomo was told that Shim’i had gone from Jerusalem to Gat, and had returned,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּקְרָא לְשִׁמְעִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֲלוֹא הִשְׁבַּעְתִּיךָ בַיהוָה וָאָעִד בְּךָ לֵאמֹר בְּיוֹם צֵאתְךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ אָנֶה וָאָנָה יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע כִּי מוֹת תָּמוּת וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלַי טוֹב הַדָּבָר שָׁמָעְתִּי׃
verses.english: so the king sent and called for Shim’i;he said to him:Did I not have you swear by YHWH—and I warned you—saying:On the day of your going out, if you should go [either] here or there,know, yes, know that you will die, yes, die!?And you said to me:The word is good—I hearken perhaps puns on the name Shim’i (Fokkelman 1981)..

verses.hebrew: וּמַדּוּעַ לֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ אֵת שְׁבֻעַת יְהוָה וְאֶת־הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּיתִי עָלֶיךָ׃
verses.english: So why did you not keep the sworn-oath of YHWH,and the command that I commanded you?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־שִׁמְעִי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֵת כָּל־הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר יָדַע לְבָבְךָ אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ לְדָוִד אָבִי וְהֵשִׁיב יְהוָה אֶת־רָעָתְךָ בְּרֹאשֶׁךָ׃
verses.english: And the king said to Shim’i:You know all the evildoing that your heart know all the evildoing that your heart knew: This odd phraseology calls upon Shim’i to remember the past; his previous “evildoing” to David will now bring down the ultimate evil (or “disaster”) upon himself. knew,that you did to David my father.So YHWH will return your evildoing on your head!

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בָּרוּךְ וְכִסֵּא דָוִד יִהְיֶה נָכוֹן לִפְנֵי יְהוָה עַד־עוֹלָם׃
verses.english: But King Shelomo is blessed,and the throne of King David will be firmly-established before YHWH for the ages!

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־בְּנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וַיֵּצֵא וַיִּפְגַּע־בּוֹ וַיָּמֹת וְהַמַּמְלָכָה נָכוֹנָה בְּיַד־שְׁלֹמֹה׃
verses.english: So the king commanded Benayahu son of Yehoyada,and he went out and attacked him, so that he died.And the kingdom was firmly-established in Shelomo’s hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְחַתֵּן שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם וַיִּקַּח אֶת־בַּת־פַּרְעֹה וַיְבִיאֶהָ אֶל־עִיר דָּוִד עַד כַּלֹּתוֹ לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּיתוֹ וְאֶת־בֵּית יְהוָה וְאֶת־חוֹמַת יְרוּשָׁלִַם סָבִיב׃
verses.english: Shelomo became the son-in-law of Pharaoh of Egypt:he took Pharaoh’s daughter [in marriage], and brought her to the City of David,until he had finished building his house) in these texts. Note which of the two is mentioned first here—a possible suggestion as to their relative importance in Shelomo’s eyes., and the House of YHWH, and the wall of Jerusalem, all around.

verses.hebrew: רַק הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים בַּבָּמוֹת כִּי לֹא־נִבְנָה בַיִת לְשֵׁם יְהוָה עַד הַיָּמִים הָהֵם׃
verses.english: However, the people were sacrificing at the sanctuaries,since no house had been built for the name of YHWH up until those days.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱהַב שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־יְהוָה לָלֶכֶת בְּחֻקּוֹת דָּוִד אָבִיו רַק בַּבָּמוֹת הוּא מְזַבֵּחַ וּמַקְטִיר׃
verses.english: And Shelomo loved YHWH,walking in the practices of David his father;however, at the sanctuaries he was offering-sacrifices and sending-up-smoke, usually denotes incense (ketoret) offerings..

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ גִּבְעֹנָה לִזְבֹּחַ שָׁם כִּי הִיא הַבָּמָה הַגְּדוֹלָה אֶלֶף עֹלוֹת יַעֲלֶה שְׁלֹמֹה עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַהוּא׃
verses.english: And the king went to Giv’on, to sacrifice there,for it was the great sanctuary;a thousand offerings-up would Shelomo offer up on that altar.

verses.hebrew: בְּגִבְעוֹן נִרְאָה יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה בַּחֲלוֹם הַלָּיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים שְׁאַל מָה אֶתֶּן־לָךְ׃
verses.english: At Giv’on, YHWH appeared to Shelomo in a dream of the night.God said:Make request: What shall I give you?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁלֹמֹה אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ עִם־עַבְדְּךָ דָוִד אָבִי חֶסֶד גָּדוֹל כַּאֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ לְפָנֶיךָ בֶּאֱמֶת וּבִצְדָקָה וּבְיִשְׁרַת לֵבָב עִמָּךְ וַתִּשְׁמָר־לוֹ אֶת־הַחֶסֶד הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה וַתִּתֶּן־לוֹ בֵן יֹשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאוֹ כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: Shelomo said:You yourself have shown great loyalty to your servant, David my father,as he walked before you in truth and in equity and in rightness of heart beside you,and you have kept this great loyalty toward him, by giving him a son to sit on his throne, as is this day.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי אַתָּה הִמְלַכְתָּ אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ תַּחַת דָּוִד אָבִי וְאָנֹכִי נַעַר קָטֹן לֹא אֵדַע צֵאת וָבֹא׃
verses.english: So-now, YHWH my God,you yourself have made your servant king in place of David my father,but I am a young lad—I do not know how to go out and to come in!

verses.hebrew: וְעַבְדְּךָ בְּתוֹךְ עַמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר בָּחָרְתָּ עַם־רָב אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִמָּנֶה וְלֹא יִסָּפֵר מֵרֹב׃
verses.english: And your servant is in the midst of your people whom you have chosen,a people so many that it cannot be measured and cannot be numbered in abundance.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ לֵב שֹׁמֵעַ לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת־עַמְּךָ לְהָבִין בֵּין־טוֹב לְרָע כִּי מִי יוּכַל לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת־עַמְּךָ הַכָּבֵד הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: So give your servant an understanding heartto judge your people, to discern between good and evil.For who is able to judge this your weighty people?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּיטַב הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי אֲדֹנָי כִּי שָׁאַל שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: The word was good in the eyes of the Lord,that Shelomo had requested this thing;

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֵלָיו יַעַן אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַלְתָּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְלֹא־שָׁאַלְתָּ לְּךָ יָמִים רַבִּים וְלֹא־שָׁאַלְתָּ לְּךָ עֹשֶׁר וְלֹא שָׁאַלְתָּ נֶפֶשׁ אֹיְבֶיךָ וְשָׁאַלְתָּ לְּךָ הָבִין לִשְׁמֹעַ מִשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: God said to him:Because you requested this thingand did not request for yourself many daysand did not request for yourself richesand did not request the life of your enemies,but requested for yourself discernment to understand justice,

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה עָשִׂיתִי כִּדְבָרֶיךָ הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי לְךָ לֵב חָכָם וְנָבוֹן אֲשֶׁר כָּמוֹךָ לֹא־הָיָה לְפָנֶיךָ וְאַחֲרֶיךָ לֹא־יָקוּם כָּמוֹךָ׃
verses.english: here, I have done according to your words—here, I am giving you a wise and discerning heart,such that like you, none has been before youand after you, none will arise like you.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁאַלְתָּ נָתַתִּי לָךְ גַּם־עֹשֶׁר גַּם־כָּבוֹד אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הָיָה כָמוֹךָ אִישׁ בַּמְּלָכִים כָּל־יָמֶיךָ׃
verses.english: And even what you did not request, I give you:even riches, even honor,such as none has been like you, as a man among kings, for all your days.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם תֵּלֵךְ בִּדְרָכַי לִשְׁמֹר חֻקַּי וּמִצְוֺתַי כַּאֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ דָּוִיד אָבִיךָ וְהַאַרַכְתִּי אֶת־יָמֶיךָ׃
verses.english: And if you walk in my ways, keeping my laws and my commandments,as David your father walked,I will prolong your days.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַץ שְׁלֹמֹה וְהִנֵּה חֲלוֹם וַיָּבוֹא יְרוּשָׁלִַם וַיַּעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־אֲדֹנָי וַיַּעַל עֹלוֹת וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלָמִים וַיַּעַשׂ מִשְׁתֶּה לְכָל־עֲבָדָיו׃
verses.english: Shelomo awoke, and here: [It was] a dream!He came to Jerusalem and stood before the Coffer of the Lord’s Covenantand offered up offerings-up, and performed shalom-offerings,and made a drinkfest for all his servants.

verses.hebrew: אָז תָּבֹאנָה שְׁתַּיִם נָשִׁים זֹנוֹת אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתַּעֲמֹדְנָה לְפָנָיו׃
verses.english: Then two whore women came to the kingand stood before him.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הָאַחַת בִּי אֲדֹנִי אֲנִי וְהָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת יֹשְׁבֹת בְּבַיִת אֶחָד וָאֵלֵד עִמָּהּ בַּבָּיִת׃
verses.english: The one woman said:Please, my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house,and I gave birth alongside her in the house.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לְלִדְתִּי וַתֵּלֶד גַּם־הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת וַאֲנַחְנוּ יַחְדָּו אֵין־זָר אִתָּנוּ בַּבַּיִת זוּלָתִי שְׁתַּיִם־אֲנַחְנוּ בַּבָּיִת׃
verses.english: And it was, on the third day after my giving birth,that also this woman gave birth—now we were together, there was no outsider with us in the house,only the two of us in the house.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת בֶּן־הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת לָיְלָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁכְבָה עָלָיו׃
verses.english: And this woman’s son died at night,[seeing] that she had lain upon him,

verses.hebrew: וַתָּקָם בְּתוֹךְ הַלַּיְלָה וַתִּקַּח אֶת־בְּנִי מֵאֶצְלִי וַאֲמָתְךָ יְשֵׁנָה וַתַּשְׁכִּיבֵהוּ בְּחֵיקָהּ וְאֶת־בְּנָהּ הַמֵּת הִשְׁכִּיבָה בְחֵיקִי׃
verses.english: so she arose in the middle of the night and took my son from next to mewhile your handmaid was sleeping,and laid him in her bosom,while her son, the dead one, she laid in my bosom.

verses.hebrew: וָאָקֻם בַּבֹּקֶר לְהֵינִיק אֶת־בְּנִי וְהִנֵּה־מֵת וָאֶתְבּוֹנֵן אֵלָיו בַּבֹּקֶר וְהִנֵּה לֹא־הָיָה בְנִי אֲשֶׁר יָלָדְתִּי׃
verses.english: I arose at daybreak to nurse my son,and here: he was dead!But when I examined him at daybreak,now here, he was not my son whom I had borne!

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הָאַחֶרֶת לֹא כִי בְּנִי הַחַי וּבְנֵךְ הַמֵּת וְזֹאת אֹמֶרֶת לֹא כִי בְּנֵךְ הַמֵּת וּבְנִי הֶחָי וַתְּדַבֵּרְנָה לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: The other woman said:No—indeed,my son is the living one, and your son is the dead one!And this one was saying:No—indeed,your son is the dead one, and my son is the living one!Thus they spoke before the king.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ זֹאת אֹמֶרֶת זֶה־בְּנִי הַחַי וּבְנֵךְ הַמֵּת וְזֹאת אֹמֶרֶת לֹא כִי בְּנֵךְ הַמֵּת וּבְנִי הֶחָי׃
verses.english: The king said:This one says: This is my son, the living one, and your son is the dead one;while this one says: No—indeed,your son is the dead one, and mine is the living one!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ קְחוּ לִי־חָרֶב וַיָּבִאוּ הַחֶרֶב לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: So the king said:Fetch me a sword!And they brought a sword before the king.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ גִּזְרוּ אֶת־הַיֶּלֶד הַחַי לִשְׁנָיִם וּתְנוּ אֶת־הַחֲצִי לְאַחַת וְאֶת־הַחֲצִי לְאֶחָת׃
verses.english: And the king said:Cut the living child in twoand give half to the one and half to the [other] one!

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר־בְּנָהּ הַחַי אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־נִכְמְרוּ רַחֲמֶיהָ עַל־בְּנָהּ וַתֹּאמֶר בִּי אֲדֹנִי תְּנוּ־לָהּ אֶת־הַיָּלוּד הַחַי וְהָמֵת אַל־תְּמִיתֻהוּ וְזֹאת אֹמֶרֶת גַּם־לִי גַם־לָךְ לֹא יִהְיֶה גְּזֹרוּ׃
verses.english: Then said the woman whose son was the living one to the king—for her insides burned) can also mean “compassion,” and the singular form rehem also denotes “womb.” for her son—she said:Please, my lord, give her the living newborn, but MT has yalud, a term more intimately connected to “birthing” and hence a strong clue as to who the real mother is (see Walsh). ,but death as “the dead one,” contrasting to “the living” one in the line above., don’t put him to death!But this one was saying:Not mine and not yours will he be;cut [him] up!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר תְּנוּ־לָהּ אֶת־הַיָּלוּד הַחַי וְהָמֵת לֹא תְמִיתֻהוּ הִיא אִמּוֹ׃
verses.english: The king spoke up and said:Give her the living newborn;but death, do not put him to death—she is his mother!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּט אֲשֶׁר שָׁפַט הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּרְאוּ מִפְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי רָאוּ כִּי־חָכְמַת אֱלֹהִים בְּקִרְבּוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: And all Israel heard the judgment that the king had pronounced-as-judgment,and they were in awe of the king,for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to execute justice.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מֶלֶךְ עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: King Shelomo was king over all Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה הַשָּׂרִים אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ עֲזַרְיָהוּ בֶן־צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן׃
verses.english: And these were the ministers whom he had:Azaryahu son of Tzadok the Priest,

verses.hebrew: אֱלִיחֹרֶף וַאֲחִיָּה בְּנֵי שִׁישָׁא סֹפְרִים יְהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־אֲחִילוּד הַמַּזְכִּיר׃
verses.english: Elihoref and Ahiyya sons of Shisha, [royal] Scribes,Yehoshafat son of Ahilud, the Herald,

verses.hebrew: וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע עַל־הַצָּבָא וְצָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר כֹּהֲנִים׃
verses.english: and Benayahu son of Yehoyada, [The One] Over the Armed-Forces,and Tzadok and Evyatar, priests,

verses.hebrew: וַעֲזַרְיָהוּ בֶן־נָתָן עַל־הַנִּצָּבִים וְזָבוּד בֶּן־נָתָן כֹּהֵן רֵעֶה הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: and Azaryahu son of Natan, [The One] Over the Prefects,and Zavud son of Natan the priest, Friend of the King,

verses.hebrew: וַאֲחִישָׁר עַל־הַבָּיִת וַאֲדֹנִירָם בֶּן־עַבְדָּא עַל־הַמַּס׃
verses.english: and Ahishar, [The One] Over the Household,and Adoniram son of Avda, [The One] Over the Labor-Gangs.

verses.hebrew: וְלִשְׁלֹמֹה שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר נִצָּבִים עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכִלְכְּלוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ חֹדֶשׁ בַּשָּׁנָה יִהְיֶה עַל־אחד [הָאֶחָד] לְכַלְכֵּל׃
verses.english: Now Shelomo had twelve prefects over all Israel.They provided for the king and for his household;for a month of the year it would be each one’s duty to provide.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹתָם בֶּן־חוּר בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם׃
verses.english: And these were their names:Son of Hur: in the highlands of Efrayim,

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־דֶּקֶר בְּמָקַץ וּבְשַׁעַלְבִים וּבֵית שָׁמֶשׁ וְאֵילוֹן בֵּית חָנָן׃
verses.english: Son of Deker: in Makatz, in Shaalvim, in Bet-Shemesh and Elon Bet-Hanan,

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־חֶסֶד בָּאֲרֻבּוֹת לוֹ שֹׂכֹה וְכָל־אֶרֶץ חֵפֶר׃
verses.english: Son of Hesed: in Arubbot—his [responsibility] was Sokho and all the region of Heyfer,

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אֲבִינָדָב כָּל־נָפַת דֹּאר טָפַת בַּת־שְׁלֹמֹה הָיְתָה לּוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃
verses.english: Son of Avinadav: all Nafat-Dor—Tafat daughter of Shelomo was his wife—

verses.hebrew: בַּעֲנָא בֶּן־אֲחִילוּד תַּעְנַךְ וּמְגִדּוֹ וְכָל־בֵּית שְׁאָן אֲשֶׁר אֵצֶל צָרְתַנָה מִתַּחַת לְיִזְרְעֶאל מִבֵּית שְׁאָן עַד אָבֵל מְחוֹלָה עַד מֵעֵבֶר לְיָקְמֳעָם׃
verses.english: Baana son of Ahilud: in Ta’nakh and Megiddo, and in all of Bet-She’an that is near Tzaretan, below Yizre’el,from Bet-She’an to Avel-Mehola, to [the region] across from Yokmo’am,

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־גֶּבֶר בְּרָמֹת גִּלְעָד לוֹ חַוֺּת יָאִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה אֲשֶׁר בַּגִּלְעָד לוֹ חֶבֶל אַרְגֹּב אֲשֶׁר בַּבָּשָׁן שִׁשִּׁים עָרִים גְּדֹלוֹת חוֹמָה וּבְרִיחַ נְחֹשֶׁת׃
verses.english: Ben-Gever: in the Heights of Gil’ad—his were the Villages of Ya’ir son of Menashe, that were in Gil’ad—his was Hevel Argov that is in Bashan,sixty large towns, [each with] a wall and a bronze bar,

verses.hebrew: אֲחִינָדָב בֶּן־עִדֹּא מַחֲנָיְמָה׃
verses.english: Ahinadav son of Iddo: Mahanayim,

verses.hebrew: אֲחִימַעַץ בְּנַפְתָּלִי גַּם־הוּא לָקַח אֶת־בָּשְׂמַת בַּת־שְׁלֹמֹה לְאִשָּׁה׃
verses.english: Ahimaatz: in Naftali—he too took Bas’mat daughter of Shelomo as a wife—

verses.hebrew: בַּעֲנָא בֶּן־חוּשָׁי בְּאָשֵׁר וּבְעָלוֹת׃
verses.english: Baana son of Hushai: in Asher and in Alot,

verses.hebrew: יְהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־פָּרוּחַ בְּיִשָׂשכָר׃
verses.english: Yehoshafat son of Paruah: in Yissakhar,

verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעִי בֶן־אֵלָא בְּבִנְיָמִן׃
verses.english: Shim’i son of Ela: in Binyamin,

verses.hebrew: גֶּבֶר בֶּן־אֻרִי בְּאֶרֶץ גִּלְעָד אֶרֶץ סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי וְעֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וּנְצִיב אֶחָד אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Gever son of Uri in the land of Gil’ad, the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan,and one prefect who was in the land of …

verses.hebrew: יְהוּדָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל רַבִּים כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַיָּם לָרֹב אֹכְלִים וְשֹׁתִים וּשְׂמֵחִים׃
verses.english: Judah and Israel were abundant [in number],like the sand that is by the sea in abundance,eating and drinking and rejoicing.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁלֹמֹה הָיָה מוֹשֵׁל בְּכָל־הַמַּמְלָכוֹת מִן־הַנָּהָר אֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְעַד גְּבוּל מִצְרָיִם מַגִּשִׁים מִנְחָה וְעֹבְדִים אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה כָּל־יְמֵי חַיָּיו׃
verses.english: Now Shelomo was ruling over all the kingdomsfrom the River [to] the land of the Philistines, to the border of Egypt;they were bringing tribute-gifts and were subservient to Shelomo all the days of his life.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לֶחֶם־שְׁלֹמֹה לְיוֹם אֶחָד שְׁלֹשִׁים כֹּר סֹלֶת וְשִׁשִּׁים כֹּר קָמַח׃
verses.english: And Shelomo’s food for a single day was:thirty cors This measure, dry, equaled fourteen bushels, and is the equivalent of the homer, cited elsewhere. of flour and sixty cors of meal,

verses.hebrew: עֲשָׂרָה בָקָר בְּרִאִים וְעֶשְׂרִים בָּקָר רְעִי וּמֵאָה צֹאן לְבַד מֵאַיָּל וּצְבִי וְיַחְמוּר וּבַרְבֻּרִים אֲבוּסִים׃
verses.english: ten fattened cattle, twenty pastured cattle, and a hundred sheep,aside from gazelles and deer, roebucks, and well-fed geese.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הוּא רֹדֶה בְּכָל־עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר מִתִּפְסַח וְעַד־עַזָּה בְּכָל־מַלְכֵי עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וְשָׁלוֹם הָיָה לוֹ מִכָּל־עֲבָרָיו מִסָּבִיב׃
verses.english: For he had dominion over all [the land] Across the River,from Tifsah, a town on the Euphrates, about four hundred miles from Gaza; it was on a major trade route from Mesopotamia to the western lands. to Gaza,over all the kings Across the River,and peace was on his every side, round about.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב יְהוּדָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל לָבֶטַח אִישׁ תַּחַת גַּפְנוֹ וְתַחַת תְּאֵנָתוֹ מִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שָׁבַע כֹּל יְמֵי שְׁלֹמֹה׃
verses.english: So Judah and Israel dwelt in security,each one beneath his vine and beneath his fig tree,from Dan to Be’er-Sheva,all the days of Shelomo.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לִשְׁלֹמֹה אַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף אֻרְוֺת סוּסִים לְמֶרְכָּבוֹ וּשְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף פָּרָשִׁים׃
verses.english: Now Shelomo had four thousand stalls of horses for his chariotryand twelve thousand steeds.

verses.hebrew: וְכִלְכְּלוּ הַנִּצָּבִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וְאֵת כָּל־הַקָּרֵב אֶל־שֻׁלְחַן הַמֶּלֶךְ־שְׁלֹמֹה אִישׁ חָדְשׁוֹ לֹא יְעַדְּרוּ דָּבָר׃
verses.english: And these prefects provided for King Shelomo and for all those who came near the table of King Shelomo,each one for his [particular] month;they let nothing be wanting.

verses.hebrew: וְהַשְּׂעֹרִים וְהַתֶּבֶן לַסּוּסִים וְלָרָכֶשׁ יָבִאוּ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה־שָּׁם אִישׁ כְּמִשְׁפָּטוֹ׃
verses.english: And as for the barley and the hay for the horses and for the pack-animals,they would bring it to the place where he would be,each one according to his turn.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן אֱלֹהִים חָכְמָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה וּתְבוּנָה הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד וְרֹחַב לֵב כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת הַיָּם׃
verses.english: And God gave wisdom to Shelomo,and discernment, exceedingly much,and breadth of mindlike the sand that is on the shore of the sea,

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶב חָכְמַת שְׁלֹמֹה מֵחָכְמַת כָּל־בְּנֵי־קֶדֶם וּמִכֹּל חָכְמַת מִצְרָיִם׃
verses.english: so that much greater was Shelomo’s wisdom than the wisdom of all the Children of the East,and than the wisdom of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּחְכַּם מִכָּל־הָאָדָם מֵאֵיתָן הָאֶזְרָחִי וְהֵימָן וְכַלְכֹּל וְדַרְדַּע בְּנֵי מָחוֹל וַיְהִי־שְׁמוֹ בְכָל־הַגּוֹיִם סָבִיב׃
verses.english: He was wiser than all [other] human beings—than Eitan the Ezrahiteand Heiman and Kalkol and Darda, the sons of Mahol,and his fame, most often translated “name.” was throughout all the nations, all around.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים מָשָׁל וַיְהִי שִׁירוֹ חֲמִשָּׁה וָאָלֶף׃
verses.english: He spoke three thousand proverbs,and his songs were five and a thousand.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר עַל־הָעֵצִים מִן־הָאֶרֶז אֲשֶׁר בַּלְּבָנוֹן וְעַד הָאֵזוֹב אֲשֶׁר יֹצֵא בַּקִּיר וַיְדַבֵּר עַל־הַבְּהֵמָה וְעַל־הָעוֹף וְעַל־הָרֶמֶשׂ וְעַל־הַדָּגִים׃
verses.english: And he spoke of trees,from the cedar that is in the Levanonto the hyssop that grows out of the wall;and he spoke of animals, of birds, of crawling things, and of fish.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ מִכָּל־הָעַמִּים לִשְׁמֹעַ אֵת חָכְמַת שְׁלֹמֹה מֵאֵת כָּל־מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר שָׁמְעוּ אֶת־חָכְמָתוֹ׃
verses.english: And they came from all the peoples to hear Shelomo’s wisdom,from all the kings of the earth who had heard of his wisdom.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם מֶלֶךְ־צוֹר אֶת־עֲבָדָיו אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה כִּי שָׁמַע כִּי אֹתוֹ מָשְׁחוּ לְמֶלֶךְ תַּחַת אָבִיהוּ כִּי אֹהֵב הָיָה חִירָם לְדָוִד כָּל־הַיָּמִים׃
verses.english: Hiram The Phoenician king’s name is probably short for “Ahiram.” king of Tyre sent his servants to Shelomo,for he had heard that it was he who had been anointed as king in place of his father—for Hiram had loved David [in covenant] all the days.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח שְׁלֹמֹה אֶל־חִירָם לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: And Shelomo sent word to Hiram, saying:

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־דָּוִד אָבִי כִּי לֹא יָכֹל לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לְשֵׁם יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו מִפְּנֵי הַמִּלְחָמָה אֲשֶׁר סְבָבֻהוּ עַד תֵּת־יְהוָה אֹתָם תַּחַת כַּפּוֹת רגלו [רַגְלָי׃]
verses.english: You yourself know [regarding] David my fatherthat he was not able to build a House for the name of YHWH his God,because of the wars that surrounded him,until YHWH put them beneath the soles of my feet.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הֵנִיחַ יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי לִי מִסָּבִיב אֵין שָׂטָן וְאֵין פֶּגַע רָע׃
verses.english: But now,YHWH my God has granted me rest round about;there is no adversary and no evil circumstance.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנְנִי אֹמֵר לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לְשֵׁם יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֶל־דָּוִד אָבִי לֵאמֹר בִּנְךָ אֲשֶׁר אֶתֵּן תַּחְתֶּיךָ עַל־כִּסְאֶךָ הוּא־יִבְנֶה הַבַּיִת לִשְׁמִי׃
verses.english: So here, I intend to build a House for the name of YHWH my God,as YHWH promised to David my father, saying:Your son whom I will put in your place on your throne,he will build the House for my name!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה צַוֵּה וְיִכְרְתוּ־לִי אֲרָזִים מִן־הַלְּבָנוֹן וַעֲבָדַי יִהְיוּ עִם־עֲבָדֶיךָ וּשְׂכַר עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶתֵּן לְךָ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמֵר כִּי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ כִּי אֵין בָּנוּ אִישׁ יֹדֵעַ לִכְרָת־עֵצִים כַּצִּדֹנִים׃
verses.english: So-now,command that they cut down cedars for me from the Levanon;my servants will be beside your servants,and your servants’ wage I will give you, according to whatever you say,for you yourself know that there is no one among us who knows how to cut down trees like the Sidonians.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ חִירָם אֶת־דִּבְרֵי שְׁלֹמֹה וַיִּשְׂמַח מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לְדָוִד בֵּן חָכָם עַל־הָעָם הָרָב הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: It was, when Hiram heard Shelomo’s words,that he rejoiced exceedingly;he said:Blessed is YHWH today,who has given David a wise son over this numerous people!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה לֵאמֹר שָׁמַעְתִּי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַחְתָּ אֵלָי אֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה אֶת־כָּל־חֶפְצְךָ בַּעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים וּבַעֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים׃
verses.english: And Hiram sent to Shelomo, saying:I have heard [the message] that you sent to me;I myself will do whatever you desireregarding cedar trees and regarding juniper trees.

verses.hebrew: עֲבָדַי יֹרִדוּ מִן־הַלְּבָנוֹן יָמָּה וַאֲנִי אֲשִׂימֵם דֹּבְרוֹת בַּיָּם עַד־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־תִּשְׁלַח אֵלַי וְנִפַּצְתִּים שָׁם וְאַתָּה תִשָּׂא וְאַתָּה תַּעֲשֶׂה אֶת־חֶפְצִי לָתֵת לֶחֶם בֵּיתִי׃
verses.english: My servants will bring them down from the Levanon to the Sea,and I will make them into rafts at the Sea, for any place that you send to me;then I will break them up there, so that you may carry them away.As for you, you will do my desire, to give food for my household.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי חִירוֹם נֹתֵן לִשְׁלֹמֹה עֲצֵי אֲרָזִים וַעֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים כָּל־חֶפְצוֹ׃
verses.english: So Hiram would give Shelomo cedar trees and juniper trees, whatever he desired,

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁלֹמֹה נָתַן לְחִירָם עֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף כֹּר חִטִּים מַכֹּלֶת לְבֵיתוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים כֹּר שֶׁמֶן כָּתִית כֹּה־יִתֵּן שְׁלֹמֹה לְחִירָם שָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה׃
verses.english: while Shelomo gave Hiram twenty thousand cors of wheat as food for his household,and twenty cors LXX reads “twenty thousand bahts,” referring to the liquid measure (a tenth of a cor) mentioned in 7:26 below. of pressed oil.Thus did Shelomo give Hiram, year by year.

verses.hebrew: וַיהוָה נָתַן חָכְמָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר־לוֹ וַיְהִי שָׁלֹם בֵּין חִירָם וּבֵין שְׁלֹמֹה וַיִּכְרְתוּ בְרִית שְׁנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: And YHWH gave wisdom to Shelomo, as he had promised him;there was shalom/peace/peace: The word is also used to indicate “treaty loyalty” (Fishbane). Here it links up with the Israelite king’s name. between Hiram and Shelomo,and the two of them cut a covenant.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מַס מִכָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְהִי הַמַּס שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃
verses.english: King Shelomo raised up labor-gangs from all Israel,and the labor-force was thirty thousand men.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלָחֵם לְבָנוֹנָה עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים בַּחֹדֶשׁ חֲלִיפוֹת חֹדֶשׁ יִהְיוּ בַלְּבָנוֹן שְׁנַיִם חֳדָשִׁים בְּבֵיתוֹ וַאֲדֹנִירָם עַל־הַמַּס׃
verses.english: He sent them to the Levanon,ten thousand per month, in shifts:one month they would be in the Levanon, [and] two months at home.And Adoniram was [The One] Over the Labor-force.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לִשְׁלֹמֹה שִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף נֹשֵׂא סַבָּל וּשְׁמֹנִים אֶלֶף חֹצֵב בָּהָר׃
verses.english: Now Shelomo had seventy thousand burden carriersand eighty thousand stone-cutters in the hill-quarry,

verses.hebrew: לְבַד מִשָּׂרֵי הַנִּצָּבִים לִשְׁלֹמֹה אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַמְּלָאכָה שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת הָרֹדִים בָּעָם הָעֹשִׂים בַּמְּלָאכָה׃
verses.english: aside from the prefect commanders of Shelomo who were Over the Work,three thousand and three hundred, who supervised the people, those doing the work.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּסִּעוּ אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת אֲבָנִים יְקָרוֹת לְיַסֵּד הַבָּיִת אַבְנֵי גָזִית׃
verses.english: The king commanded that they transport [from the quarry] large stones, costly stones for setting-the-foundation of the House [with] hewn stones.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְסְלוּ בֹּנֵי שְׁלֹמֹה וּבֹנֵי חִירוֹם וְהַגִּבְלִים וַיָּכִינוּ הָעֵצִים וְהָאֲבָנִים לִבְנוֹת הַבָּיִת׃
verses.english: And Shelomo’s builders and Hiram’s builders and the Giblites carved them.Thus they prepared the timber and the stone for building the House.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִשְׁמוֹנִים שָׁנָה וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה לְצֵאת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ־מִצְרַיִם בַּשָּׁנָה הָרְבִיעִית בְּחֹדֶשׁ זִו הוּא הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי לִמְלֹךְ שְׁלֹמֹה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּבֶן הַבַּיִת לַיהוָה׃
verses.english: Now it was in year four hundred and eighty of the years of the Children of Israel’s going out from the land of Egypt,in the fourth year—in the month of Ziv, the “Blossom Month,” in the spring. This designation, from the Phoenician calendar, corresponds to the Jewish month of Iyyar., that is the second month—of Shelomo’s reign as king over Israel,that he [began] building the House to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לַיהוָה שִׁשִּׁים־אַמָּה אָרְכּוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים רָחְבּוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ׃
verses.english: And the House that King Shelomo built for YHWH was:sixty cubits its length, twenty its width, and thirty cubits its height.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאוּלָם עַל־פְּנֵי הֵיכַל הַבַּיִת עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה אָרְכּוֹ עַל־פְּנֵי רֹחַב הַבָּיִת עֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה רָחְבּוֹ עַל־פְּנֵי הַבָּיִת׃
verses.english: As for the portico at the front of the Great-Hall), cognate elsewhere in the ancient Near East, can indicate a large space, including also “palace” (see I Kings 21:2) and “temple.” of the House:twenty cubits was its length, along the width of the House,and ten by the cubit its depth, in front of the House.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לַבָּיִת חַלּוֹנֵי שְׁקֻפִים אֲטֻמִים׃
verses.english: And he made windows for the House, framed [and] latticed,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן עַל־קִיר הַבַּיִת יצוע [יָצִיעַ] סָבִיב אֶת־קִירוֹת הַבַּיִת סָבִיב לַהֵיכָל וְלַדְּבִיר וַיַּעַשׂ צְלָעוֹת סָבִיב׃
verses.english: and he built an extension against the wall of the House, all around,namely, along the walls of the House,round about the Great-Hall and the Rear-Chamber) is sometimes linked to the “word” (davar) of God, but is probably an architectural rather than a theological term.,and he made side-chambers all around.

verses.hebrew: היצוע [הַיָּצִיעַ] הַתַּחְתֹּנָה חָמֵשׁ בָּאַמָּה רָחְבָּהּ וְהַתִּיכֹנָה שֵׁשׁ בָּאַמָּה רָחְבָּהּ וְהַשְּׁלִישִׁית שֶׁבַע בָּאַמָּה רָחְבָּהּ כִּי מִגְרָעוֹת נָתַן לַבַּיִת סָבִיב חוּצָה לְבִלְתִּי אֲחֹז בְּקִירוֹת־הַבָּיִת׃
verses.english: The lowest side-chamber was five by the cubit its width,with the middle one, six by the cubit its width,and the third one, seven cubits its width,for he placed offsets for the House, all around, on the exterior,so as not to fasten [them] to the walls of the House.

verses.hebrew: וְהַבַּיִת בְּהִבָּנֹתוֹ אֶבֶן־שְׁלֵמָה מַסָּע נִבְנָה וּמַקָּבוֹת וְהַגַּרְזֶן כָּל־כְּלִי בַרְזֶל לֹא־נִשְׁמַע בַּבַּיִת בְּהִבָּנֹתוֹ׃
verses.english: And the House as it was being built,of complete) echoes the name Shelomo, and is used elsewhere in these chapters as a verb. quarry stone it was built,and [neither] hammers nor pickax—any tool of iron—was heard in the House as it was being built.

verses.hebrew: פֶּתַח הַצֵּלָע הַתִּיכֹנָה אֶל־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַיְמָנִית וּבְלוּלִּים יַעֲלוּ עַל־הַתִּיכֹנָה וּמִן־הַתִּיכֹנָה אֶל־הַשְּׁלִשִׁים׃
verses.english: The entrance to the lowest side-chamber was on the right shoulder of the House,while winding-stairs went up to the middle one from the lower one, and from the middle one to the third one.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הַבַּיִת וַיְכַלֵּהוּ וַיִּסְפֹּן אֶת־הַבַּיִת גֵּבִים וּשְׂדֵרֹת בָּאֲרָזִים׃
verses.english: So he built the House and finished it:he covered) means “to cover with wood,” the noun, “ceiling.” the House with hollow-squares and beam-projections, of cedar.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־היצוע [הַיָּצִיעַ] עַל־כָּל־הַבַּיִת חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קוֹמָתוֹ וַיֶּאֱחֹז אֶת־הַבַּיִת בַּעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים׃
verses.english: He built the extension along the entire House, five cubits its height,and secured the House with cedar wood.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהוָה אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: Now the word of YHWH [came] to Shelomo, saying:

verses.hebrew: הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּה בֹנֶה אִם־תֵּלֵךְ בְּחֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַי תַּעֲשֶׂה וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֺתַי לָלֶכֶת בָּהֶם וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת־דְּבָרִי אִתָּךְ אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי אֶל־דָּוִד אָבִיךָ׃
verses.english: [Regarding] this House that you are building:if you walk in my ways, and my practices you observe,and you keep my commandments, walking in them,I will fulfill my word with you which I promised to David your father:

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא אֶעֱזֹב אֶת־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: I will dwell in the midst of the Children of Israel,and I will not abandon my people Israel!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־הַבַּיִת וַיְכַלֵּהוּ׃
verses.english: So Shelomo built the House and finished it;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־קִירוֹת הַבַּיִת מִבַּיְתָה בְּצַלְעוֹת אֲרָזִים מִקַּרְקַע הַבַּיִת עַד־קִירוֹת הַסִּפֻּן צִפָּה עֵץ מִבָּיִת וַיְצַף אֶת־קַרְקַע הַבַּיִת בְּצַלְעוֹת בְּרוֹשִׁים׃
verses.english: he built the walls of the House on the interior with cedar planks,from the floor of the House up to the beams of the ceiling;he overlaid it with wood on the interior,and overlaid the floor of the House with juniper planks.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה מירכותי [מִיַּרְכְּתֵי] הַבַּיִת בְּצַלְעוֹת אֲרָזִים מִן־הַקַּרְקַע עַד־הַקִּירוֹת וַיִּבֶן לוֹ מִבַּיִת לִדְבִיר לְקֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים׃
verses.english: And he built twenty cubits from the flanks of the House with cedar planks,from the floor up to the beams,and built it on the interior as a Rear-Chamber, the Holiest Holy-Place.

verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבָּעִים בָּאַמָּה הָיָה הַבָּיִת הוּא הַהֵיכָל לִפְנָי׃
verses.english: Forty by the cubit [long] was the House—that was the Great-Hall in front [of it].

verses.hebrew: וְאֶרֶז אֶל־הַבַּיִת פְּנִימָה מִקְלַעַת פְּקָעִים וּפְטוּרֵי צִצִּים הַכֹּל אֶרֶז אֵין אֶבֶן נִרְאָה׃
verses.english: Now the cedarwork of the interior of the House was carving of gourds and open flowers;all was cedar, no stone was to be seen.

verses.hebrew: וּדְבִיר בְּתוֹךְ־הַבַּיִת מִפְּנִימָה הֵכִין לְתִתֵּן שָׁם אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Now the Rear-Chamber within the House, in the interior, he prepared for placing there the Coffer of YHWH’s Covenant.

verses.hebrew: וְלִפְנֵי הַדְּבִיר עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה אֹרֶךְ וְעֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה רֹחַב וְעֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב סָגוּר וַיְצַף מִזְבֵּחַ אָרֶז׃
verses.english: And in the forepart of the Rear-Chamber were twenty cubits of length, twenty cubits of width, and twenty cubits its height,and he overlaid it with refined gold.And he overlaid the sacrificial-altar with cedar.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַף שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־הַבַּיִת מִפְּנִימָה זָהָב סָגוּר וַיְעַבֵּר ברתיקות [בְּרַתּוּקוֹת] זָהָב לִפְנֵי הַדְּבִיר וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב׃
verses.english: And Shelomo overlaid the House on the interior with refined gold;he passed chains of gold across the front of the Rear-Chamberand overlaid it with gold,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־כָּל־הַבַּיִת צִפָּה זָהָב עַד־תֹּם כָּל־הַבָּיִת וְכָל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲ‍שֶׁר־לַדְּבִיר צִפָּה זָהָב׃
verses.english: and the entire House he overlaid with gold, until the entire House was done,while the entire altar that belonged to the Rear-Chamber he overlaid with gold.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ בַּדְּבִיר שְׁנֵי כְרוּבִים עֲצֵי־שָׁמֶן עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת קוֹמָתוֹ׃
verses.english: And in the Rear-Chamber he made two winged-sphinxes were a common symbol in the ancient Near East; imaginary, composite creatures, they appear as guardians to royal and sacred buildings. See also Exod. 25:18-20. of oleaster wood,ten cubits its height.

verses.hebrew: וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת כְּנַף הַכְּרוּב הָאֶחָת וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת כְּנַף הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִית עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת מִקְצוֹת כְּנָפָיו וְעַד־קְצוֹת כְּנָפָיו׃
verses.english: Five cubits was the wing of the one sphinx,and five cubits was the wing of the second sphinx—ten cubits from the tips of its wing to the tips of its [other] wing.

verses.hebrew: וְעֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִי מִדָּה אַחַת וְקֶצֶב אֶחָד לִשְׁנֵי הַכְּרֻבִים׃
verses.english: And ten by the cubit was the second sphinx,a single measure and a single shape for the two winged-sphinxes.

verses.hebrew: קוֹמַת הַכְּרוּב הָאֶחָד עֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה וְכֵן הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִי׃
verses.english: The height of the one sphinx was ten by the cubit,and thus for the second sphinx.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־הַכְּרוּבִים בְּתוֹךְ הַבַּיִת הַפְּנִימִי וַיִּפְרְשׂוּ אֶת־כַּנְפֵי הַכְּרֻבִים וַתִּגַּע כְּנַף־הָאֶחָד בַּקִּיר וּכְנַף הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִי נֹגַעַת בַּקִּיר הַשֵּׁנִי וְכַנְפֵיהֶם אֶל־תּוֹךְ הַבַּיִת נֹגְעֹת כָּנָף אֶל־כָּנָף׃
verses.english: And he placed the winged-sphinxes in the middle of the inner House;the wings of the sphinxes were spread out so that the wing of the one touched the wall,and the wing of the second sphinx was touching the second wall,while their wings toward the middle of the house were touching,wing to wing.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַף אֶת־הַכְּרוּבִים זָהָב׃
verses.english: And he overlaid the winged-sphinxes with gold.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כָּל־קִירוֹת הַבַּיִת מֵסַב קָלַע פִּתּוּחֵי מִקְלְעוֹת כְּרוּבִים וְתִמֹרֹת וּפְטוּרֵי צִצִּים מִלִּפְנִים וְלַחִיצוֹן׃
verses.english: Now all the walls of the House, round about, he carved with engraved carvings of winged-sphinxes and palmettes and open flowers,on the inside and out.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־קַרְקַע הַבַּיִת צִפָּה זָהָב לִפְנִימָה וְלַחִיצוֹן׃
verses.english: And the floor of the House he overlaid with gold,inside and out.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת פֶּתַח הַדְּבִיר עָשָׂה דַּלְתוֹת עֲצֵי־שָׁמֶן הָאַיִל מְזוּזוֹת חֲמִשִׁית׃
verses.english: Now the entrance to the Rear-Chamber he made as doors of oleaster wood;the jamb [and] the doorposts were a fifth [of the wall-length] as “five-sided,” and thus bonded for strength..

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּי דַּלְתוֹת עֲצֵי־שֶׁמֶן וְקָלַע עֲלֵיהֶם מִקְלְעוֹת כְּרוּבִים וְתִמֹרוֹת וּפְטוּרֵי צִצִּים וְצִפָּה זָהָב וַיָּרֶד עַל־הַכְּרוּבִים וְעַל־הַתִּמֹרוֹת אֶת־הַזָּהָב׃
verses.english: As for the two doors of oleaster wood,he carved on them carvings of winged-sphinxes, palmettes, and open flowers,and overlaid them with gold,and he hammered the gold over the winged-sphinxes and over the palmettes.

verses.hebrew: וְכֵן עָשָׂה לְפֶתַח הַהֵיכָל מְזוּזוֹת עֲצֵי־שָׁמֶן מֵאֵת רְבִעִית׃
verses.english: And so [too] he made for the entrance to the Great-Hall: posts of oleaster wood, a fourth [of the wall-length],

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּי דַלְתוֹת עֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים שְׁנֵי צְלָעִים הַדֶּלֶת הָאַחַת גְּלִילִים וּשְׁנֵי קְלָעִים הַדֶּלֶת הַשֵּׁנִית גְּלִילִים׃
verses.english: and two doors of juniper wood,with two rib-leaves for the one door, folding,and two rib-leaves for the second door, folding,

verses.hebrew: וְקָלַע כְּרוּבִים וְתִמֹרוֹת וּפְטֻרֵי צִצִּים וְצִפָּה זָהָב מְיֻשָּׁר עַל־הַמְּחֻקֶּה׃
verses.english: and he carved winged-sphinxes, palmettes, and open flowers,and overlaid them with gold,evenly over the chiseled-work.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִית שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרֵי גָזִית וְטוּר כְּרֻתֹת אֲרָזִים׃
verses.english: And he built the interior courtyard of three rows of hewn-stones,and a row of cut cedar.

verses.hebrew: בַּשָּׁנָה הָרְבִיעִית יֻסַּד בֵּית יְהוָה בְּיֶרַח זִו׃
verses.english: In the fourth yearthe House of YHWH was laid-in-foundation,in the month of Ziv.

verses.hebrew: וּבַשָּׁנָה הָאַחַת עֶשְׂרֵה בְּיֶרַח בּוּל הוּא הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִי כָּלָה הַבַּיִת לְכָל־דְּבָרָיו וּלְכָל־משפטו [מִשְׁפָּטָיו] וַיִּבְנֵהוּ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים׃
verses.english: And in the eleventh year, in the moon, an older term for “month.” of Bul—that is the eighth month—the House was finished, in all its details and in all its specifications;he had built it in seven years.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ בָּנָה שְׁלֹמֹה שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וַיְכַל אֶת־כָּל־בֵּיתוֹ׃
verses.english: Now his [own] house Shelomo built in thirteen years;then he finished his entire house.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־בֵּית יַעַר הַלְּבָנוֹן מֵאָה אַמָּה אָרְכּוֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה רָחְבּוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ עַל אַרְבָּעָה טוּרֵי עַמּוּדֵי אֲרָזִים וּכְרֻתוֹת אֲרָזִים עַל־הָעַמּוּדִים׃
verses.english: And he built the House of the Forest of the Levanon:a hundred cubits its length, fifty cubits its width, and thirty cubits its height,on four rows of cedar columns, with cut cedarwork atop the columns.

verses.hebrew: וְסָפֻן בָּאֶרֶז מִמַּעַל עַל־הַצְּלָעֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־הָעַמּוּדִים אַרְבָּעִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר הַטּוּר׃
verses.english: And it was covered with cedar from above, atop the planks that were on the columns,forty-five: fifteen per row.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁקֻפִים שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרִים וּמֶחֱזָה אֶל־מֶחֱזָה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים׃
verses.english: And the window-frames were of three rows,with sight line toward sight line, three times.

verses.hebrew: וְכָל־הַפְּתָחִים וְהַמְּזוּזוֹת רְבֻעִים שָׁקֶף וּמוּל מֶחֱזָה אֶל־מֶחֱזָה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים׃
verses.english: And all the entrances and posts were square of frame, opposite,sight line toward sight line, three times.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת אוּלָם הָעַמּוּדִים עָשָׂה חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה אָרְכּוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה רָחְבּוֹ וְאוּלָם עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם וְעַמֻּדִים וְעָב עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: And the Portico of Columns he made: fifty cubits its lengthand twenty cubits its width,with a portico in front of them,with columns and a cornice in front of them.

verses.hebrew: וְאוּלָם הַכִּסֵּא אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁפָּט־שָׁם אֻלָם הַמִּשְׁפָּט עָשָׂה וְסָפוּן בָּאֶרֶז מֵהַקַּרְקַע עַד־הַקַּרְקָע׃
verses.english: And the Portico of the Throne, where he would pronounce judgment, the Portico of Justice, he made;it was covered with cedar, from floor to floor.

verses.hebrew: וּבֵיתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־יֵשֶׁב שָׁם חָצֵר הָאַחֶרֶת מִבֵּית לָאוּלָם כַּמַּעֲשֶׂה הַזֶּה הָיָה וּבַיִת יַעֲשֶׂה לְבַת־פַּרְעֹה אֲשֶׁר לָקַח שְׁלֹמֹה כָּאוּלָם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: And his housing where he would reside, in the other courtyard within the portico,was like this [same] pattern;and he was [also] to make a house for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom Shelomo had taken [in marriage], like this portico.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־אֵלֶּה אֲבָנִים יְקָרֹת כְּמִדֹּת גָּזִית מְגֹרָרוֹת בַּמְּגֵרָה מִבַּיִת וּמִחוּץ וּמִמַּסָּד עַד־הַטְּפָחוֹת וּמִחוּץ עַד־הֶחָצֵר הַגְּדוֹלָה׃
verses.english: All these were of costly stones, hewn according to measure,smoothed with a smoothing-tool, within and without,from the foundation to the coping,from outside to the Great Courtyard.

verses.hebrew: וּמְיֻסָּד אֲבָנִים יְקָרוֹת אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת אַבְנֵי עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת וְאַבְנֵי שְׁמֹנֶה אַמּוֹת׃
verses.english: It was founded [on] costly stones, large stones,stones of ten cubits and stones of eight cubits.

verses.hebrew: וּמִלְמַעְלָה אֲבָנִים יְקָרוֹת כְּמִדּוֹת גָּזִית וָאָרֶז׃
verses.english: And above were costly stones, hewn to measure, and cedar.

verses.hebrew: וְחָצֵר הַגְּדוֹלָה סָבִיב שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרִים גָּזִית וְטוּר כְּרֻתֹת אֲרָזִים וְלַחֲצַר בֵּית־יְהוָה הַפְּנִימִית וּלְאֻלָם הַבָּיִת׃
verses.english: Now the Great Courtyard, all around, was of three rows of hewnstones and a row of cut cedarwork;[so] for the inner courtyard of the House of YHWH and for the Portico of the Palace-House.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיִּקַּח אֶת־חִירָם מִצֹּר׃
verses.english: And King Shelomo sent and fetched Hiram from Tyre,

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אִשָּׁה אַלְמָנָה הוּא מִמַּטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי וְאָבִיו אִישׁ־צֹרִי חֹרֵשׁ נְחֹשֶׁת וַיִּמָּלֵא אֶת־הַחָכְמָה וְאֶת־הַתְּבוּנָה וְאֶת־הַדַּעַת לַעֲשׂוֹת כָּל־מְלָאכָה בַּנְּחֹשֶׁת וַיָּבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־כָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ׃
verses.english: the son of a widow woman, from the tribe of Naftali,while his father was a Tyrian man, an engraver in bronze;he was filled with practical-wisdom, discernment, and technical-knowledgeto make all kinds of work in bronze.He came to King Shelomo and made all his work:

verses.hebrew: וַיָּצַר אֶת־שְׁנֵי הָעַמּוּדִים נְחֹשֶׁת שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה קוֹמַת הָעַמּוּד הָאֶחָד וְחוּט שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה יָסֹב אֶת־הָעַמּוּד הַשֵּׁנִי׃
verses.english: he fashioned the two columns, of bronze—eighteen cubits the height of the one column,with a cord of twelve cubits [able to] go around it, and so to oto ve-khen, as suggested in ancient versions. the second column.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּי כֹתָרֹת עָשָׂה לָתֵת עַל־רָאשֵׁי הָעַמּוּדִים מֻצַק נְחֹשֶׁת חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קוֹמַת הַכֹּתֶרֶת הָאֶחָת וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קוֹמַת הַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃
verses.english: And two capitals he madeto put on the tops of the columns, cast in bronze—five cubits the height of the one capital, and five cubits the height of the second capital,

verses.hebrew: שְׂבָכִים מַעֲשֵׂה שְׂבָכָה גְּדִלִים מַעֲשֵׂה שַׁרְשְׁרוֹת לַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים שִׁבְעָה לַכֹּתֶרֶת הָאֶחָת וְשִׁבְעָה לַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃
verses.english: [with] networks made of netted making, twisted-decorations of chain making,for the capitals that were on top of the columns:seven for the one capital and seven for the second capital.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־הָעַמּוּדִים וּשְׁנֵי טוּרִים סָבִיב עַל־הַשְּׂבָכָה הָאֶחָת לְכַסּוֹת אֶת־הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הָרִמֹּנִים וְכֵן עָשָׂה לַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃
verses.english: And he made the pomegranates,with two rows surrounding [each] one network, to cover the capitals that were on the top of the columns and ’ammudim).,and thus he made for the second capital.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים מַעֲשֵׂה שׁוּשַׁן בָּאוּלָם אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת׃
verses.english: And the capitals that were on the top of the columnswere a pattern of lilies, in the Portico,four cubits.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹתָרֹת עַל־שְׁנֵי הָעַמּוּדִים גַּם־מִמַּעַל מִלְּעֻמַּת הַבֶּטֶן אֲשֶׁר לְעֵבֶר שבכה [הַשְּׂבָכָה] וְהָרִמּוֹנִים מָאתַיִם טֻרִים סָבִיב עַל הַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃
verses.english: And the capitals on the two columns were also above, close to the bulging-section that was across from the netting,and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows, all around the second capital.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם אֶת־הָעַמֻּדִים לְאֻלָם הַהֵיכָל וַיָּקֶם אֶת־הָעַמּוּד הַיְמָנִי וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ יָכִין וַיָּקֶם אֶת־הָעַמּוּד הַשְּׂמָאלִי וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ בֹּעַז׃
verses.english: He set up the columns for the portico of the Great-Hall:he set up the right column, and called its name Yakhin/He Establishes,and he set up the left column, and called its name Boaz/ In Him, Strength.

verses.hebrew: וְעַל רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים מַעֲשֵׂה שׁוֹשָׁן וַתִּתֹּם מְלֶאכֶת הָעַמּוּדִים׃
verses.english: And on the top of the columns was a pattern of lilies.Then the work of the columns was done.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־הַיָּם מוּצָק עֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה מִשְּׂפָתוֹ עַד־שְׂפָתוֹ עָגֹל סָבִיב וְחָמֵשׁ בָּאַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ וקוה [וְקָו] שְׁלֹשִׁים בָּאַמָּה יָסֹב אֹתוֹ סָבִיב׃
verses.english: He made the Sea-Basin, cast: ten by the cubit from its lip to its [other] lip, circular, all around,five cubits its height,and a line of thirty cubits could surround it, all around.

verses.hebrew: וּפְקָעִים מִתַּחַת לִשְׂפָתוֹ סָבִיב סֹבְבִים אֹתוֹ עֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה מַקִּפִים אֶת־הַיָּם סָבִיב שְׁנֵי טוּרִים הַפְּקָעִים יְצֻקִים בִּיצֻקָתוֹ׃
verses.english: And gourd-ornaments were beneath its lip, all around, surrounding it,ten in cubits, encompassing the Sea all around;two rows of gourd-ornaments were cast at its casting.

verses.hebrew: עֹמֵד עַל־שְׁנֵי עָשָׂר בָּקָר שְׁלֹשָׁה פֹנִים צָפוֹנָה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה פֹנִים יָמָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה פֹּנִים נֶגְבָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה פֹּנִים מִזְרָחָה וְהַיָּם עֲלֵיהֶם מִלְמָעְלָה וְכָל־אֲחֹרֵיהֶם בָּיְתָה׃
verses.english: [It was] standing on twelve oxen: three facing north, three facing seaward, three facing south, and three facing sunrise,with the Sea upon them, from above,and all of their hindquarters inward.

verses.hebrew: וְעָבְיוֹ טֶפַח וּשְׂפָתוֹ כְּמַעֲשֵׂה שְׂפַת־כּוֹס פֶּרַח שׁוֹשָׁן אַלְפַּיִם בַּת יָכִיל׃
verses.english: Its thickness was a handbreadth,with its lip like the pattern of the lip of a cup, a lily flower.Two thousand baht-measures-measures: A fluid measure equal perhaps to six gallons. Most translations use “baths,” to which English word this concept is unrelated. could it contain.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־הַמְּכֹנוֹת עֶשֶׂר נְחֹשֶׁת אַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה אֹרֶךְ הַמְּכוֹנָה הָאֶחָת וְאַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה רָחְבָּהּ וְשָׁלֹשׁ בָּאַמָּה קוֹמָתָהּ׃
verses.english: He made the stands, ten, of bronze,four by the cubit the length of each one stand,and four by the cubit its width,and three by the cubit its height.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶה מַעֲשֵׂה הַמְּכוֹנָה מִסְגְּרֹת לָהֶם וּמִסְגְּרֹת בֵּין הַשְׁלַבִּים׃
verses.english: And this was the pattern of the standwork:they had enclosures,and enclosures between the crosspieces—

verses.hebrew: וְעַל־הַמִּסְגְּרוֹת אֲשֶׁר בֵּין הַשְׁלַבִּים אֲרָיוֹת בָּקָר וּכְרוּבִים וְעַל־הַשְׁלַבִּים כֵּן מִמָּעַל וּמִתַּחַת לַאֲרָיוֹת וְלַבָּקָר לֹיוֹת מַעֲשֵׂה מוֹרָד׃
