verses.english: and on the enclosures that were between the crosspieceswere lions, oxen, and sphinxes,and on the crosspieces were thus;above and below the lions and the oxen were spirals of hammered making.

verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבָּעָה אוֹפַנֵּי נְחֹשֶׁת לַמְּכוֹנָה הָאַחַת וְסַרְנֵי נְחֹשֶׁת וְאַרְבָּעָה פַעֲמֹתָיו כְּתֵפֹת לָהֶם מִתַּחַת לַכִּיֹּר הַכְּתֵפֹת יְצֻקוֹת מֵעֵבֶר אִישׁ לֹיוֹת׃
verses.english: And four wheels of bronze were for each one stand, and axles of bronze,and its four legs had shoulder-pieces under the basin;the shoulder-pieces were cast across from each one in spirals.

verses.hebrew: וּפִיהוּ מִבֵּית לַכֹּתֶרֶת וָמַעְלָה בָּאַמָּה וּפִיהָ עָגֹל מַעֲשֵׂה־כֵן אַמָּה וַחֲצִי הָאַמָּה וְגַם־עַל־פִּיהָ מִקְלָעוֹת וּמִסְגְּרֹתֵיהֶם מְרֻבָּעוֹת לֹא עֲגֻלּוֹת׃
verses.english: And its mouth, within the capital, and above [it] for one cubit,its mouth was circular, in the pattern of a pedestal,a cubit and half a cubit,and even on the mouth there were carvings.Now their frames were square, not circular.

verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבַּעַת הָאוֹפַנִּים לְמִתַּחַת לַמִּסְגְּרוֹת וִידוֹת הָאוֹפַנִּים בַּמְּכוֹנָה וְקוֹמַת הָאוֹפַן הָאֶחָד אַמָּה וַחֲצִי הָאַמָּה׃
verses.english: And four wheels were beneath the enclosures;the supports of the wheels were in the stand, with the height of the one wheel a cubit and half a cubit.

verses.hebrew: וּמַעֲשֵׂה הָאוֹפַנִּים כְּמַעֲשֵׂה אוֹפַן הַמֶּרְכָּבָה יְדוֹתָם וְגַבֵּיהֶם וְחִשֻּׁקֵיהֶם וְחִשֻּׁרֵיהֶם הַכֹּל מוּצָק׃
verses.english: Now the pattern of the wheels was like the pattern of a chariot wheel,with their supports, their back-rims, their spokes, and their hubs— all were cast.

verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבַּע כְּתֵפוֹת אֶל אַרְבַּע פִּנּוֹת הַמְּכֹנָה הָאֶחָת מִן־הַמְּכֹנָה כְּתֵפֶיהָ׃
verses.english: And the four shoulder-pieces were at the four corners of each one stand,from the stand [itself came] its shoulder-pieces.

verses.hebrew: וּבְרֹאשׁ הַמְּכוֹנָה חֲצִי הָאַמָּה קוֹמָה עָגֹל סָבִיב וְעַל רֹאשׁ הַמְּכֹנָה יְדֹתֶיהָ וּמִסְגְּרֹתֶיהָ מִמֶּנָּה׃
verses.english: And at the top of the stand, half a cubit its height, was a circularband all around,and at the top of the stand, its handles and its enclosures [came] from itself.

verses.hebrew: וַיְפַתַּח עַל־הַלֻּחֹת יְדֹתֶיהָ וְעַל ומסגרתיה [מִסְגְּרֹתֶיהָ] כְּרוּבִים אֲרָיוֹת וְתִמֹרֹת כְּמַעַר־אִישׁ וְלֹיוֹת סָבִיב׃
verses.english: And he engraved on the panels, its handles, and on its enclosures:sphinxes, lions, and palmettes, according to the bare space on each, with spirals all around.

verses.hebrew: כָּזֹאת עָשָׂה אֵת עֶשֶׂר הַמְּכֹנוֹת מוּצָק אֶחָד מִדָּה אַחַת קֶצֶב אֶחָד לְכֻלָּהְנָה׃
verses.english: Like this he made the ten stands,with one casting, one measure, one shape for all of them.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ עֲשָׂרָה כִיֹּרוֹת נְחֹשֶׁת אַרְבָּעִים בַּת יָכִיל הַכִּיּוֹר הָאֶחָד אַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה הַכִּיּוֹר הָאֶחָד כִּיּוֹר אֶחָד עַל־הַמְּכוֹנָה הָאַחַת לְעֶשֶׂר הַמְּכֹנוֹת׃
verses.english: Then he made ten basins of bronze—forty baht-measures could each one basin contain;four by the cubit, for each one basin,one basin per one stand, for the ten stands.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־הַמְּכֹנוֹת חָמֵשׁ עַל־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת מִיָּמִין וְחָמֵשׁ עַל־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת מִשְּׂמֹאלוֹ וְאֶת־הַיָּם נָתַן מִכֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַיְמָנִית קֵדְמָה מִמּוּל נֶגֶב׃
verses.english: And he placed the stands: five at the right shoulder of the House, and five at its left shoulder,while the Sea he [had] placed on the House’s right shoulder, eastward, toward the south.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ חִירוֹם אֶת־הַכִּיֹּרוֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִים וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָקוֹת וַיְכַל חִירָם לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־כָּל־הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בֵּית יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And Hiram made the pots, the shovels, and the sprinkling-bowls.So Hiram finished making all the workthat he had made for King Shelomo for the House of YHWH:

verses.hebrew: עַמֻּדִים שְׁנַיִם וְגֻלֹּת הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר־עַל־רֹאשׁ הָעַמֻּדִים שְׁתָּיִם וְהַשְּׂבָכוֹת שְׁתַּיִם לְכַסּוֹת אֶת־שְׁתֵּי גֻּלֹּת הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים׃
verses.english: the columns, two,and the bowl-shapes of the capitals that were at the top of the two columns, two,the netting-pieces, two, for covering the two bowl-shapes of the columns that were at the top of the columns;

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הָרִמֹּנִים אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת לִשְׁתֵּי הַשְּׂבָכוֹת שְׁנֵי־טוּרִים רִמֹּנִים לַשְּׂבָכָה הָאֶחָת לְכַסּוֹת אֶת־שְׁתֵּי גֻּלֹּת הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי הָעַמּוּדִים׃
verses.english: the pomegranates, four hundred, for the two network-pieces,two rows of pomegranates for each one network, for covering the two bowl-shapes of the capitals that were on the top of the columns;

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַמְּכֹנוֹת עָשֶׂר וְאֶת־הַכִּיֹּרֹת עֲשָׂרָה עַל־הַמְּכֹנוֹת׃
verses.english: and the stands, ten,and the basins, ten, on the stands,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַיָּם הָאֶחָד וְאֶת־הַבָּקָר שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר תַּחַת הַיָּם׃
verses.english: and the one Sea,with the oxen, twelve, beneath the Sea;

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַסִּירוֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִים וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָקוֹת וְאֵת כָּל־הַכֵּלִים האהל [הָאֵלֶּה] אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה חִירָם לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בֵּית יְהוָה נְחֹשֶׁת מְמֹרָט׃
verses.english: and the pots, and the shovels, and the sprinkling-bowls—all these vessels that Hiram made for King Shelomo, for the House of YHWH,were of polished bronze.

verses.hebrew: בְּכִכַּר הַיַּרְדֵּן יְצָקָם הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּמַעֲבֵה הָאֲדָמָה בֵּין סֻכּוֹת וּבֵין צָרְתָן׃
verses.english: In the round-plain of the Jordan the king had cast them, in thick soil,between Sukkot and Tzaretan.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּנַּח שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־כָּל־הַכֵּלִים מֵרֹב מְאֹד מְאֹד לֹא נֶחְקַר מִשְׁקַל הַנְּחֹשֶׁת׃
verses.english: And Shelomo left all the vessels [unweighed], out of their exceeding, exceeding abundance;the weight of the bronze could not be ascertained.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹה אֵת כָּל־הַכֵּלִים אֲשֶׁר בֵּית יְהוָה אֵת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָן אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו לֶחֶם הַפָּנִים זָהָב׃
verses.english: And Shelomo made all the vessels that were for the House of YHWH:the golden sacrificial-altar,and the table on which was the Bread of the Presence, of gold,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַמְּנֹרוֹת חָמֵשׁ מִיָּמִין וְחָמֵשׁ מִשְּׂמֹאול לִפְנֵי הַדְּבִיר זָהָב סָגוּר וְהַפֶּרַח וְהַנֵּרֹת וְהַמֶּלְקַחַיִם זָהָב׃
verses.english: and the lampstands, with five to the right and five to the left,in front of the Rear-Chamber, of refined gold,and the flowerwork, the lamps, and the tongs, of gold,

verses.hebrew: וְהַסִּפּוֹת וְהַמְזַמְּרוֹת וְהַמִּזְרָקוֹת וְהַכַּפּוֹת וְהַמַּחְתּוֹת זָהָב סָגוּר וְהַפֹּתוֹת לְדַלְתוֹת הַבַּיִת הַפְּנִימִי לְקֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים לְדַלְתֵי הַבַּיִת לַהֵיכָל זָהָב׃
verses.english: and the bowls, the snuffers, the sprinkling-bowls, the ladles, and the incense-pans, of refined gold,and the hinge-pieces for the doors to the inner house, the Holiest Holy-Place,[and] for the doors of the House, for the Great-Hall, of gold.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּשְׁלַם כָּל־הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בֵּית יְהוָה וַיָּבֵא שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־קָדְשֵׁי דָּוִד אָבִיו אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־הַכֵּלִים נָתַן בְּאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And all the work that King Shelomo had made on the House of YHWH was completed), but sh-l-m again, as in 6:7. Cogan (2001) notes that “finished” seems to be used here to designate parts of the work, as in vv.9, 14, and 38 (and 7:1 and 40). ;Shelomo brought the holy-objects of David his father:the silver, the gold, and all the [other] vessels,and he put them in the treasuries of the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: אָז יַקְהֵל שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־כָּל־רָאשֵׁי הַמַּטּוֹת נְשִׂיאֵי הָאָבוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה יְרוּשָׁלִָם לְהַעֲלוֹת אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָה מֵעִיר דָּוִד הִיא צִיּוֹן׃
verses.english: Then Shelomo assembled the elders of Israel,all the heads of the tribes, the ancestral leaders of the Children of Israel, to King Shelomo in Jerusalem,to bring up the Coffer of YHWH’s Covenant from the City of David—that is Zion, the hill on which the Temple was built. What is today called Mount Zion is in fact located some distance southwest of the original Temple Mount..

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה כָּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיֶרַח הָאֵתָנִים בֶּחָג הוּא הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי׃
verses.english: And every man of Israel assembled to King Shelomo, in the month of Etanim/Ever-Flowing, at the Festival Festival” in the Bible.—that is the seventh month.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ כֹּל זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׂאוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־הָאָרוֹן׃
verses.english: And all the elders of Israel came,and the priests carried the Coffer;

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהוָה וְאֶת־אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת־כָּל־כְּלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר בָּאֹהֶל וַיַּעֲלוּ אֹתָם הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם׃
verses.english: they brought up the Coffer of YHWH along with the Tent of Appointment and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent;the priests and the Levites brought them up.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וְכָל־עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל הַנּוֹעָדִים עָלָיו אִתּוֹ לִפְנֵי הָאָרוֹן מְזַבְּחִים צֹאן וּבָקָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִסָּפְרוּ וְלֹא יִמָּנוּ מֵרֹב׃
verses.english: Meanwhile, King Shelomo and the entire community of Israel who were present with him before the Cofferwere offering-sacrifices of sheep and oxenwhich could not be numbered or measured in abundance.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבִאוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָה אֶל־מְקוֹמוֹ אֶל־דְּבִיר הַבַּיִת אֶל־קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֶל־תַּחַת כַּנְפֵי הַכְּרוּבִים׃
verses.english: And the priests brought the Coffer of YHWH’s Covenant to its place, to the Rear-Chamber of the House, to the Holiest Holy-Place,beneath the wings of the sphinxes.

verses.hebrew: כִּי הַכְּרוּבִים פֹּרְשִׂים כְּנָפַיִם אֶל־מְקוֹם הָאָרוֹן וַיָּסֹכּוּ הַכְּרֻבִים עַל־הָאָרוֹן וְעַל־בַּדָּיו מִלְמָעְלָה׃
verses.english: For the sphinxes were spreading [their] wings to the place of the Coffer,so that the sphinxes were sheltering the Coffer and its poles from above.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּאֲרִכוּ הַבַּדִּים וַיֵּרָאוּ רָאשֵׁי הַבַּדִּים מִן־הַקֹּדֶשׁ עַל־פְּנֵי הַדְּבִיר וְלֹא יֵרָאוּ הַחוּצָה וַיִּהְיוּ שָׁם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: And the poles were so long that the heads of the poles could be seen from the Holy-Place in front of the Rear-Chamber, but could not be seen outside;they have been there until this day.

verses.hebrew: אֵין בָּאָרוֹן רַק שְׁנֵי לֻחוֹת הָאֲבָנִים אֲשֶׁר הִנִּחַ שָׁם מֹשֶׁה בְּחֹרֵב אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת יְהוָה עִם־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּצֵאתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃
verses.english: There is nothing in the Coffersave the two stone tablets that Moshe had put there at Horev,when YHWH had cut [a covenant] with the Children of Israel, at their going out from the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּצֵאת הַכֹּהֲנִים מִן־הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְהֶעָנָן מָלֵא אֶת־בֵּית יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And it was, at the priests’ going out from the Holy-Place,that the cloud filled the House of YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־יָכְלוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים לַעֲמֹד לְשָׁרֵת מִפְּנֵי הֶעָנָן כִּי־מָלֵא כְבוֹד־יְהוָה אֶת־בֵּית יְהוָה׃
verses.english: and the priests were not able to stand to attend because of the cloud,for the Glory of YHWH had filled the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: אָז אָמַר שְׁלֹמֹה יְהוָה אָמַר לִשְׁכֹּן בָּעֲרָפֶל׃
verses.english: Then Shelomo said:YHWH has determined can encompass a wide range of concepts beyond speaking, including thinking and intending. to dwell in thick darkness.

verses.hebrew: בָּנֹה בָנִיתִי בֵּית זְבֻל לָךְ מָכוֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ עוֹלָמִים׃
verses.english: I have built, yes, built a lofty House for you,a fixed-place for your [royal] seat, for the ages.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּסֵּב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־פָּנָיו וַיְבָרֶךְ אֵת כָּל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכָל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹמֵד׃
verses.english: And the king turned his face and blessed the entire assembly of Israelwhile the entire assembly of Israel was standing;

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּפִיו אֵת דָּוִד אָבִי וּבְיָדוֹ מִלֵּא לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: he said:Blessed is YHWH, the God of Israel,who promised David my father with his own mouth,and with his own hand confirmed, saying:

verses.hebrew: מִן־הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶת־עַמִּי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרַיִם לֹא־בָחַרְתִּי בְעִיר מִכֹּל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לִהְיוֹת שְׁמִי שָׁם וָאֶבְחַר בְּדָוִד לִהְיוֹת עַל־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: From the day that I brought out my people Israel from Egypt,I have not chosen a city from all the tribes of Israel[in which] to build a House, to have my name be there.But I chose David to be over my people Israel,

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי עִם־לְבַב דָּוִד אָבִי לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לְשֵׁם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: and it was in the heart of David my father to build a House for the name of YHWH, the God of Israel,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־דָּוִד אָבִי יַעַן אֲשֶׁר הָיָה עִם־לְבָבְךָ לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לִשְׁמִי הֱטִיבֹתָ כִּי הָיָה עִם־לְבָבֶךָ׃
verses.english: so YHWH said to David my father:Because it was in your heart to build a House for my name,you have done well, for it was in your heart.

verses.hebrew: רַק אַתָּה לֹא תִבְנֶה הַבָּיִת כִּי אִם־בִּנְךָ הַיֹּצֵא מֵחֲלָצֶיךָ הוּא־יִבְנֶה הַבַּיִת לִשְׁמִי׃
verses.english: However: you shall not build the House,rather, your son, the one going out of your loins,he shall build the House for my name.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם יְהוָה אֶת־דְּבָרוֹ אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר וָאָקֻם תַּחַת דָּוִד אָבִי וָאֵשֵׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה וָאֶבְנֶה הַבַּיִת לְשֵׁם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And YHWH has fulfilled his word which he promised:I have arisen in the place of David my father,and have taken seat on the throne of Israel, as YHWH promised;I have built the House for the name of YHWH, the God of Israel,

verses.hebrew: וָאָשִׂם שָׁם מָקוֹם לָאָרוֹן אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם בְּרִית יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת עִם־אֲבֹתֵינוּ בְּהוֹצִיאוֹ אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃
verses.english: and I have put there a place for the Coffer, in which is YHWH’s covenantthat he cut with our fathers, when he brought them out from the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמֹד שְׁלֹמֹה לִפְנֵי מִזְבַּח יְהוָה נֶגֶד כָּל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּפְרֹשׂ כַּפָּיו הַשָּׁמָיִם׃
verses.english: Then Shelomo stood in front of the altar of YHWH, opposite the entire assembly of Israel,and he spread his palms heavenward

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵין־כָּמוֹךָ אֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל־הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת שֹׁמֵר הַבְּרִית וְהַחֶסֶד לַעֲבָדֶיךָ הַהֹלְכִים לְפָנֶיךָ בְּכָל־לִבָּם׃
verses.english: and said:O YHWH, God of Israel,there is none like you as a godin the heavens above or on the earth beneath,keeping the covenant, loyalty with your servants, those who walk in your presence with all their heart,

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַרְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ דָּוִד אָבִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּרְתָּ לוֹ וַתְּדַבֵּר בְּפִיךָ וּבְיָדְךָ מִלֵּאתָ כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: who has kept regarding your servant David my father what you promised him;you promised with your own mouth and with your own hand confirmed, as is this day.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁמֹר לְעַבְדְּךָ דָוִד אָבִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ לּוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא־יִכָּרֵת לְךָ אִישׁ מִלְּפָנַי יֹשֵׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל רַק אִם־יִשְׁמְרוּ בָנֶיךָ אֶת־דַּרְכָּם לָלֶכֶת לְפָנַי כַּאֲשֶׁר הָלַכְתָּ לְפָנָי׃
verses.english: So-now, YHWH God of Israel,keep for your servant David my father what you promised him, saying:There will never be a man cut off from you in my presence,sitting on the throne of Israel—if only your sons keep their way, walking in my presenceas you have walked in my presence!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יֵאָמֶן נָא דבריך [דְּבָרְךָ] אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ דָּוִד אָבִי׃
verses.english: So-now, O God of Israel,pray let your word be confirmed that you promised to your servant David my father.

verses.hebrew: כִּי הַאֻמְנָם יֵשֵׁב אֱלֹהִים עַל־הָאָרֶץ הִנֵּה הַשָּׁמַיִם וּשְׁמֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם לֹא יְכַלְכְּלוּךָ אַף כִּי־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בָּנִיתִי׃
verses.english: But will God really reside on earth?Here, the heavens and the heavenmost heavens cannot contain you,how much less this House that I have built!

verses.hebrew: וּפָנִיתָ אֶל־תְּפִלַּת עַבְדְּךָ וְאֶל־תְּחִנָּתוֹ יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶל־הָרִנָּה וְאֶל־הַתְּפִלָּה אֲשֶׁר עַבְדְּךָ מִתְפַּלֵּל לְפָנֶיךָ הַיּוֹם׃
verses.english: Yet turn your face to the prayer of your servant, and to his plea, O YHWH my God,to hearken to the cry-of-praise and to the prayer that your servant is praying in your presence today,

verses.hebrew: לִהְיוֹת עֵינֶךָ פְתֻחוֹת אֶל־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה לַיְלָה וָיוֹם אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתָּ יִהְיֶה שְׁמִי שָׁם לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶל־הַתְּפִלָּה אֲשֶׁר יִתְפַּלֵּל עַבְדְּךָ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: that your eyes may be open toward this House, night and day,toward the place about which you said: My name will be there,to hearken to the prayer that your servant will pray toward this place.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ אֶל־תְּחִנַּת עַבְדְּךָ וְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יִתְפַּלְלוּ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע אֶל־מְקוֹם שִׁבְתְּךָ אֶל־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְשָׁמַעְתָּ וְסָלָחְתָּ׃
verses.english: And when you hear the plea of your servant and of your people Israelthat they will pray toward this place—then may you hearken at the place of your [royal] seat in the heavens;may you hearken and may you forgive!

verses.hebrew: אֵת אֲשֶׁר יֶחֱטָא אִישׁ לְרֵעֵהוּ וְנָשָׁא־בוֹ אָלָה לְהַאֲלֹתוֹ וּבָא אָלָה לִפְנֵי מִזְבַּחֲךָ בַּבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: Should a person sin against his neighborand he lifts up an oath-curse upon him, to put him under a curse,and he comes with the oath-curse before your altar, in this House—

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם וְעָשִׂיתָ וְשָׁפַטְתָּ אֶת־עֲבָדֶיךָ לְהַרְשִׁיעַ רָשָׁע לָתֵת דַּרְכּוֹ בְּרֹאשׁוֹ וּלְהַצְדִּיק צַדִּיק לָתֶת לוֹ כְּצִדְקָתוֹ׃
verses.english: then may you hearken in the heavensand may you act and judge your servants,to bring punishment on the guilty, by putting his way on his head,and to vindicate the innocent, by giving him according to his innocence.

verses.hebrew: בְּהִנָּגֵף עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי אוֹיֵב אֲשֶׁר יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָךְ וְשָׁבוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְהוֹדוּ אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ וְהִתְפַּלְלוּ וְהִתְחַנְּנוּ אֵלֶיךָ בַּבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: When your people Israel is defeated before an enemy, becausethey have sinned against you,and then they return to you and praise your name,and they pray and plead to you in this House,

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם וְסָלַחְתָּ לְחַטַּאת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָם אֶל־הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּ לַאֲבוֹתָם׃
verses.english: then may you hearken in the heavensand may you forgive the sin of your people Israel,and return them to the soil that you gave to their fathers.

verses.hebrew: בְּהֵעָצֵר שָׁמַיִם וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה מָטָר כִּי יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָךְ וְהִתְפַּלְלוּ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְהוֹדוּ אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ וּמֵחַטָּאתָם יְשׁוּבוּן כִּי תַעֲנֵם׃
verses.english: When the heavens are held back, and there is no early-rain,because they have sinned against you,and they pray toward this place, and praise your name,and from their sin they turn, since you afflicted them—

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם וְסָלַחְתָּ לְחַטַּאת עֲבָדֶיךָ וְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי תוֹרֵם אֶת־הַדֶּרֶךְ הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר יֵלְכוּ־בָהּ וְנָתַתָּה מָטָר עַל־אַרְצְךָ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַתָּה לְעַמְּךָ לְנַחֲלָה׃
verses.english: then may you hearken in the heavens,and may you forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel,so that you instruct them the good way in which they should walk,and may you give rain upon your land which you gave to your people as heriditary-property.

verses.hebrew: רָעָב כִּי־יִהְיֶה בָאָרֶץ דֶּבֶר כִּי־יִהְיֶה שִׁדָּפוֹן יֵרָקוֹן אַרְבֶּה חָסִיל כִּי יִהְיֶה כִּי יָצַר־לוֹ אֹיְבוֹ בְּאֶרֶץ שְׁעָרָיו כָּל־נֶגַע כָּל־מַחֲלָה׃
verses.english: A famine—if it should come upon the land;pestilence—if it should come;blight, green-mildew, ravaging locust, grasshopper—if it should come;if his enemy should put him in straits in one of his gates;whatever the affliction, whatever the sickness:

verses.hebrew: כָּל־תְּפִלָּה כָל־תְּחִנָּה אֲשֶׁר תִהְיֶה לְכָל־הָאָדָם לְכֹל עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יֵדְעוּן אִישׁ נֶגַע לְבָבוֹ וּפָרַשׂ כַּפָּיו אֶל־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: [for] any prayer, any plea that any person might have among any of your people Israelwho knows the affliction in his heart, and spreads his palms toward this House—

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם מְכוֹן שִׁבְתֶּךָ וְסָלַחְתָּ וְעָשִׂיתָ וְנָתַתָּ לָאִישׁ כְּכָל־דְּרָכָיו אֲשֶׁר תֵּדַע אֶת־לְבָבוֹ כִּי־אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ לְבַדְּךָ אֶת־לְבַב כָּל־בְּנֵי הָאָדָם׃
verses.english: then may you hearken in the heavens, the fixed-place of your [royal] seat;may you forgive and act, giving to each according to all his ways,[seeing] that you know his heart,for you yourself know the heart of every human being,

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן יִרָאוּךָ כָּל־הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר־הֵם חַיִּים עַל־פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּה לַאֲבֹתֵינוּ׃
verses.english: in order that they may hold you in awe all the days that they live on the face of the ground that you have given to our fathers.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֶל־הַנָּכְרִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מֵעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא וּבָא מֵאֶרֶץ רְחוֹקָה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ׃
verses.english: And also to the foreigner, who is not from your people Israel,but comes from a land far off for the sake of your name,

verses.hebrew: כִּי יִשְׁמְעוּן אֶת־שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְאֶת־יָדְךָ הַחֲזָקָה וּזְרֹעֲךָ הַנְּטוּיָה וּבָא וְהִתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: for he hears of your great nameand your strong hand and your outstretched arm,and comes and prays toward this House—

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם מְכוֹן שִׁבְתֶּךָ וְעָשִׂיתָ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָא אֵלֶיךָ הַנָּכְרִי לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּן כָּל־עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ לְיִרְאָה אֹתְךָ כְּעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלָדַעַת כִּי־שִׁמְךָ נִקְרָא עַל־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בָּנִיתִי׃
verses.english: may you hearken hearken: Some manuscripts and Chronicles read, as in earlier paragraphs, “Then may you hearken…” in the heavens, the fixed-place of your [royal] seat,and may you act,in accordance with all that the foreigner calls out to you,in order that all the peoples of the earth may know your name,holding you in awe as your people Israel [does],and acknowledging that your name is called over this House that I have built.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־יֵצֵא עַמְּךָ לַמִּלְחָמָה עַל־אֹיְבוֹ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁלָחֵם וְהִתְפַּלְלוּ אֶל־יְהוָה דֶּרֶךְ הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתָּ בָּהּ וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר־בָּנִתִי לִשְׁמֶךָ׃
verses.english: When your people goes out to battle against its enemy, on the road that you send them,and they pray to YHWH, toward, the same word as “the road” in the previous phrase. the city that you have chosenand the House that I have built for your name—

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ הַשָּׁמַיִם אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָם וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּתָם וְעָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטָם׃
verses.english: then may you hearken in the heavens to their prayer and to their plea,and may you act justly toward them.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָךְ כִּי אֵין אָדָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יֶחֱטָא וְאָנַפְתָּ בָם וּנְתַתָּם לִפְנֵי אוֹיֵב וְשָׁבוּם שֹׁבֵיהֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ הָאוֹיֵב רְחוֹקָה אוֹ קְרוֹבָה׃
verses.english: When they sin against you—for there is no human being who does not sin—and you rage against them, and give them before the enemy,and they lead them captive, their captors, to the land of their enemy, far or near,

verses.hebrew: וְהֵשִׁיבוּ אֶל־לִבָּם בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבּוּ־שָׁם וְשָׁבוּ וְהִתְחַנְּנוּ אֵלֶיךָ בְּאֶרֶץ שֹׁבֵיהֶם לֵאמֹר חָטָאנוּ וְהֶעֱוִינוּ רָשָׁעְנוּ׃
verses.english: but then they turn their heart, “turn/return” and shavoh, “take-captive, deport.” in the land to which they were led captive,and return and plead to you in the land of their captivity, saying:We have sinned and we have done perversely, we have done wickedly!,

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁבוּ אֵלֶיךָ בְּכָל־לְבָבָם וּבְכָל־נַפְשָׁם בְּאֶרֶץ אֹיְבֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר־שָׁבוּ אֹתָם וְהִתְפַּלְלוּ אֵלֶיךָ דֶּרֶךְ אַרְצָם אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּה לַאֲבוֹתָם הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתָּ וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר־בנית [בָּנִיתִי] לִשְׁמֶךָ׃
verses.english: and they return to you with all their heart and with all their being, in the land of their enemies who led them captive,and they pray to you toward their land that you gave their fathers,the city that you chose and the House that I have built to your name—

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ הַשָּׁמַיִם מְכוֹן שִׁבְתְּךָ אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָם וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּתָם וְעָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטָם׃
verses.english: then may you hearken in the heavens, the fixed-place of your [royal] seat,to their prayer and to their plea;may you act justly toward them

verses.hebrew: וְסָלַחְתָּ לְעַמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר חָטְאוּ־לָךְ וּלְכָל־פִּשְׁעֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר פָּשְׁעוּ־בָךְ וּנְתַתָּם לְרַחֲמִים לִפְנֵי שֹׁבֵיהֶם וְרִחֲמוּם׃
verses.english: and forgive your people who have sinned against youfor all the rebellious acts through which they have rebelled against you,and grant them compassion before their captors, that they may have compassion on them.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־עַמְּךָ וְנַחֲלָתְךָ הֵם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתָ מִמִּצְרַיִם מִתּוֹךְ כּוּר הַבַּרְזֶל׃
verses.english: For they are your people and your inheritance, whom you brought out from Egypt, from amid the iron furnace,

verses.hebrew: לִהְיוֹת עֵינֶיךָ פְתֻחוֹת אֶל־תְּחִנַּת עַבְדְּךָ וְאֶל־תְּחִנַּת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל לִשְׁמֹעַ אֲלֵיהֶם בְּכֹל קָרְאָם אֵלֶיךָ׃
verses.english: so that your eyes may be open to the plea of your servant, and to the plea of your people Israel,to hearken to them whenever they call out to you.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה הִבְדַּלְתָּם לְךָ לְנַחֲלָה מִכֹּל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ בְּהוֹצִיאֲךָ אֶת־אֲבֹתֵינוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃
verses.english: For you have set them apart for yourself as an inheritancefrom all the peoples of the earth,as you promised by the hand of Moshe your servant, when you brought out our fathers from Egypt, O YHWH God!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת שְׁלֹמֹה לְהִתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־יְהוָה אֵת כָּל־הַתְּפִלָּה וְהַתְּחִנָּה הַזֹּאת קָם מִלִּפְנֵי מִזְבַּח יְהוָה מִכְּרֹעַ עַל־בִּרְכָּיו וְכַפָּיו פְּרֻשׂוֹת הַשָּׁמָיִם׃
verses.english: Now it was, when Shelomo had finished praying to YHWH all this prayer and plea,that he arose from in front of the altar of YHWH, from bending down on his knees, with his palms spread toward the heavens,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעְמֹד וַיְבָרֶךְ אֵת כָּל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל קוֹל גָּדוֹל לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: and he stoodand he blessedthe entire assembly of Israel in a loud voice, saying:

verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן מְנוּחָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר לֹא־נָפַל דָּבָר אֶחָד מִכֹּל דְּבָרוֹ הַטּוֹב אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: Blessed is YHWH,who has given rest to his people Israel, exactly as he promised;not one thing has failed of all his good words which he promised by the hand of Moshe his servant!

verses.hebrew: יְהִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ עִמָּנוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיָה עִם־אֲבֹתֵינוּ אַל־יַעַזְבֵנוּ וְאַל־יִטְּשֵׁנוּ׃
verses.english: May YHWH our God be with usas he was with our fathers—may he not abandon us, may he not leave us!—

verses.hebrew: לְהַטּוֹת לְבָבֵנוּ אֵלָיו לָלֶכֶת בְּכָל־דְּרָכָיו וְלִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקָּיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶת־אֲבֹתֵינוּ׃
verses.english: inclining our heart toward himto walk in all his ways and to keep all his commandments, his laws, and his judgmentswhich he commanded our fathers.

verses.hebrew: וְיִהְיוּ דְבָרַי אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר הִתְחַנַּנְתִּי לִפְנֵי יְהוָה קְרֹבִים אֶל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפַּט עַבְדּוֹ וּמִשְׁפַּט עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל דְּבַר־יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: And may these words of mine which I have pleaded in the presence of YHWHbe near to YHWH our God, day and night,to render justice [for] his servant and justice [for] his people Israel,each day’s need in its day,

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן דַּעַת כָּל־עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כִּי יְהוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים אֵין עוֹד׃
verses.english: in order for all the peoples of the earth to knowthat YHWH, he is God, there is none else!

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה לְבַבְכֶם שָׁלֵם עִם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לָלֶכֶת בְּחֻקָּיו וְלִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: And may your heart be complete with YHWH our God,to walk in his laws and to keep his commandments, as is this day!

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ זֹבְחִים זֶבַח לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Now the king and all Israel with him were sacrificing sacrifices in the presence of YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְבַּח שְׁלֹמֹה אֵת זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר זָבַח לַיהוָה בָּקָר עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁנַיִם אֶלֶף וְצֹאן מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים אָלֶף וַיַּחְנְכוּ אֶת־בֵּית יְהוָה הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכָל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: and Shelomo sacrificed as the sacrifice of shalom that he sacrificed to YHWHtwelve thousand oxen and a hundred twenty thousand sheep;thus they inaugurated the House of YHWH,the king and all the Children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא קִדַּשׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־תּוֹךְ הֶחָצֵר אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי בֵית־יְהוָה כִּי־עָשָׂה שָׁם אֶת־הָעֹלָה וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וְאֵת חֶלְבֵי הַשְּׁלָמִים כִּי־מִזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהוָה קָטֹן מֵהָכִיל אֶת־הָעֹלָה וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וְאֵת חֶלְבֵי הַשְּׁלָמִים׃
verses.english: On that daythe king hallowed the middle of the courtyard that was in front of the House of YHWH,for he performed there the offerings-up and the grain-giftsand the fat parts of the shalom-offerings,since the bronze altar that was in the presence of YHWH was too small for containing the offerings-up, the grain-gifts, and the fat parts of the shalom-offerings.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹה בָעֵת־הַהִיא אֶת־הֶחָג וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ קָהָל גָּדוֹל מִלְּבוֹא חֲמָת עַד־נַחַל מִצְרַיִם לִפְנֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְשִׁבְעַת יָמִים אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם׃
verses.english: So Shelomo observed the Festival at that time, and all Israel with him, a great assemblage,[coming] from Levo-Hamat to the Wadi of Egypt,in the presence of YHWH our God, for seven days and seven days [more],fourteen days.

verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי שִׁלַּח אֶת־הָעָם וַיְבָרֲכוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֵּלְכוּ לְאָהֳלֵיהֶם שְׂמֵחִים וְטוֹבֵי לֵב עַל כָּל־הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהוָה לְדָוִד עַבְדּוֹ וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַמּוֹ׃
verses.english: On the eighth day he sent the people off,and they gave the king farewell-blessing and went back to their tents,rejoicing and [feeling] good at heartover all the good things that YHWH had done for David his servant and for Israel his people.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת שְׁלֹמֹה לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּית־יְהוָה וְאֶת־בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֵת כָּל־חֵשֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹה אֲשֶׁר חָפֵץ לַעֲשׂוֹת׃
verses.english: Now it was, when Shelomo had finished building the House of YHWH, and the House of the King,and every desire of Shelomo that he wished to do,

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא יְהוָה אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה שֵׁנִית כַּאֲשֶׁר נִרְאָה אֵלָיו בְּגִבְעוֹן׃
verses.english: that YHWH appeared to Shelomo a second time, [just] as he had appeared to him at Giv’on.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלָיו שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת־תְּפִלָּתְךָ וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּתְךָ אֲשֶׁר הִתְחַנַּנְתָּה לְפָנַי הִקְדַּשְׁתִּי אֶת־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בָּנִתָה לָשׂוּם־שְׁמִי שָׁם עַד־עוֹלָם וְהָיוּ עֵינַי וְלִבִּי שָׁם כָּל־הַיָּמִים׃
verses.english: And YHWH said to him:I have hearkened to your prayer and to your plea which you have pleaded before me—I have hallowed this House that you have built in which to set my name there throughout the ages;my eyes and my heart will be there all the days [to come].

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה אִם־תֵּלֵךְ לְפָנַי כַּאֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ דָּוִד אָבִיךָ בְּתָם־לֵבָב וּבְיֹשֶׁר לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִיךָ חֻקַּי וּמִשְׁפָּטַי תִּשְׁמֹר׃
verses.english: As for you, if you walk before meas David your father walked—in wholeness of heart and in uprightness,doing exactly what I commanded you,and if my laws and my judgments you will keep,

verses.hebrew: וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת־כִּסֵּא מַמְלַכְתְּךָ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְעֹלָם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי עַל־דָּוִד אָבִיךָ לֵאמֹר לֹא־יִכָּרֵת לְךָ אִישׁ מֵעַל כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: I will establish your kingly throne Israel for the ages,as I promised regarding David your father, saying:No one will be cut off from you on the throne of Israel!

verses.hebrew: אִם־שׁוֹב תְּשֻׁבוּן אַתֶּם וּבְנֵיכֶם מֵאַחֲרַי וְלֹא תִשְׁמְרוּ מִצְוֺתַי חֻקֹּתַי אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לִפְנֵיכֶם וַהֲלַכְתֶּם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם לָהֶם׃
verses.english: [But] if you should turn, yes, turn, you and your children, from [following] after meand do not keep my commandments and my laws that I have placed before you,but go and serve other gods and bow down to them,

verses.hebrew: וְהִכְרַתִּי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָהֶם וְאֶת־הַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר הִקְדַּשְׁתִּי לִשְׁמִי אֲשַׁלַּח מֵעַל פָּנָי וְהָיָה יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמָשָׁל וְלִשְׁנִינָה בְּכָל־הָעַמִּים׃
verses.english: I will cut off Israel from the face of the ground that I have given them,while the House that I have hallowed to my nameI will send away from my presence,and Israel will become a proverb and a reproach, from a verb denoting “sharp.” among all peoples.

verses.hebrew: וְהַבַּיִת הַזֶּה יִהְיֶה עֶלְיוֹן כָּל־עֹבֵר עָלָיו יִשֹּׁם וְשָׁרָק וְאָמְרוּ עַל־מֶה עָשָׂה יְהוָה כָּכָה לָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וְלַבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: And this House will become a ruin, “exalted,” undoubtedly, even though it makes little sense, to substitute a euphemism for what versions rightly read as le-’iyyin. ;all who cross by it will be appalled and will whistle, and they will say:Why did YHWH do thus to this land and to this House?

verses.hebrew: וְאָמְרוּ עַל אֲשֶׁר עָזְבוּ אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצִיא אֶת־אֲבֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיַּחֲזִקוּ בֵּאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וישתחו [וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ] לָהֶם וַיַּעַבְדֻם עַל־כֵּן הֵבִיא יְהוָה עֲלֵיהֶם אֵת כָּל־הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת׃
verses.english: And they will say:Because they abandoned YHWH their God, who brought their fathers out from the land of Egypt;they held fast to other gods, they bowed down to them and served them—therefore has YHWH brought all this evil upon them!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקְצֵה עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה אֲשֶׁר־בָּנָה שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־שְׁנֵי הַבָּתִּים אֶת־בֵּית יְהוָה וְאֶת־בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: Now it was at the end of twenty years during which Shelomo built the two houses,the House of YHWH and the House of the King,

verses.hebrew: חִירָם מֶלֶךְ־צֹר נִשָּׂא אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה בַּעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים וּבַעֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים וּבַזָּהָב לְכָל־חֶפְצוֹ אָז יִתֵּן הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לְחִירָם עֶשְׂרִים עִיר בְּאֶרֶץ הַגָּלִיל׃
verses.english: —Hiram king of Tyre had supplied Shelomo with trees of cedar and trees of juniper, and gold, as much as he desired—[that] then King Shelomo gave Hiram twenty towns in the region of the Galilee;

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא חִירָם מִצֹּר לִרְאוֹת אֶת־הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר נָתַן־לוֹ שְׁלֹמֹה וְלֹא יָשְׁרוּ בְּעֵינָיו׃
verses.english: but when Hiram went out from Tyre, to see the towns that Shelomo had given him,they were not right in his eyes.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נָתַתָּה לִּי אָחִי וַיִּקְרָא לָהֶם אֶרֶץ כָּבוּל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: He said:What are these towns that you have given me, brother?So they called them the Region of Cavul/ As Nothing, until this day.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם לַמֶּלֶךְ מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים כִּכַּר זָהָב׃
verses.english: And Hiram sent the king a hundred and twenty talents, a “round thing,” the heaviest unit of weight in the Bible. of gold.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶה דְבַר־הַמַּס אֲשֶׁר־הֶעֱלָה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּית יְהוָה וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ וְאֶת־הַמִּלּוֹא וְאֵת חוֹמַת יְרוּשָׁלִָם וְאֶת־חָצֹר וְאֶת־מְגִדּוֹ וְאֶת־גָּזֶר׃
verses.english: Now this was the matter of the forced-labor that King Shelomo raisedfor building the House of YHWH, his own House, the Earthfill, the wall of Jerusalem,and Hatzor trad. English “Hazor,” a city north of the Sea of Galilee, on two major trade routes. Its ruins have recently been the site of considerable archaeological activity. and Megiddo Situated at a pass which gives access to major movements of traders and troops from eastern empires down through the Coastal Plain, this was the site of crucial battles throughout antiquity. Its name of the “Hill of Megiddo,” Har Megiddo, has entered the English language as ‘Armageddon”—the Final Battle mentioned in the New Testament (Rev. 16:16) and a general catchword for the end of the world. and Gezer In the foothills west of Jerusalem, not far from modern Ramleh, it controlled yet another route of access: to the Coastal Plain from Jerusalem and the highlands. Thus the three cities mentioned in this verse were of signal strategic importance, and all three have left evidence of almost identical massive buildings, containing chambered gates with casemate walls. Many archaeologists connect these with the period of Shelomo (tenth century B.C.E.), although some date them later.:

verses.hebrew: פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם עָלָה וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־גֶּזֶר וַיִּשְׂרְפָהּ בָּאֵשׁ וְאֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּעִיר הָרָג וַיִּתְּנָהּ שִׁלֻּחִים לְבִתּוֹ אֵשֶׁת שְׁלֹמֹה׃
verses.english: —Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone upand had taken Gezer and burned it with fire,while the Canaanites who were settled in the city he had killed,and he had given it as a sendoff-gift to his daughter, Shelomo’s wife—

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־גָּזֶר וְאֶת־בֵּית חֹרֹן תַּחְתּוֹן׃
verses.english: Shelomo built Gezer and Lower Bet-Horon,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־בַּעֲלָת וְאֶת־תמר [תַּדְמֹר] בַּמִּדְבָּר בָּאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Baalat and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land [of Judah],

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כָּל־עָרֵי הַמִּסְכְּנוֹת אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לִשְׁלֹמֹה וְאֵת עָרֵי הָרֶכֶב וְאֵת עָרֵי הַפָּרָשִׁים וְאֵת חֵשֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹה אֲשֶׁר חָשַׁק לִבְנוֹת בִּירוּשָׁלִַם וּבַלְּבָנוֹן וּבְכֹל אֶרֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּוֹ׃
verses.english: and all the storage towns that belonged to Shelomo and the chariot towns and the steeds’ towns,and the desirable things that Shelomo desired to build in Jerusalem and in the Levanon,and throughout all the land of his rule.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־הָעָם הַנּוֹתָר מִן־הָאֱמֹרִי הַחִתִּי הַפְּרִזִּי הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵמָּה׃
verses.english: All the people left from the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites,the Hivvites, and the Yevusites,who were not of the Children of Israel,

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר נֹתְרוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָכְלוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַחֲרִימָם וַיַּעֲלֵם שְׁלֹמֹה לְמַס־עֹבֵד עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: their children who were left after them in the land,whom the Children of Israel were not able to devote-to-destruction—Shelomo raised them up for slave, elsewhere rendered “servant” or “serf.” labor, until this day.

verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־נָתַן שְׁלֹמֹה עָבֶד כִּי־הֵם אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה וַעֲבָדָיו וְשָׂרָיו וְשָׁלִשָׁיו וְשָׂרֵי רִכְבּוֹ וּפָרָשָׁיו׃
verses.english: But from the Children of Israel Shelomo did not make a slave,for they were the men of battle, namely, his servants, his commanders, his officers, his chariot commanders, and his steed-riders.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה שָׂרֵי הַנִּצָּבִים אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַמְּלָאכָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה חֲמִשִּׁים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת הָרֹדִים בָּעָם הָעֹשִׂים בַּמְּלָאכָה׃
verses.english: [And] these were the prefect commanders, Those Over Shelomo’s Work:fifty and five hundred,who were supervising the people who were doing the work.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ בַּת־פַּרְעֹה עָלְתָה מֵעִיר דָּוִד אֶל־בֵּיתָהּ אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה־לָהּ אָז בָּנָה אֶת־הַמִּלּוֹא׃
verses.english: Nevertheless, Pharaoh’s daughter went up from the City of David to her house which he had built for her;then he built the Earthfill.

verses.hebrew: וְהֶעֱלָה שְׁלֹמֹה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה עֹלוֹת וּשְׁלָמִים עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה לַיהוָה וְהַקְטֵיר אִתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וְשִׁלַּם אֶת־הַבָּיִת׃
verses.english: Now Shelomo would offer up, three times a year, offerings-up and shalom-offeringson the altar that he had built to YHWH,and would send up smoke with it, on the one in the presence of YHWH;thus he kept the House [in] complete [repair] also puns with “shalom-offerings” (shelamim) and “Shelomo” (Walsh)..

verses.hebrew: וָאֳנִי עָשָׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בְּעֶצְיוֹן־גֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר אֶת־אֵלוֹת עַל־שְׂפַת יַם־סוּף בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם׃
verses.english: Now Shelomo made a fleet-of-ships at Etzyon-Gever that is by Elat, next to the Reed Sea for suf). in the land of Edom.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם בָּאֳנִי אֶת־עֲבָדָיו אַנְשֵׁי אֳנִיּוֹת יֹדְעֵי הַיָּם עִם עַבְדֵי שְׁלֹמֹה׃
verses.english: And Hiram sent by ship his servants, the men for ships, those knowing the sea,along with the servants of Shelomo.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אוֹפִירָה וַיִּקְחוּ מִשָּׁם זָהָב אַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת וְעֶשְׂרִים כִּכָּר וַיָּבִאוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה׃
verses.english: They came to Ofir and took away gold from there, four hundred and twenty talents,and they brought it to King Shelomo.

verses.hebrew: וּמַלְכַּת־שְׁבָא שֹׁמַעַת אֶת־שֵׁמַע שְׁלֹמֹה לְשֵׁם יְהוָה וַתָּבֹא לְנַסֹּתוֹ בְּחִידוֹת׃
verses.english: Now the Queen of Sheba had been hearing the reports of Shelomo, I was tempted to use “shining-reports” in the translation, for that reason. for the fame of YHWH,and so she came to test him with riddles.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא יְרוּשָׁלְַמָה בְּחַיִל כָּבֵד מְאֹד גְּמַלִּים נֹשְׂאִים בְּשָׂמִים וְזָהָב רַב־מְאֹד וְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה וַתָּבֹא אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלָיו אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר הָיָה עִם־לְבָבָהּ׃
verses.english: She came to Jerusalem with an exceedingly heavy array:camels carrying spices and gold, in exceeding abundance, and precious stones.She came to Shelomo and spoke to him all that was on her mind,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֶּד־לָהּ שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־כָּל־דְּבָרֶיהָ לֹא־הָיָה דָּבָר נֶעְלָם מִן־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר לֹא הִגִּיד לָהּ׃
verses.english: and Shelomo told her [the answer to] all her words;there was no matter so hidden from the king that he could not tell her.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא מַלְכַּת־שְׁבָא אֵת כָּל־חָכְמַת שְׁלֹמֹה וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה׃
verses.english: And the Queen of Sheba saw all Shelomo’s wisdom,and the House that he had built,

verses.hebrew: וּמַאֲכַל שֻׁלְחָנוֹ וּמוֹשַׁב עֲבָדָיו וּמַעֲמַד משרתו [מְשָׁרְתָיו] וּמַלְבֻּשֵׁיהֶם וּמַשְׁקָיו וְעֹלָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲלֶה בֵּית יְהוָה וְלֹא־הָיָה בָהּ עוֹד רוּחַ׃
verses.english: and the food at his table, the seating of his court-servants, his attendants’ standing and their attire, and his cupbearers,and his offering[s]-up that he would offer up in the House of YHWH,and she was left breathless.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֱמֶת הָיָה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתִּי בְּאַרְצִי עַל־דְּבָרֶיךָ וְעַל־חָכְמָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: She said to the king:True was the word that I heard in my land about your way-with-words, about your wisdom!

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־הֶאֱמַנְתִּי לַדְּבָרִים עַד אֲשֶׁר־בָּאתִי וַתִּרְאֶינָה עֵינַי וְהִנֵּה לֹא־הֻגַּד־לִי הַחֵצִי הוֹסַפְתָּ חָכְמָה וָטוֹב אֶל־הַשְּׁמוּעָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁמָעְתִּי׃
verses.english: Now I did not believe the words until I came [here] and my own eyes saw it,but here: I had not been told the half [of it]:you have more wisdom and bounty than the report that I had heard!

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי אֲנָשֶׁיךָ אַשְׁרֵי עֲבָדֶיךָ אֵלֶּה הָעֹמְדִים לְפָנֶיךָ תָּמִיד הַשֹּׁמְעִים אֶת־חָכְמָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: O the happiness of your men, O the happiness of these your servants who stand [in attendance] before you regularly,who hear your wisdom!

verses.hebrew: יְהִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בָּרוּךְ אֲשֶׁר חָפֵץ בְּךָ לְתִתְּךָ עַל־כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאַהֲבַת יְהוָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְעֹלָם וַיְשִׂימְךָ לְמֶלֶךְ לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה׃
verses.english: May YHWH your God be blessed,who has taken pleasure in you,to place you on the throne of Israel.Because of YHWH’s love for Israel, for the ages,he has made you king, to render justice and equity!

verses.hebrew: וַתִּתֵּן לַמֶּלֶךְ מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים כִּכַּר זָהָב וּבְשָׂמִים הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד וְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה לֹא־בָא כַבֹּשֶׂם הַהוּא עוֹד לָרֹב אֲשֶׁר־נָתְנָה מַלְכַּת־שְׁבָא לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה׃
verses.english: And she gave the king a hundred and twenty talents of goldand an exceeding abundance of spices, and precious stones;such spices never came again in abundancethat the Queen of Sheba gave King Shelomo.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֳנִי חִירָם אֲשֶׁר־נָשָׂא זָהָב מֵאוֹפִיר הֵבִיא מֵאֹפִיר עֲצֵי אַלְמֻגִּים הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד וְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה׃
verses.english: And also Hiram’s ships, which carried gold from Ofir,brought almug wood wood: The identification is not certain; some surmise red sandalwood. from Ofir, exceedingly much, and precious stones.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־עֲצֵי הָאַלְמֻגִּים מִסְעָד לְבֵית־יְהוָה וּלְבֵית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכִנֹּרוֹת וּנְבָלִים לַשָּׁרִים לֹא בָא־כֵן עֲצֵי אַלְמֻגִּים וְלֹא נִרְאָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: And the king made from the almug wood railings for the House of YHWH and for the House of the King,and lyres and harps for the singers;no such almug wood had come [before],and none has been seen until this day.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה נָתַן לְמַלְכַּת־שְׁבָא אֶת־כָּל־חֶפְצָהּ אֲשֶׁר שָׁאָלָה מִלְּבַד אֲשֶׁר נָתַן־לָהּ כְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַתֵּפֶן וַתֵּלֶךְ לְאַרְצָהּ הִיא וַעֲבָדֶיהָ׃
verses.english: Now King Shelomo gave the Queen of Sheba whatever she wished, that she had requested,aside from what had been given her according to the capacity of King Shelomo.Then she faced about and went back to her land, she and her servants.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִשְׁקַל הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר־בָּא לִשְׁלֹמֹה בְּשָׁנָה אֶחָת שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת שִׁשִּׁים וָשֵׁשׁ כִּכַּר זָהָב׃
verses.english: Now the weight of gold that came to Shelomo in a single yearwas six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

verses.hebrew: לְבַד מֵאַנְשֵׁי הַתָּרִים וּמִסְחַר הָרֹכְלִים וְכָל־מַלְכֵי הָעֶרֶב וּפַחוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: besides [what came] from the tradesmen and from the commerce of the merchantsand all the kings of Arabia and governors of the land.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מָאתַיִם צִנָּה זָהָב שָׁחוּט שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת זָהָב יַעֲלֶה עַל־הַצִּנָּה הָאֶחָת׃
verses.english: And King Shelomo made two hundred [large] shields of hammered gold,—six hundred gold pieces would go for each one shield—

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת מָגִנִּים זָהָב שָׁחוּט שְׁלֹשֶׁת מָנִים זָהָב יַעֲלֶה עַל־הַמָּגֵן הָאֶחָת וַיִּתְּנֵם הַמֶּלֶךְ בֵּית יַעַר הַלְּבָנוֹן׃
verses.english: and three hundred bucklers of hammered gold—three minas Weights of fifty shekels, according to Ezek. 45:12. As with many biblical measures, an accurate modern equivalent is difficult to calculate. of gold would go for each one buckler—and the king put them in the House of the Forest of the Levanon.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּסֵּא־שֵׁן גָּדוֹל וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב מוּפָז׃
verses.english: And the king made a great throne of ivory,and he overlaid it with refined gold.

verses.hebrew: שֵׁשׁ מַעֲלוֹת לַכִּסֵּה וְרֹאשׁ־עָגֹל לַכִּסֵּה מֵאַחֲרָיו וְיָדֹת מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה אֶל־מְקוֹם הַשָּׁבֶת וּשְׁנַיִם אֲרָיוֹת עֹמְדִים אֵצֶל הַיָּדוֹת׃
verses.english: There were six steps for the throne,with a rounded top to the throne, on its back,with armrests on this-side and on that-side at the place of sitting,and two lions standing beside the armrests,

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אֲרָיִים עֹמְדִים שָׁם עַל־שֵׁשׁ הַמַּעֲלוֹת מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה לֹא־נַעֲשָׂה כֵן לְכָל־מַמְלָכוֹת׃
verses.english: and twelve male-lions standing there on the six steps, on this-side and on that-side;none such was made in any [other] kingdom.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל כְּלֵי מַשְׁקֵה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה זָהָב וְכֹל כְּלֵי בֵּית־יַעַר הַלְּבָנוֹן זָהָב סָגוּר אֵין כֶּסֶף לֹא נֶחְשָׁב בִּימֵי שְׁלֹמֹה לִמְאוּמָה׃
verses.english: Now all of King Shelomo’s drinking vessels were of gold,while all the vessels of the House of the Forest of the Levanon were of fine gold;there were none of silver—it was not reckoned of any [value] in the days of Shelomo.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֳנִי תַרְשִׁישׁ לַמֶּלֶךְ בַּיָּם עִם אֳנִי חִירָם אַחַת לְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים תָּבוֹא אֳנִי תַרְשִׁישׁ נֹשְׂאֵת זָהָב וָכֶסֶף שֶׁנְהַבִּים וְקֹפִים וְתֻכִּיִּים׃
verses.english: For the king had a shipping-fleet of Tarshish on the sea,along with Hiram’s ships;once out of every three years, a ship of Tarshish would comecarrying gold and silver,tusks, monkeys, and peacocks.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְדַּל הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מִכֹּל מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ לְעֹשֶׁר וּלְחָכְמָה׃
verses.english: So King Shelomo was greater than all the kings of the earth, in riches and in wisdom,

verses.hebrew: וְכָל־הָאָרֶץ מְבַקְשִׁים אֶת־פְּנֵי שְׁלֹמֹה לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶת־חָכְמָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן אֱלֹהִים בְּלִבּוֹ׃
verses.english: and all the earth was seeking Shelomo’s faceto hear his wisdom which God had put in his heart;

verses.hebrew: וְהֵמָּה מְבִאִים אִישׁ מִנְחָתוֹ כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב וּשְׂלָמוֹת וְנֵשֶׁק וּבְשָׂמִים סוּסִים וּפְרָדִים דְּבַר־שָׁנָה בְּשָׁנָה׃
verses.english: they brought, each one, his tribute:vessels of silver and vessels of gold,clothing and weaponry and spices,horses and mules—each year’s due in its year.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱסֹף שְׁלֹמֹה רֶכֶב וּפָרָשִׁים וַיְהִי־לוֹ אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב וּשְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף פָּרָשִׁים וַיַּנְחֵם בְּעָרֵי הָרֶכֶב וְעִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: And Shelomo gathered chariots and steeds:he had a thousand and four hundred chariots and twelve thousand steeds,and he put them in chariot towns and with the king in Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף בִּירוּשָׁלִַם כָּאֲבָנִים וְאֵת הָאֲרָזִים נָתַן כַּשִּׁקְמִים אֲשֶׁר־בַּשְּׁפֵלָה לָרֹב׃
verses.english: And the king made the silver in Jerusalem like stones,while the cedars he made like sycamores that are in the lowlands, in abundance.

verses.hebrew: וּמוֹצָא הַסּוּסִים אֲשֶׁר לִשְׁלֹמֹה מִמִּצְרָיִם וּמִקְוֵה סֹחֲרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ יִקְחוּ מִקְוֵה בִּמְחִיר׃
verses.english: And the import-source of horses for Shelomo was from Egypt, but some propose Mutzri, north of the Taurus Mountains. and from Kue;the king’s merchants would get them from Kue at a fixed-price.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲלֶה וַתֵּצֵא מֶרְכָּבָה מִמִּצְרַיִם בְּשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת כֶּסֶף וְסוּס בַּחֲמִשִּׁים וּמֵאָה וְכֵן לְכָל־מַלְכֵי הַחִתִּים וּלְמַלְכֵי אֲרָם בְּיָדָם יֹצִאוּ׃
verses.english: So a chariot imported from Egypt would go for six hundred silver pieces, and a horse for fifty and a hundred.Thus it was for all the Hittite kings and the Amorite kings;by their [own] hand they exported them.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה אָהַב נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת רַבּוֹת וְאֶת־בַּת־פַּרְעֹה מוֹאֲבִיּוֹת עַמֳּנִיּוֹת אֲדֹמִיֹּת צֵדְנִיֹּת חִתִּיֹּת׃
verses.english: Now King Shelomo loved many foreign women, along with Pharaoh’s daughter:Moavites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites,

verses.hebrew: מִן־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר־יְהוָה אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־תָבֹאוּ בָהֶם וְהֵם לֹא־יָבֹאוּ בָכֶם אָכֵן יַטּוּ אֶת־לְבַבְכֶם אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶם בָּהֶם דָּבַק שְׁלֹמֹה לְאַהֲבָה׃
verses.english: from the nations of which YHWH had said to the Children of Israel:You are not to come among them and they are not to come among you—surely, they will incline away your heart after their gods.To them Shelomo clung in love.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־לוֹ נָשִׁים שָׂרוֹת שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וּפִלַגְשִׁים שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת וַיַּטּוּ נָשָׁיו אֶת־לִבּוֹ׃
verses.english: He had princess wives, seven hundred,and concubines, three hundred,and his wives inclined away his heart.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לְעֵת זִקְנַת שְׁלֹמֹה נָשָׁיו הִטּוּ אֶת־לְבָבוֹ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְלֹא־הָיָה לְבָבוֹ שָׁלֵם עִם־יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו כִּלְבַב דָּוִיד אָבִיו׃
verses.english: So it was at the time of Shelomo’s old age:his wives inclined away his heart after other gods,and his heart was not complete, playing on Shelomo’s name as one whose heart was not “complete” with God. with YHWH his God,like the heart of David his father.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה אַחֲרֵי עַשְׁתֹּרֶת אֱלֹהֵי צִדֹנִים וְאַחֲרֵי מִלְכֹּם שִׁקֻּץ עַמֹּנִים׃
verses.english: Shelomo went [following] after Astarte uses the vowels of the word bosket, “shame,” to fill out what may originally have been ‘Astart.” Similarly constructed are a number of other biblical names for pagan gods—such as “the Molekh” (for Malik), and “Kemosh” (using the vowels of be’osh, “stench,” for Kamish), both in v.7. godhead of the Sidoniansand after Milkom the Detestable One of the Ammonites.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וְלֹא מִלֵּא אַחֲרֵי יְהוָה כְּדָוִד אָבִיו׃
verses.english: So Shelomo did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH;he did not fully-follow after YHWH, like David his father.

verses.hebrew: אָז יִבְנֶה שְׁלֹמֹה בָּמָה לִכְמוֹשׁ שִׁקֻּץ מוֹאָב בָּהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי יְרוּשָׁלִָם וּלְמֹלֶךְ שִׁקֻּץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃
verses.english: And Shelomo built a sanctuary to Kemosh the Detestable-One of Moav,on the hill that faces Jerusalem,and to Molekh Possibly a god, and often associated in Kings with child sacrifice. LXX, though, reads “Milkom” here., the Detestable One of the Children of Ammon.

verses.hebrew: וְכֵן עָשָׂה לְכָל־נָשָׁיו הַנָּכְרִיּוֹת מַקְטִירוֹת וּמְזַבְּחוֹת לֵאלֹהֵיהֶן׃
verses.english: Thus did he do for all his foreign wives,those sending up smoke and offering-sacrifices to their gods.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְאַנַּף יְהוָה בִּשְׁלֹמֹה כִּי־נָטָה לְבָבוֹ מֵעִם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַנִּרְאָה אֵלָיו פַּעֲמָיִם׃
verses.english: So YHWH was enraged at Shelomo,for he had inclined his heart away from YHWH, the God of Israel,who had appeared to him twice,

verses.hebrew: וְצִוָּה אֵלָיו עַל־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְבִלְתִּי־לֶכֶת אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְלֹא שָׁמַר אֵת אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהוָה׃
verses.english: and had commanded him about this matter, not to walk after other gods,but he had not kept what YHWH had commanded him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר הָיְתָה־זֹּאת עִמָּךְ וְלֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ בְּרִיתִי וְחֻקֹּתַי אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי עָלֶיךָ קָרֹעַ אֶקְרַע אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה מֵעָלֶיךָ וּנְתַתִּיהָ לְעַבְדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: And YHWH said to Shelomo:Because this was your [intention],namely, you have not kept my covenant and my laws which I commanded you,I will tear, yes, tear the kingdom away from you and give it to your servant!

verses.hebrew: אַךְ־בְּיָמֶיךָ לֹא אֶעֱשֶׂנָּה לְמַעַן דָּוִד אָבִיךָ מִיַּד בִּנְךָ אֶקְרָעֶנָּה׃
verses.english: However, in your own days I will not do it,for the sake of David your father;from the hand of your son I will tear it away.

verses.hebrew: רַק אֶת־כָּל־הַמַּמְלָכָה לֹא אֶקְרָע שֵׁבֶט אֶחָד אֶתֵּן לִבְנֶךָ לְמַעַן דָּוִד עַבְדִּי וּלְמַעַן יְרוּשָׁלִַם אֲשֶׁר בָּחָרְתִּי׃
verses.english: Yet I will not tear away the entire kingdom:one tribe I will give to your son, for the sake of David my servant,and for the sake of Jerusalem, which I have chosen.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם יְהוָה שָׂטָן לִשְׁלֹמֹה אֵת הֲדַד הָאֲדֹמִי מִזֶּרַע הַמֶּלֶךְ הוּא בֶּאֱדוֹם׃
verses.english: So YHWH raised up an adversary, later developed into familiar “Satan“; here it denotes only a human being. to Shelomo,Hadad the Edomite, who was from the royal seed in Edom.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּהְיוֹת דָּוִד אֶת־אֱדוֹם בַּעֲלוֹת יוֹאָב שַׂר הַצָּבָא לְקַבֵּר אֶת־הַחֲלָלִים וַיַּךְ כָּל־זָכָר בֶּאֱדוֹם׃
verses.english: Now it was, when David struck Edom, when Yoav Commander of the Armed-Forces had gone up to bury [all] the slain—he struck down all the males in Edom,

verses.hebrew: כִּי שֵׁשֶׁת חֳדָשִׁים יָשַׁב־שָׁם יוֹאָב וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־הִכְרִית כָּל־זָכָר בֶּאֱדוֹם׃
verses.english: since for six months Yoav and all Israel stayed there, until he had cut off all the males in Edom—

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְרַח אֲדַד הוּא וַאֲנָשִׁים אֲדֹמִיִּים מֵעַבְדֵי אָבִיו אִתּוֹ לָבוֹא מִצְרָיִם וַהֲדַד נַעַר קָטָן׃
verses.english: that Hadad ran away, he and his fighting-men, Edomites from among his father’s servants with him, to come to Egypt,and Hadad was [then] a young lad.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ מִמִּדְיָן וַיָּבֹאוּ פָּארָן וַיִּקְחוּ אֲנָשִׁים עִמָּם מִפָּארָן וַיָּבֹאוּ מִצְרַיִם אֶל־פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ בַיִת וְלֶחֶם אָמַר לוֹ וְאֶרֶץ נָתַן לוֹ׃
verses.english: They proceeded from Midyan and came to Pa’ran,and took fighting-men with them from Pa’ranand came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt;he gave him a house, and food he assigned for him,and land he gave him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצָא הֲדַד חֵן בְּעֵינֵי פַרְעֹה מְאֹד וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ אִשָּׁה אֶת־אֲחוֹת אִשְׁתּוֹ אֲחוֹת תַּחְפְּנֵיס הַגְּבִירָה׃
verses.english: And Hadad found exceeding favor in the eyes of Pharaoh,so that he gave him as wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of the Tah’penes Pronounced tah-pe-NACE. The meaning in Egyptian indicates a title, “wife of the king.”, the queen-mother.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ אֲחוֹת תַּחְפְּנֵיס אֵת גְּנֻבַת בְּנוֹ וַתִּגְמְלֵהוּ תַחְפְּנֵס בְּתוֹךְ בֵּית פַּרְעֹה וַיְהִי גְנֻבַת בֵּית פַּרְעֹה בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי פַרְעֹה׃
verses.english: The sister of the Tah’penes bore him Genuvat It possibly means “stranger” or “outsider,” like Moshe’s son Gershom (Exod. 2:22). The whole verse is reminiscent of the Moshe story. his son, and the Tah’penes weaned him amid the house of Pharaoh.And Genuvat remained in the house of Pharaoh, amid Pharaoh’s sons.

verses.hebrew: וַהֲדַד שָׁמַע בְּמִצְרַיִם כִּי־שָׁכַב דָּוִד עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וְכִי־מֵת יוֹאָב שַׂר־הַצָּבָא וַיֹּאמֶר הֲדַד אֶל־פַּרְעֹה שַׁלְּחֵנִי וְאֵלֵךְ אֶל־אַרְצִי׃
verses.english: Now when Hadad heard in Egypt that David lay beside his fathers,and that Yoav Commander of the Armed-Forces was dead,Hadad said to Pharaoh:Send me off, that I may go back to my land.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ פַרְעֹה כִּי מָה־אַתָּה חָסֵר עִמִּי וְהִנְּךָ מְבַקֵּשׁ לָלֶכֶת אֶל־אַרְצֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא כִּי שַׁלֵּחַ תְּשַׁלְּחֵנִי׃
verses.english: Pharaoh said to him:What do you lack with methat here, you seek to go back to your land?He said:No[thing], but send, send me off!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם אֱלֹהִים לוֹ שָׂטָן אֶת־רְזוֹן בֶּן־אֶלְיָדָע אֲשֶׁר בָּרַח מֵאֵת הֲדַדְעֶזֶר מֶלֶךְ־צוֹבָה אֲדֹנָיו׃
verses.english: And God raised up against him an[other] adversary,Rezon son of Elyada,who had run away from Hadad’ezer king of Tzova, his lord.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבֹּץ עָלָיו אֲנָשִׁים וַיְהִי שַׂר־גְּדוּד בַּהֲרֹג דָּוִד אֹתָם וַיֵּלְכוּ דַמֶּשֶׂק וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָהּ וַיִּמְלְכוּ בְּדַמָּשֶׂק׃
verses.english: He gathered fighting-men to himselfand became commander of a raiding-band,when David was killing them,and he went to Damascus and settled in it, and he became king in Damascus.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי שָׂטָן לְיִשְׂרָאֵל כָּל־יְמֵי שְׁלֹמֹה וְאֶת־הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר הֲדָד וַיָּקָץ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְלֹךְ עַל־אֲרָם׃
verses.english: He was an adversary to Israel all the days of Shelomo, along with the evil that Hadad … ;he felt loathing at Israel,and he reigned as king over Aram.

verses.hebrew: וְיָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֶפְרָתִי מִן־הַצְּרֵדָה וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ צְרוּעָה אִשָּׁה אַלְמָנָה עֶבֶד לִשְׁלֹמֹה וַיָּרֶם יָד בַּמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: Now Yorov’am son of Nevat the Efratite, from Tzereda,—his mother’s name was Tzerua, which in the Bible is often seen as reflecting wrongdoing. So its use may be intentional here, given Yorov’am’s low standing in the eyes of the author(s) of Kings. , a widow woman—was a servant of Shelomo,but he raised a hand against the king.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־הֵרִים יָד בַּמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בָּנָה אֶת־הַמִּלּוֹא סָגַר אֶת־פֶּרֶץ עִיר דָּוִד אָבִיו׃
verses.english: And this is the matter in which he raised a hand against the king:when Shelomo built the Earthfill,he closed up the breach of the City of David his father.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאִישׁ יָרָבְעָם גִּבּוֹר חָיִל וַיַּרְא שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־הַנַּעַר כִּי־עֹשֵׂה מְלָאכָה הוּא וַיַּפְקֵד אֹתוֹ לְכָל־סֵבֶל בֵּית יוֹסֵף׃
verses.english: Now the man Yorov’am was a mighty-man of valor;Shelomo saw the lad,that he was a [skilled] doer of work,so he appointed him over all the burden-force of the House of Yosef.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בָּעֵת הַהִיא וְיָרָבְעָם יָצָא מִירוּשָׁלִָם וַיִּמְצָא אֹתוֹ אֲחִיָּה הַשִּׁילֹנִי הַנָּבִיא בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְהוּא מִתְכַּסֶּה בְּשַׂלְמָה חֲדָשָׁה וּשְׁנֵיהֶם לְבַדָּם בַּשָּׂדֶה׃
verses.english: It was at [about] that time,when Yorov’am went out of Jerusalem,that Ahiyya trad. English ‘Ahijah.” It means “Yah (YHWH) Is My Brother.” the Shilonite, the prophet, encountered him on the road—he had covered himself with a new cloak—and the two of them were alone in the open-field.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְפֹּשׂ אֲחִיָּה בַּשַּׂלְמָה הַחֲדָשָׁה אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו וַיִּקְרָעֶהָ שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר קְרָעִים׃
verses.english: And Ahiyya seized the new cloak that was on himand tore it into twelve torn-pieces;

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְיָרָבְעָם קַח־לְךָ עֲשָׂרָה קְרָעִים כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנְנִי קֹרֵעַ אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה מִיַּד שְׁלֹמֹה וְנָתַתִּי לְךָ אֵת עֲשָׂרָה הַשְּׁבָטִים׃
verses.english: he said to Yorov’am:Take yourself ten torn-pieces,for thus says YHWH, the God of Israel:Here, I am about to tear away the kingdom from the hand of Shelomoand will give you the ten tribes,

verses.hebrew: וְהַשֵּׁבֶט הָאֶחָד יִהְיֶה־לּוֹ לְמַעַן עַבְדִּי דָוִד וּלְמַעַן יְרוּשָׁלִַם הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתִּי בָהּ מִכֹּל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: while the one tribe will remain his,for the sake of my servant Davidand for the sake of Jerusalem,the city which I have chosen from all the tribes of Israel—

verses.hebrew: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עֲזָבוּנִי וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְעַשְׁתֹּרֶת אֱלֹהֵי צִדֹנִין לִכְמוֹשׁ אֱלֹהֵי מוֹאָב וּלְמִלְכֹּם אֱלֹהֵי בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וְלֹא־הָלְכוּ בִדְרָכַי לַעֲשׂוֹת הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינַי וְחֻקֹּתַי וּמִשְׁפָּטַי כְּדָוִד אָבִיו׃
verses.english: because he has abandoned me and bowed down to Astarte goddess of the Sidonians,to Kemosh god of Moav,and to Milkom god of the Children of Ammon,and has not walked in my ways,to do what is right in my eyes—my laws and my judgments,like David his father.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־אֶקַּח אֶת־כָּל־הַמַּמְלָכָה מִיָּדוֹ כִּי נָשִׂיא אֲשִׁתֶנּוּ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיָּיו לְמַעַן דָּוִד עַבְדִּי אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתִּי אֹתוֹ אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַר מִצְוֺתַי וְחֻקֹּתָי׃
verses.english: But I will not take away the entire kingdom from his hand;indeed, I will make him exalted-leader). Since this old term is not exactly synonymous with “king,” our verse may be a subtle demoting of Shelomo (Gray 1970). all the days of his life,for the sake of David my servant, whom I chose,who kept my commandments and my laws.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתִּי הַמְּלוּכָה מִיַּד בְּנוֹ וּנְתַתִּיהָ לְּךָ אֵת עֲשֶׂרֶת הַשְּׁבָטִים׃
verses.english: But I will take away the kingdom from the hand of his sonand will give it to you,the ten tribes.

verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנוֹ אֶתֵּן שֵׁבֶט־אֶחָד לְמַעַן הֱיוֹת־נִיר לְדָוִיד־עַבְדִּי כָּל־הַיָּמִים לְפָנַי בִּירוּשָׁלִַם הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתִּי לִי לָשׂוּם שְׁמִי שָׁם׃
verses.english: Yet to his son I will give one tribe,in order that there may be a lamp) is taken to indicate either dynasty continuity or dominion (nir) in recent scholarship. for David my servant all the days [to come] in my presence in Jerusalem,the city that I chose for myself to put my name there.

verses.hebrew: וְאֹתְךָ אֶקַּח וּמָלַכְתָּ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תְּאַוֶּה נַפְשֶׁךָ וְהָיִיתָ מֶּלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And you I will take,that you may reign as king over all that you crave,and you shall be king over Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם־תִּשְׁמַע אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר אֲצַוֶּךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ בִדְרָכַי וְעָשִׂיתָ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינַי לִשְׁמוֹר חֻקּוֹתַי וּמִצְוֺתַי כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה דָּוִד עַבְדִּי וְהָיִיתִי עִמָּךְ וּבָנִיתִי לְךָ בַיִת־נֶאֱמָן כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּנִיתִי לְדָוִד וְנָתַתִּי לְךָ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now it will be:if you hearken to all that I command you,and walk in my ways,and do what is right in my eyes,keeping my laws and my commandmentsas David my servant did,then I will be with you;I will build you a firm house, as I built for David,and I will give you Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַאעַנֶּה אֶת־זֶרַע דָּוִד לְמַעַן זֹאת אַךְ לֹא כָל־הַיָּמִים׃
verses.english: And I will afflict the seed of David on account of this,yet not for all the days [to come].

verses.hebrew: וַיְבַקֵּשׁ שְׁלֹמֹה לְהָמִית אֶת־יָרָבְעָם וַיָּקָם יָרָבְעָם וַיִּבְרַח מִצְרַיִם אֶל־שִׁישַׁק מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם וַיְהִי בְמִצְרַיִם עַד־מוֹת שְׁלֹמֹה׃
verses.english: Shelomo sought to put Yorov’am to death,so Yorov’am arose and ran away to Egypt, to Shishak Shoshenq I (late tenth century) was the founder of Egypt’s Twenty-Second Dynasty. king of Egypt,and remained in Egypt until Shelomo’s death.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי שְׁלֹמֹה וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְחָכְמָתוֹ הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתֻבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי שְׁלֹמֹה׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Shelomo, and all that he did, and his wisdom—are they not written in the Record of the Events of Shelomo?

verses.hebrew: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בִירוּשָׁלִַם עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃
verses.english: Now the days that Shelomo reigned as king in Jerusalem, over all Israel, were forty years;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב שְׁלֹמֹה עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּעִיר דָּוִד אָבִיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ רְחַבְעָם בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: then Shelomo lay beside his fathers,and he was buried in the City of David his father,and Rehav’am meaning either “God [the Kinsman] Has Caused Expansion” or “The People [Kin] Has Expanded”; trad. English “Rehoboam.” Cogan (2001) notes how both his and Yorov’am’s names may point to the prosperity of the Solomonic era. his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ רְחַבְעָם שְׁכֶם כִּי שְׁכֶם בָּא כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַמְלִיךְ אֹתוֹ׃
verses.english: Rehav’am went to Shekhem,for to Shekhem all Israel came to make him king.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט וְהוּא עוֹדֶנּוּ בְמִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר בָּרַח מִפְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיֵּשֶׁב יָרָבְעָם בְּמִצְרָיִם׃
verses.english: And it was, when Yorov’am son of Nevat heard—he was still in Egypt, where he had run away from before King Shelomo—that Yorov’am returned), but the “returned” (va-yoshav) reflected in LXX and II Chron. 10:2 better echoes the theme word of Chaps. 12-13. from Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ־לוֹ ויבאו [וַיָּבֹא] יָרָבְעָם וְכָל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֶל־רְחַבְעָם לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: They sent and called for him, and Yorov’am and the entire assembly of Israel cameand spoke to Rehav’am, saying:

verses.hebrew: אָבִיךָ הִקְשָׁה אֶת־עֻלֵּנוּ וְאַתָּה עַתָּה הָקֵל מֵעֲבֹדַת אָבִיךָ הַקָּשָׁה וּמֵעֻלּוֹ הַכָּבֵד אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן עָלֵינוּ וְנַעַבְדֶךָּ׃
verses.english: Your father made our yoke hard,but you now, lighten your father’s hard servitudeand the heavy yoke that he placed upon us,and we will serve you!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם לְכוּ עֹד שְׁלֹשָׁה יָמִים וְשׁוּבוּ אֵלָי וַיֵּלְכוּ הָעָם׃
verses.english: He said to them:Go off for three days, and [then] return to me.So the people went off.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּעַץ הַמֶּלֶךְ רְחַבְעָם אֶת־הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר־הָיוּ עֹמְדִים אֶת־פְּנֵי שְׁלֹמֹה אָבִיו בִּהְיֹתוֹ חַי לֵאמֹר אֵיךְ אַתֶּם נוֹעָצִים לְהָשִׁיב אֶת־הָעָם־הַזֶּה דָּבָר׃
verses.english: And King Rehav’am sought advice from the elders who had stood before Shelomo his father when he was alive, saying:How do you advise returning word to this people?

verses.hebrew: וידבר [וַיְדַבְּרוּ] אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר אִם־הַיּוֹם תִּהְיֶה־עֶבֶד לָעָם הַזֶּה וַעֲבַדְתָּם וַעֲנִיתָם וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם דְּבָרִים טוֹבִים וְהָיוּ לְךָ עֲבָדִים כָּל־הַיָּמִים׃
verses.english: They spoke to him, saying:If today you would be servant to this people, and would serve them,then answer them and speak good words to them,and they will be servants to you all the days [to come].

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲזֹב אֶת־עֲצַת הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר יְעָצֻהוּ וַיִּוָּעַץ אֶת־הַיְלָדִים אֲשֶׁר גָּדְלוּ אִתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר הָעֹמְדִים לְפָנָיו׃
verses.english: But he abandoned the advice of the elders which they had advised him;he sought advice from the youngsters who had grown up with him, who were standing [in service] before him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מָה אַתֶּם נוֹעָצִים וְנָשִׁיב דָּבָר אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרוּ אֵלַי לֵאמֹר הָקֵל מִן־הָעֹל אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן אָבִיךָ עָלֵינוּ׃
verses.english: He said to them:What do you advise that we return as word to this people,who spoke to me, saying:Lighten the yoke that your father placed upon us!?

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלָיו הַיְלָדִים אֲשֶׁר גָּדְלוּ אִתּוֹ לֵאמֹר כֹּה־תֹאמַר לָעָם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרוּ אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר אָבִיךָ הִכְבִּיד אֶת־עֻלֵּנוּ וְאַתָּה הָקֵל מֵעָלֵינוּ כֹּה תְּדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם קָטָנִּי עָבָה מִמָּתְנֵי אָבִי׃
verses.english: The youngsters who had grown up with him said:Say thus to this people who spoke to you, saying:Your father made our yoke heavy,but you—lighten [it] from upon us!Thus should you speak to them:My little-thing is thicker than my father’s loins!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אָבִי הֶעְמִיס עֲלֵיכֶם עֹל כָּבֵד וַאֲנִי אוֹסִיף עַל־עֻלְּכֶם אָבִי יִסַּר אֶתְכֶם בַּשּׁוֹטִים וַאֲנִי אֲיַסֵּר אֶתְכֶם בָּעַקְרַבִּים׃
verses.english: So-now:my father loaded a heavy yoke upon you,but I will add to your yoke;my father disciplined you with whips,but I will discipline you with “scorpions”!

verses.hebrew: ויבו [וַיָּבוֹא] יָרָבְעָם וְכָל־הָעָם אֶל־רְחַבְעָם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר שׁוּבוּ אֵלַי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי׃
verses.english: So when Yorov’am and the people came to Rehav’am on the third day,as the king had spoken to them, saying: Return to me on the third day.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־הָעָם קָשָׁה וַיַּעֲזֹב אֶת־עֲצַת הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר יְעָצֻהוּ׃
verses.english: And the king answered the people roughly;he abandoned the advice of the elders that they had advised

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם כַּעֲצַת הַיְלָדִים לֵאמֹר אָבִי הִכְבִּיד אֶת־עֻלְּכֶם וַאֲנִי אֹסִיף עַל־עֻלְּכֶם אָבִי יִסַּר אֶתְכֶם בַּשּׁוֹטִים וַאֲנִי אֲיַסֵּר אֶתְכֶם בָּעַקְרַבִּים׃
verses.english: and spoke to them according to the advice of the youngsters, saying:My father made your yoke heavy,but I will add to your yoke;my father disciplined you with whips,but I will discipline you with “scorpions”!

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־שָׁמַע הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־הָעָם כִּי־הָיְתָה סִבָּה מֵעִם יְהוָה לְמַעַן הָקִים אֶת־דְּבָרוֹ אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה בְּיַד אֲחִיָּה הַשִּׁילֹנִי אֶל־יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט׃
verses.english: Now the king did not hearken to the people,for it was a reversal-of-events from YHWH,in order that he might fulfill his word that YHWH had spoken by the hand of Ahiyya the Shilonite to Yorov’am son of Nevat.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי לֹא־שָׁמַע הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲלֵיהֶם וַיָּשִׁבוּ הָעָם אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר לֵאמֹר מַה־לָּנוּ חֵלֶק בְּדָוִד וְלֹא־נַחֲלָה בְּבֶן־יִשַׁי לְאֹהָלֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל עַתָּה רְאֵה בֵיתְךָ דָּוִד וַיֵּלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאֹהָלָיו׃
verses.english: And all Israel saw that the king had not hearkened to them,so the people returned word to the king, saying:What portion do we have in David?No inheritance in the son of Yishai!To your tents, O Israel!Now—see to your own house, O David!And Israel went back to their tents.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּעָרֵי יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם רְחַבְעָם׃
verses.english: But as for the Children of Israel who were settled in the towns of Judah,Rehav’am reigned as king over them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ רְחַבְעָם אֶת־אֲדֹרָם אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַמַּס וַיִּרְגְּמוּ כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בּוֹ אֶבֶן וַיָּמֹת וְהַמֶּלֶךְ רְחַבְעָם הִתְאַמֵּץ לַעֲלוֹת בַּמֶּרְכָּבָה לָנוּס יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: And King Rehav’am sent Adoram Earlier “Adoniram.” As Gray (1970) points out, he is the wrong choice as envoy in this situation. , [The One] Over the Forced-Labor,but all Israel pelted him with stones, so that he died,while King Rehav’am managed to go up into a chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְשְׁעוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּבֵית דָּוִד עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: So Israel rebelled, carries legal and religious overtones (a vassal rebelling against his lord), as contrasted with the more standard m-r-d, “revolt,” used elsewhere. against the House of David—until this day.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־שָׁב יָרָבְעָם וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־הָעֵדָה וַיַּמְלִיכוּ אֹתוֹ עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא הָיָה אַחֲרֵי בֵית־דָּוִד זוּלָתִי שֵׁבֶט־יְהוּדָה לְבַדּוֹ׃
verses.english: Now it was, when all Israel heard that Yorov’am had returned,that they sent and called him to the Communityand made him king over all Israel;there was no one [following] after the House of David except for the tribe of Yehuda alone.

verses.hebrew: ויבאו [וַיָּבֹא] רְחַבְעָם יְרוּשָׁלִַם וַיַּקְהֵל אֶת־כָּל־בֵּית יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־שֵׁבֶט בִּנְיָמִן מֵאָה וּשְׁמֹנִים אֶלֶף בָּחוּר עֹשֵׂה מִלְחָמָה לְהִלָּחֵם עִם־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהָשִׁיב אֶת־הַמְּלוּכָה לִרְחַבְעָם בֶּן־שְׁלֹמֹה׃
verses.english: Rehav’am came to Jerusalem, and he assembled the entire House of Judah, along with the tribe of Binyamin,a hundred eighty thousand chosen ones, ready for battle,to do battle with the House of Israel,to return the kingship to Rehav’am son of Shelomo.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְּבַר הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־שְׁמַעְיָה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: But the word of God [came] to Shema’ya, the man of God, saying:

verses.hebrew: אֱמֹר אֶל־רְחַבְעָם בֶּן־שְׁלֹמֹה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וְאֶל־כָּל־בֵּית יְהוּדָה וּבִנְיָמִין וְיֶתֶר הָעָם לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: Say to Rehav’am son of Shelomo, king of Judah, and to the entire House of Judah, and Binyaminand the rest of the people, saying:

verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה לֹא־תַעֲלוּ וְלֹא־תִלָּחֲמוּן עִם־אֲחֵיכֶם בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל שׁוּבוּ אִישׁ לְבֵיתוֹ כִּי מֵאִתִּי נִהְיָה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶת־דְּבַר יְהוָה וַיָּשֻׁבוּ לָלֶכֶת כִּדְבַר יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Thus says YHWH:You are not to go up, you are not to do battle with your brothers, the Children of Israel;return, each one to his house, for from me is this matter!They hearkened to the word of YHWH,and they turned back, going in accordance with the word of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן יָרָבְעָם אֶת־שְׁכֶם בְּהַר אֶפְרַיִם וַיֵּשֶׁב בָּהּ וַיֵּצֵא מִשָּׁם וַיִּבֶן אֶת־פְּנוּאֵל׃
verses.english: Yorov’am built up Shekhem in the highlands of Efrayim, and held seat in it;then he went out from there and built up Penuel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יָרָבְעָם בְּלִבּוֹ עַתָּה תָּשׁוּב הַמַּמְלָכָה לְבֵית דָּוִד׃
verses.english: And Yorov’am said in his heart:Now the kingdom may [well] return to the House of David;

verses.hebrew: אִם־יַעֲלֶה הָעָם הַזֶּה לַעֲשׂוֹת זְבָחִים בְּבֵית־יְהוָה בִּירוּשָׁלִַם וְשָׁב לֵב הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶל־אֲדֹנֵיהֶם אֶל־רְחַבְעָם מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַהֲרָגֻנִי וְשָׁבוּ אֶל־רְחַבְעָם מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: if this people should go up to make sacrifices at the House of YHWH in Jerusalem,the heart of the people will turn back to their lord, to Rehav’am king of Judah,and they will kill meand return to Rehav’am king of Judah!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּעַץ הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁנֵי עֶגְלֵי זָהָב וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם רַב־לָכֶם מֵעֲלוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַם הִנֵּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלוּךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃
verses.english: So the king sought advice,and made two calves of gold.He said to them:Enough for you, going up to Jerusalem!Here are your gods, O Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־הָאֶחָד בְּבֵית־אֵל וְאֶת־הָאֶחָד נָתַן בְּדָן׃
verses.english: He put the one at Bet-El,while the [other] one he placed at Dan.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְחַטָּאת וַיֵּלְכוּ הָעָם לִפְנֵי הָאֶחָד עַד־דָּן׃
verses.english: So this matter became a sin.And the people went before the one, as far as Dan.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־בֵּית בָּמוֹת וַיַּעַשׂ כֹּהֲנִים מִקְצוֹת הָעָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הָיוּ מִבְּנֵי לֵוִי׃
verses.english: He made a temple-house [for] the sanctuaries,and made priests from [all] quarters of the people who were not from the Sons of Levi.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ יָרָבְעָם חָג בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִי בַּחֲמִשָּׁה־עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ כֶּחָג אֲשֶׁר בִּיהוּדָה וַיַּעַל עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כֵּן עָשָׂה בְּבֵית־אֵל לְזַבֵּחַ לָעֲגָלִים אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה וְהֶעֱמִיד בְּבֵית אֵל אֶת־כֹּהֲנֵי הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃
verses.english: And Yorov’am made a pilgrimage-festival in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month,like the Festival that is in Judah,and he went up on the sacrificial-altar;thus did he make at Bet-El,to offer-sacrifices to the calves that he had made,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה בְּבֵית־אֵל בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִי בַּחֹדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּדָא מלבד [מִלִּבּוֹ] וַיַּעַשׂ חָג לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעַל עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לְהַקְטִיר׃
verses.english: And he went up on the altar that he had made at Bet-Elon the fifteenth day of the eighth month, the month that he had devised of his own heart;so he made a festival for the Children of Israel.And he went up on the altar, to send-up-smoke,

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ אֱלֹהִים בָּא מִיהוּדָה בִּדְבַר יְהוָה אֶל־בֵּית־אֵל וְיָרָבְעָם עֹמֵד עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לְהַקְטִיר׃
verses.english: when here, a man of God was coming from Judah by the word of YHWH to Bet-El.As Yorov’am was standing by the altar to send up smoke,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בִּדְבַר יְהוָה וַיֹּאמֶר מִזְבֵּחַ מִזְבֵּחַ כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה הִנֵּה־בֵן נוֹלָד לְבֵית־דָּוִד יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ שְׁמוֹ וְזָבַח עָלֶיךָ אֶת־כֹּהֲנֵי הַבָּמוֹת הַמַּקְטִרִים עָלֶיךָ וְעַצְמוֹת אָדָם יִשְׂרְפוּ עָלֶיךָ׃
verses.english: he called over the altar with the word of YHWH,he said:O Altar! Altar!Thus says YHWH:Here, a son will be born to the House of David, Yoshiyyahu trad. English “Josiah.” The meaning of the name is uncertain; proposals range from “YHWH Will Grant” and “YHWH Will Protect” to “YHWH Makes Forget.” Although not etymologically related, it also recalls “Yehoshua” (Joshua). The prophecy will be fulfilled in II Kings 23:16. his name;he will slay upon youthe priests of the sanctuaries who are sending up smoke upon you,and human bones will he burn). upon you!

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַן בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא מוֹפֵת לֵאמֹר זֶה הַמּוֹפֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה הִנֵּה הַמִּזְבֵּחַ נִקְרָע וְנִשְׁפַּךְ הַדֶּשֶׁן אֲשֶׁר־עָלָיו׃
verses.english: And he gave a portent on that day, saying:This is the portent that YHWH has spoken:Here, the altar will be torn apart,and spilled out will be the ash-heap that is on it!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־דְּבַר אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר קָרָא עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בְּבֵית־אֵל וַיִּשְׁלַח יָרָבְעָם אֶת־יָדוֹ מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֵאמֹר תִּפְשֻׂהוּ וַתִּיבַשׁ יָדוֹ אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח עָלָיו וְלֹא יָכֹל לַהֲשִׁיבָהּ אֵלָיו׃
verses.english: And it was, when the king heard the word of the man of God which he called out over the altar at Bet-El,that Yorov’am stretched out his hand from over the altar, saying:Seize him!But his hand dried up, the one that he stretched out against him,and he was not able to return it to himself.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמִּזְבֵּחַ נִקְרָע וַיִּשָּׁפֵךְ הַדֶּשֶׁן מִן־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כַּמּוֹפֵת אֲשֶׁר נָתַן אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים בִּדְבַר יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And the altar was torn apart,and the ashes spilled from the altar,in accordance with the portent that the man of God had given him by the hand of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים חַל־נָא אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהִתְפַּלֵּל בַּעֲדִי וְתָשֹׁב יָדִי אֵלָי וַיְחַל אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהוָה וַתָּשָׁב יַד־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלָיו וַתְּהִי כְּבָרִאשֹׁנָה׃
