verses.english: Then the king spoke up and said to the man of God:Now soothe the face of YHWH your God,and pray on my behalf, that my hand may be returned-in-health to me!And the man of God soothed the face of YHWH,so that the king’s hand was returned-in-health to him,and became as at the beginning.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים בֹּאָה־אִתִּי הַבַּיְתָה וּסְעָדָה וְאֶתְּנָה לְךָ מַתָּת׃
verses.english: The king spoke to the man of God:Come back with me to the house and be refreshed,so that I may give you a gift.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־תִּתֶּן־לִי אֶת־חֲצִי בֵיתֶךָ לֹא אָבֹא עִמָּךְ וְלֹא־אֹכַל לֶחֶם וְלֹא אֶשְׁתֶּה־מַּיִם בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: But the man of God said to the king:If you were to give me half your houseI would not come back with you,I would not eat food, I would not drink water in this place,

verses.hebrew: כִּי־כֵן צִוָּה אֹתִי בִּדְבַר יְהוָה לֵאמֹר לֹא־תֹאכַל לֶחֶם וְלֹא תִשְׁתֶּה־מָּיִם וְלֹא תָשׁוּב בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלָכְתָּ׃
verses.english: for thus I was commmanded by the word of YHWH, saying:You are not to eat food, you are not to drink water,and you are not to return by the way that you went!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אַחֵר וְלֹא־שָׁב בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר בָּא בָהּ אֶל־בֵּית־אֵל׃
verses.english: So he went off by another way,and did not return by the way that he had come to Bet-El.

verses.hebrew: וְנָבִיא אֶחָד זָקֵן יֹשֵׁב בְּבֵית־אֵל וַיָּבוֹא בְנוֹ וַיְסַפֶּר־לוֹ אֶת־כָּל־הַמַּעֲשֶׂה אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים הַיּוֹם בְּבֵית־אֵל אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיְסַפְּרוּם לַאֲבִיהֶם׃
verses.english: Now an old prophet was settled at Bet-El.And his sons came and recounted to him all the doings that the man of God had done that day in Bet-El;the words that he had spoken to the king,they recounted them to their father.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם אֲבִיהֶם אֵי־זֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ הָלָךְ וַיִּרְאוּ בָנָיו אֶת־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־בָּא מִיהוּדָה׃
verses.english: Their father spoke to them:By which way did he go?—His sons had seen the way by which the man of God had gone, who had come from Judah.—

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־בָּנָיו חִבְשׁוּ־לִי הַחֲמוֹר וַיַּחְבְּשׁוּ־לוֹ הַחֲמוֹר וַיִּרְכַּב עָלָיו׃
verses.english: He said to his sons:Saddle a donkey for me.So they saddled a donkey for him, and he mounted it,

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵי אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּמְצָאֵהוּ יֹשֵׁב תַּחַת הָאֵלָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הַאַתָּה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־בָּאתָ מִיהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר אָנִי׃
verses.english: and he went after the man of God;he found him sitting under an oakand said to him:Are you the man of God who came from Judah?He said:I am.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לֵךְ אִתִּי הַבָּיְתָה וֶאֱכֹל לָחֶם׃
verses.english: He said to him:Go back with me to the house and eat [some] food.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אוּכַל לָשׁוּב אִתָּךְ וְלָבוֹא אִתָּךְ וְלֹא־אֹכַל לֶחֶם וְלֹא־אֶשְׁתֶּה אִתְּךָ מַיִם בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: He said:I am not able to return with you, to come back with you,and I will not eat food, I will not drink water with you in this place,

verses.hebrew: כִּי־דָבָר אֵלַי בִּדְבַר יְהוָה לֹא־תֹאכַל לֶחֶם וְלֹא־תִשְׁתֶּה שָׁם מָיִם לֹא־תָשׁוּב לָלֶכֶת בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־הָלַכְתָּ בָּהּ׃
verses.english: for the word [came to me] by the word of YHWH:You are not to eat food, you are not to drink water there;you are not to return, going by the way on which you went!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ גַּם־אֲנִי נָבִיא כָּמוֹךָ וּמַלְאָךְ דִּבֶּר אֵלַי בִּדְבַר יְהוָה לֵאמֹר הֲשִׁבֵהוּ אִתְּךָ אֶל־בֵּיתֶךָ וְיֹאכַל לֶחֶם וְיֵשְׁתְּ מָיִם כִּחֵשׁ לוֹ׃
verses.english: He said to him:I too am a prophet like you,and a messenger spoke to me by the word of YHWH, saying:Have him return with you to your house,that he may eat food and drink water!—He was lying to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב אִתּוֹ וַיֹּאכַל לֶחֶם בְּבֵיתוֹ וַיֵּשְׁתְּ מָיִם׃
verses.english: So he returned with himand ate food in his house, and drank water.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הֵם יֹשְׁבִים אֶל־הַשֻּׁלְחָן וַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהוָה אֶל־הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר הֱשִׁיבוֹ׃
verses.english: Now it was:as they were sitting at the table,the word of YHWH [came] to the prophet who had had him return,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־בָּא מִיהוּדָה לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה יַעַן כִּי מָרִיתָ פִּי יְהוָה וְלֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת־הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃
verses.english: and he called out to the man who had come from Judah, saying:Thus says YHWH:Because you have revolted against YHWH’s orderand have not kept the command that YHWH your God commanded,

verses.hebrew: וַתָּשָׁב וַתֹּאכַל לֶחֶם וַתֵּשְׁתְּ מַיִם בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֵלֶיךָ אַל־תֹּאכַל לֶחֶם וְאַל־תֵּשְׁתְּ מָיִם לֹא־תָבוֹא נִבְלָתְךָ אֶל־קֶבֶר אֲבֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: but have returned and eaten food and drunk water in the place of which he spoke to you:Do not eat food and do not drink water!—your corpse shall not come to the burial-place of your fathers!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי אָכְלוֹ לֶחֶם וְאַחֲרֵי שְׁתוֹתוֹ וַיַּחֲבָשׁ־לוֹ הַחֲמוֹר לַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר הֱשִׁיבוֹ׃
verses.english: And it was,after his eating food and after his drinking,that the donkey was saddled for him, belonging to the prophet who had had him return.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּמְצָאֵהוּ אַרְיֵה בַּדֶּרֶךְ וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַתְּהִי נִבְלָתוֹ מֻשְׁלֶכֶת בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְהַחֲמוֹר עֹמֵד אֶצְלָהּ וְהָאַרְיֵה עֹמֵד אֵצֶל הַנְּבֵלָה׃
verses.english: He went off, and a lion encountered him on the way, and caused his death,and his corpse was [left] thrown into the way,with the donkey standing near him,while the lion was standing near the corpse.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה אֲנָשִׁים עֹבְרִים וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת־הַנְּבֵלָה מֻשְׁלֶכֶת בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְאֶת־הָאַרְיֵה עֹמֵד אֵצֶל הַנְּבֵלָה וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיְדַבְּרוּ בָעִיר אֲשֶׁר הַנָּבִיא הַזָּקֵן יֹשֵׁב בָּהּ׃
verses.english: Now here, some men were crossing by,and they saw the corpse thrown into the way, with the lion standing near the corpse,so they came and spoke [of it] in the town where the old prophet was settled.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר הֱשִׁיבוֹ מִן־הַדֶּרֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים הוּא אֲשֶׁר מָרָה אֶת־פִּי יְהוָה וַיִּתְּנֵהוּ יְהוָה לָאַרְיֵה וַיִּשְׁבְּרֵהוּ וַיְמִתֵהוּ כִּדְבַר יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר־לוֹ׃
verses.english: And he heard, the prophet who had had him return from the way, and he said:He is the man of God who revolted against YHWH’s order,so YHWH gave him to the lion, so that he mangled him and put him to death,in accordance with the word of YHWH which he had spoken to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל־בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר חִבְשׁוּ־לִי אֶת־הַחֲמוֹר וַיַּחֲבֹשׁוּ׃
verses.english: And he spoke to his sons, saying:Saddle me the donkey!And they saddled it.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּמְצָא אֶת־נִבְלָתוֹ מֻשְׁלֶכֶת בַּדֶּרֶךְ וַחֲמוֹר וְהָאַרְיֵה עֹמְדִים אֵצֶל הַנְּבֵלָה לֹא־אָכַל הָאַרְיֵה אֶת־הַנְּבֵלָה וְלֹא שָׁבַר אֶת־הַחֲמוֹר׃
verses.english: He went and found the corpse thrown in the way,with the donkey and the lion standing near the corpse—the lion had not eaten the corpse, and had not mangled the donkey!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא הַנָּבִיא אֶת־נִבְלַת אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּנִּחֵהוּ אֶל־הַחֲמוֹר וַיְשִׁיבֵהוּ וַיָּבֹא אֶל־עִיר הַנָּבִיא הַזָּקֵן לִסְפֹּד וּלְקָבְרוֹ׃
verses.english: And the prophet lifted up the corpse of the man of God and put it on the donkey, and had him return;then he came to the town of the old prophet, to beat [the breast] and to bury him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּנַּח אֶת־נִבְלָתוֹ בְּקִבְרוֹ וַיִּסְפְּדוּ עָלָיו הוֹי אָחִי׃
verses.english: He put his corpse in his [own] burial-placeand they beat [the breast] over him: Alas, my brother!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי קָבְרוֹ אֹתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר בְּמוֹתִי וּקְבַרְתֶּם אֹתִי בַּקֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים קָבוּר בּוֹ אֵצֶל עַצְמֹתָיו הַנִּיחוּ אֶת־עַצְמֹתָי׃
verses.english: And it was, after he buried him, that he said to his sons, saying:When I die, you are to bury me in the burial-place where the man of God is buried;near his bones put my bones.

verses.hebrew: כִּי הָיֹה יִהְיֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר קָרָא בִּדְבַר יְהוָה עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית־אֵל וְעַל כָּל־בָּתֵּי הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר בְּעָרֵי שֹׁמְרוֹן׃
verses.english: For it will come, come-to-pass, the word that he called out by the word of YHWHconcerning the altar that is in Bet-El and concerning all the sanctuary buildings that are in the towns of Shomeron trad. English “Samaria,” the northern capital (which will not be named until Chap. 16!). Here it appears to refer to a region, rather unusually for the Bible..

verses.hebrew: אַחַר הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לֹא־שָׁב יָרָבְעָם מִדַּרְכּוֹ הָרָעָה וַיָּשָׁב וַיַּעַשׂ מִקְצוֹת הָעָם כֹּהֲנֵי בָמוֹת הֶחָפֵץ יְמַלֵּא אֶת־יָדוֹ וִיהִי כֹּהֲנֵי בָמוֹת׃
verses.english: After this matter, Yorov’am did not return from his evil way,but he returned to making priests from [all] quarters of the people for the sanctuaries;[to] whoever desired, he would give mandate, and he became a priest at the sanctuaries.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְחַטַּאת בֵּית יָרָבְעָם וּלְהַכְחִיד וּלְהַשְׁמִיד מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃
verses.english: So this matter became a sin by the House of Yorov’am,for effacing, for erasing [it]: The dynasty of Yorov’am. [it] from the surface of the ground.

verses.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַהִיא חָלָה אֲבִיָּה בֶן־יָרָבְעָם׃
verses.english: At [about] that time,Aviyya son of Yorov’am became sick.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יָרָבְעָם לְאִשְׁתּוֹ קוּמִי נָא וְהִשְׁתַּנִּית וְלֹא יֵדְעוּ כִּי־אתי [אַתְּ] אֵשֶׁת יָרָבְעָם וְהָלַכְתְּ שִׁלֹה הִנֵּה־שָׁם אֲחִיָּה הַנָּבִיא הוּא־דִבֶּר עָלַי לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־הָעָם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: Yorov’am said to his wife:Now arise and change your [appearance],so that they will not know that you are Yorov’am’s wife,and go to Shilo—there is Ahiyya the prophet; it was he [who] declared me as king over this people—

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחַתְּ בְּיָדֵךְ עֲשָׂרָה לֶחֶם וְנִקֻּדִים וּבַקְבֻּק דְּבַשׁ וּבָאת אֵלָיו הוּא יַגִּיד לָךְ מַה־יִּהְיֶה לַנָּעַר׃
verses.english: and take in your hand ten bread-loaves and biscuits and a bottle of honeyand come to him;he will tell you what will happen to the lad.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעַשׂ כֵּן אֵשֶׁת יָרָבְעָם וַתָּקָם וַתֵּלֶךְ שִׁלֹה וַתָּבֹא בֵּית אֲחִיָּה וַאֲחִיָּהוּ לֹא־יָכֹל לִרְאוֹת כִּי קָמוּ עֵינָיו מִשֵּׂיבוֹ׃
verses.english: Yorov’am’s wife did thus:she arose and went to Shilo, and came to the house of Ahiyya.Now Ahiyyahu was not able to see,for his eyes were set from his hoary-age.

verses.hebrew: וַיהוָה אָמַר אֶל־אֲחִיָּהוּ הִנֵּה אֵשֶׁת יָרָבְעָם בָּאָה לִדְרֹשׁ דָּבָר מֵעִמְּךָ אֶל־בְּנָהּ כִּי־חֹלֶה הוּא כָּזֹה וְכָזֶה תְּדַבֵּר אֵלֶיהָ וִיהִי כְבֹאָהּ וְהִיא מִתְנַכֵּרָה׃
verses.english: But God had said to Ahiyyahu:Here, Yorov’am’s wife is comingto search out a word through you concerning her son, for he is sick;like this and like that you are to speak to her.And it will be that when she comes, she will act-like-a-stranger.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ אֲחִיָּהוּ אֶת־קוֹל רַגְלֶיהָ בָּאָה בַפֶּתַח וַיֹּאמֶר בֹּאִי אֵשֶׁת יָרָבְעָם לָמָּה זֶּה אַתְּ מִתְנַכֵּרָה וְאָנֹכִי שָׁלוּחַ אֵלַיִךְ קָשָׁה׃
verses.english: Now it was, when Ahiyyahu heard the sound of her feet as she came in at the entrance,that he said:Come in, Yorov’am’s wife,why now do you act-like-a-stranger?I myself am sent to you with a hard [message]:

verses.hebrew: לְכִי אִמְרִי לְיָרָבְעָם כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יַעַן אֲשֶׁר הֲרִימֹתִיךָ מִתּוֹךְ הָעָם וָאֶתֶּנְךָ נָגִיד עַל עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Go, say to Yorov’am:Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel:Because I exalted you from the midst of the people,and made you Nagid over my people Israel,

verses.hebrew: וָאֶקְרַע אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה מִבֵּית דָּוִד וָאֶתְּנֶהָ לָךְ וְלֹא־הָיִיתָ כְּעַבְדִּי דָוִד אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַר מִצְוֺתַי וַאֲשֶׁר־הָלַךְ אַחֲרַי בְּכָל־לְבָבוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת רַק הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינָי׃
verses.english: and tore the kingdom away from the House of David and gave it to you—but you have not been like my servant David,who kept my commandments and who walked after me with all his heart,doing only what was right in my eyes;

verses.hebrew: וַתָּרַע לַעֲשׂוֹת מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־הָיוּ לְפָנֶיךָ וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתַּעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וּמַסֵּכוֹת לְהַכְעִיסֵנִי וְאֹתִי הִשְׁלַכְתָּ אַחֲרֵי גַוֶּךָ׃
verses.english: you have done evil, more than all who were before you,you have gone and made yourself other gods, namely molten ones, to provoke me,and me you have thrown behind your back—

verses.hebrew: לָכֵן הִנְנִי מֵבִיא רָעָה אֶל־בֵּית יָרָבְעָם וְהִכְרַתִּי לְיָרָבְעָם מַשְׁתִּין בְּקִיר עָצוּר וְעָזוּב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִעַרְתִּי אַחֲרֵי בֵית־יָרָבְעָם כַּאֲשֶׁר יְבַעֵר הַגָּלָל עַד־תֻּמּוֹ׃
verses.english: therefore:here, I am bringing evil upon the House of Yorov’am:I will cut off from Yorov’am he who pisses against the wall,[even] those fettered and forsaken in Israel,and I will eradicate after [you] the House of Yorov’amas a ball of dung is burned)., until it is gone.

verses.hebrew: הַמֵּת לְיָרָבְעָם בָּעִיר יֹאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים וְהַמֵּת בַּשָּׂדֶה יֹאכְלוּ עוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם כִּי יְהוָה דִּבֵּר׃
verses.english: He who dies of Yorov’am in the city, the dogs will eat,while he who dies in the open-field, the birds of the heavens will eat;for YHWH has spoken!

verses.hebrew: וְאַתְּ קוּמִי לְכִי לְבֵיתֵךְ בְּבֹאָה רַגְלַיִךְ הָעִירָה וּמֵת הַיָּלֶד׃
verses.english: As for you, arise, go back to your house;when your feet come into the city, the child will die.

verses.hebrew: וְסָפְדוּ־לוֹ כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְקָבְרוּ אֹתוֹ כִּי־זֶה לְבַדּוֹ יָבֹא לְיָרָבְעָם אֶל־קָבֶר יַעַן נִמְצָא־בוֹ דָּבָר טוֹב אֶל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּבֵית יָרָבְעָם׃
verses.english: And all Israel will beat [the breast] for him and will bury him,for he alone of Yorov’am will come to a burial-place,because some good toward YHWH, the God of Israel, has been found in him [alone] of the House of Yorov’am.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵקִים יְהוָה לוֹ מֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יַכְרִית אֶת־בֵּית יָרָבְעָם זֶה הַיּוֹם וּמֶה גַּם־עָתָּה׃
verses.english: And YHWH will raise up a king for himself over Israel, who will cut off the House of Yorov’am, this very day and even now.

verses.hebrew: וְהִכָּה יְהוָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר יָנוּד הַקָּנֶה בַּמַּיִם וְנָתַשׁ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל הָאֲדָמָה הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לַאֲבוֹתֵיהֶם וְזֵרָם מֵעֵבֶר לַנָּהָר יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֶת־אֲשֵׁרֵיהֶם מַכְעִיסִים אֶת־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: YHWH will strike Israel,like a reed that sways in water,and will uproot Israelfrom this good ground that he gave their fathers,and will scatter them across the River,because they made their Ashera-poles,provoking YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְיִתֵּן אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּגְלַל חַטֹּאות יָרָבְעָם אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וַאֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: He will give Israel up, on account of, perhaps a double pun with “dung” (galal, v.10) and “Illicit-Things” (gillulim) elsewhere. Yorov’am’s sins which he sinned, and which he caused Israel to sin.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּקָם אֵשֶׁת יָרָבְעָם וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתָּבֹא תִרְצָתָה הִיא בָּאָה בְסַף־הַבַּיִת וְהַנַּעַר מֵת׃
verses.english: Yorov’am’s wife aroseand went back to Tirtza;[just as] she was coming in to the threshold of the house,the child died.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ וַיִּסְפְּדוּ־לוֹ כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּדְבַר יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד־עַבְדּוֹ אֲחִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא׃
verses.english: They buried him and all Israel beat [the breast] for him,according to the word of YHWH that he had spoken by the hand of his servant Ahiyyahu the prophet.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יָרָבְעָם אֲשֶׁר נִלְחַם וַאֲשֶׁר מָלָךְ הִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Yorov’am,how he waged battle and how he reigned as king—here, they are written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ יָרָבְעָם עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה וַיִּשְׁכַּב עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ נָדָב בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Now the days that Yorov’am reigned as king were twenty and two years;then he lay beside his fathers,and Nadav his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: וּרְחַבְעָם בֶּן־שְׁלֹמֹה מָלַךְ בִּיהוּדָה בֶּן־אַרְבָּעִים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה רְחַבְעָם בְּמָלְכוֹ וּשֲׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִַם הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר־בָּחַר יְהוָה לָשׂוּם אֶת־שְׁמוֹ שָׁם מִכֹּל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ נַעֲמָה הָעַמֹּנִית׃
verses.english: Now Rehav’am son of Shelomo reigned as king in Judah:forty-one years old was Rehav’am at his becoming king,and for seventeen years he reigned as king in Jerusalem,the city that YHWH had chosen to put his name there from all the tribes of Israel;his mother’s name was Naama the Ammonite.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהוּדָה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וַיְקַנְאוּ אֹתוֹ מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָם בְּחַטֹּאתָם אֲשֶׁר חָטָאוּ׃
verses.english: And Judah did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH:they aroused his zealous-indignation more than all their fathers had done, in the sins that they sinned.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְנוּ גַם־הֵמָּה לָהֶם בָּמוֹת וּמַצֵּבוֹת וַאֲשֵׁרִים עַל כָּל־גִּבְעָה גְבֹהָה וְתַחַת כָּל־עֵץ רַעֲנָן׃
verses.english: They too built for themselves sanctuaries and standing-pillars and Ashera-poleson every lofty hill and under every luxuriant tree.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם־קָדֵשׁ הָיָה בָאָרֶץ עָשׂוּ כְּכֹל הַתּוֹעֲבֹת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And there were even [male] prostitutes in the land;they did according to all the abominable deeds of the nations that YHWH had dispossessed before the Children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּשָּׁנָה הַחֲמִישִׁית לַמֶּלֶךְ רְחַבְעָם עָלָה שושק [שִׁישַׁק] מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: Now it wasin the fifth year of King Rehav’am,that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־אֹצְרוֹת בֵּית־יְהוָה וְאֶת־אוֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־הַכֹּל לָקָח וַיִּקַּח אֶת־כָּל־מָגִנֵּי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה שְׁלֹמֹה׃
verses.english: He took away the treasures of the House of YHWH and the treasures of the king’s house—he took everything.He [even] took all the gold bucklers that Shelomo had made,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ רְחַבְעָם תַּחְתָּם מָגִנֵּי נְחֹשֶׁת וְהִפְקִיד עַל־יַד שָׂרֵי הָרָצִים הַשֹּׁמְרִים פֶּתַח בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: so King Rehav’am made, in their place, bronze bucklers;he would entrust them to the hand of the Commanders of the Outrunners, those on watch at the entrance to the king’s house.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִדֵּי־בֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ בֵּית יְהוָה יִשָּׂאוּם הָרָצִים וֶהֱשִׁיבוּם אֶל־תָּא הָרָצִים׃
verses.english: It was, whenever the king entered YHWH’s House,that the outrunners would carry themand would return them to the outrunners’ guardroom.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי רְחַבְעָם וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵמָּה כְתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Rehav’am, and all that he did—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Judah?

verses.hebrew: וּמִלְחָמָה הָיְתָה בֵין־רְחַבְעָם וּבֵין יָרָבְעָם כָּל־הַיָּמִים׃
verses.english: And there was war between Rehav’am and Yorov’am all the days.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב רְחַבְעָם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ נַעֲמָה הָעַמֹּנִית וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֲבִיָּם בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Rehav’am lay beside his fathers;he was buried with his fathers, in the City of David.Now his mother’s name was Naama the Ammonite.And Aviyyam his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: וּבִשְׁנַת שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה לַמֶּלֶךְ יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט מָלַךְ אֲבִיָּם עַל־יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: In year eighteen of King Yorov’am son of Nevat, Aviyyam became king over Judah.

verses.hebrew: שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ מַעֲכָה בַּת־אֲבִישָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: For three years he reigned as king in Jerusalem;his mother’s name was Maakha daughter of Avishalom. (here, “daughter”) would be “granddaughter.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכָל־חַטֹּאות אָבִיו אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לְפָנָיו וְלֹא־הָיָה לְבָבוֹ שָׁלֵם עִם־יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו כִּלְבַב דָּוִד אָבִיו׃
verses.english: He walkedin all the sins of his father which he had done before him;his heart was not complete with YHWH his God,like the heart of David his father.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לְמַעַן דָּוִד נָתַן יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו לוֹ נִיר בִּירוּשָׁלִָם לְהָקִים אֶת־בְּנוֹ אַחֲרָיו וּלְהַעֲמִיד אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: But for the sake of David,YHWH his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem,to establish his son after him and to let Jerusalem stand,

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה דָוִד אֶת־הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וְלֹא־סָר מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּהוּ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיָּיו רַק בִּדְבַר אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי׃
verses.english: since David did what was right in the eyes of YHWH:he did not turn aside from all that he had commanded him all the days of his life—save in the matter of Uriyya the Hittite.

verses.hebrew: וּמִלְחָמָה הָיְתָה בֵין־רְחַבְעָם וּבֵין יָרָבְעָם כָּל־יְמֵי חַיָּיו׃
verses.english: And there was war between Aviyyam and Yorov’am all the days of his life.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אֲבִיָּם וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה וּמִלְחָמָה הָיְתָה בֵּין אֲבִיָּם וּבֵין יָרָבְעָם׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Aviyyam, and all that he did—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Judah?And there was war between Aviyyam and Yorov’am.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אֲבִיָּם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בְּעִיר דָּוִד וַיִּמְלֹךְ אָסָא בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Aviyyam lay beside his fathers;they buried him in the City of David,and Asa his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: וּבִשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים לְיָרָבְעָם מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ אָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: In year twenty of Yorov’am king of Israel,Asa king of Judah became king.

verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבָּעִים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ מַעֲכָה בַּת־אֲבִישָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: For forty-one years he reigned as king in Jerusalem;his mother’s name was Maakha daughter of Avishalom.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אָסָא הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כְּדָוִד אָבִיו׃
verses.english: And Asa did what was right in the eyes of YHWH,like his father David:

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֵר הַקְּדֵשִׁים מִן־הָאָרֶץ וַיָּסַר אֶת־כָּל־הַגִּלֻּלִים אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָיו׃
verses.english: he put away the [male] prostitutes from the land,and removed all the Illicit-Things, perhaps related to Akkadian gillatu (crime), but also suggesting Hebrew words for “dung,” so that here, as is common in the Bible, idolatry is understood pejoratively. that his fathers had made.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֶת־מַעֲכָה אִמּוֹ וַיְסִרֶהָ מִגְּבִירָה אֲשֶׁר־עָשְׂתָה מִפְלֶצֶת לָאֲשֵׁרָה וַיִּכְרֹת אָסָא אֶת־מִפְלַצְתָּהּ וַיִּשְׂרֹף בְּנַחַל קִדְרוֹן׃
verses.english: And also Maakha his mother—he removed her from being queen-mother,since she had made the Horrid-Thing for Ashera;Asa cut down her Horrid-Thing, and burned it at Wadi Kidron.

verses.hebrew: וְהַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ רַק לְבַב־אָסָא הָיָה שָׁלֵם עִם־יְהוָה כָּל־יָמָיו׃
verses.english: But the sanctuaries were not removed;however, Asa’s heart was complete with YHWH all his days.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֵא אֶת־קָדְשֵׁי אָבִיו וקדשו [וְקָדְשֵׁי] בֵּית יְהוָה כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב וְכֵלִים׃
verses.english: He brought the holy-objects of his father and his own holy-objects into the House of YHWH,silver, gold, and vessels.

verses.hebrew: וּמִלְחָמָה הָיְתָה בֵּין אָסָא וּבֵין בַּעְשָׁא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּל־יְמֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: And there was war between Asa and Ba’sha king of Israel all their days.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל בַּעְשָׁא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל־יְהוּדָה וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הָרָמָה לְבִלְתִּי תֵּת יֹצֵא וָבָא לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: Ba’sha king of Israel came up against Judah and built Rama,so as not to allow going out or coming in to Asa king of Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אָסָא אֶת־כָּל־הַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב הַנּוֹתָרִים בְּאוֹצְרוֹת בֵּית־יְהוָה וְאֶת־אוֹצְרוֹת בֵּית מלך [הַמֶּלֶךְ] וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד־עֲבָדָיו וַיִּשְׁלָחֵם הַמֶּלֶךְ אָסָא אֶל־בֶּן־הֲדַד בֶּן־טַבְרִמֹּן בֶּן־חֶזְיוֹן מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם הַיֹּשֵׁב בְּדַמֶּשֶׂק לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: So Asa took all the silver and gold that was left in the treasuries of the House of YHWH and in the treasuries of the House of the Kingand gave them into the hand of his servants,and King Asa sent them to Ben-Hadad son of Tavrimon son of Hezyon, king of Aram, who had seat in Damascus, saying:

verses.hebrew: בְּרִית בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ בֵּין אָבִי וּבֵין אָבִיךָ הִנֵּה שָׁלַחְתִּי לְךָ שֹׁחַד כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב לֵךְ הָפֵרָה אֶת־בְּרִיתְךָ אֶת־בַּעְשָׁא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיַעֲלֶה מֵעָלָי׃
verses.english: There is a covenant between me and you, as between my father and your father;here, I am sending you a bribe of silver and gold—go, violate your covenant with Ba’sha king of Israel,that he may go up away from me!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע בֶּן־הֲדַד אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אָסָא וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶת־שָׂרֵי הַחֲיָלִים אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ עַל־עָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּךְ אֶת־עִיּוֹן וְאֶת־דָּן וְאֵת אָבֵל בֵּית־מַעֲכָה וְאֵת כָּל־כִּנְרוֹת עַל כָּל־אֶרֶץ נַפְתָּלִי׃
verses.english: And Ben-Hadad hearkened to King Asa;he sent the commanders of the soldiers who belonged to him against the towns of Israeland they struck Iyyon, and Dan, and Avel Bet-Maakhaand all the Kinneret-regions, next to all the region of Naftali.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ בַּעְשָׁא וַיֶּחְדַּל מִבְּנוֹת אֶת־הָרָמָה וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּתִרְצָה׃
verses.english: It was, when Ba’sha heard, that he refrained from building up Rama,and returned to Tirtza.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ אָסָא הִשְׁמִיעַ אֶת־כָּל־יְהוּדָה אֵין נָקִי וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת־אַבְנֵי הָרָמָה וְאֶת־עֵצֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה בַּעְשָׁא וַיִּבֶן בָּם הַמֶּלֶךְ אָסָא אֶת־גֶּבַע בִּנְיָמִן וְאֶת־הַמִּצְפָּה׃
verses.english: Now King Asa mustered all Judah—there was no one clear [of obligation]—and they carried away the stones of Rama and its timber, which Ba’sha had built up,and King Asa built with them Geva/The Hill of Binyamin and Mitzpa.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר כָּל־דִּבְרֵי־אָסָא וְכָל־גְּבוּרָתוֹ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְהֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה הֲלֹא־הֵמָּה כְתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה רַק לְעֵת זִקְנָתוֹ חָלָה אֶת־רַגְלָיו׃
verses.english: Now the rest of all the events of Asa, and all his mighty-deeds, and all that he did,and the towns that he built up—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Judah?However: at the time of his old age, he became sick in his feet.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אָסָא עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד אָבִיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָט בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: And Asa lay beside his fathers;he was buried with his fathers, in the City of David his father,and Yehoshafat his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: וְנָדָב בֶּן־יָרָבְעָם מָלַךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁנָתָיִם׃
verses.english: Now Nadav trad. English “Nadab.” son of Yorov’am became king over Israel in year two of Asa king of Judah,and he reigned as king over Israel for two years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אָבִיו וּבְחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: He did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH:he walked in the way of his father and in his sin which he had caused Israel to sin.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְשֹׁר עָלָיו בַּעְשָׁא בֶן־אֲחִיָּה לְבֵית יִשָּׂשכָר וַיַּכֵּהוּ בַעְשָׁא בְּגִבְּתוֹן אֲשֶׁר לַפְּלִשְׁתִּים וְנָדָב וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל צָרִים עַל־גִּבְּתוֹן׃
verses.english: And Ba’sha son of Ahiyya, of the House of Yissakhar, conspired against him;Ba’sha struck him down at Gibbeton that belonged to the Philistines,while Nadav and all Israel were besieging Gibbeton.

verses.hebrew: וַיְמִתֵהוּ בַעְשָׁא בִּשְׁנַת שָׁלֹשׁ לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Ba’sha put him to death in year three of Asa king of Judah,and reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְמָלְכוֹ הִכָּה אֶת־כָּל־בֵּית יָרָבְעָם לֹא־הִשְׁאִיר כָּל־נְשָׁמָה לְיָרָבְעָם עַד־הִשְׁמִדוֹ כִּדְבַר יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד־עַבְדּוֹ אֲחִיָּה הַשִּׁילֹנִי׃
verses.english: And it was, when he became king,that he struck down the entire House of Yorov’am;he did not leave anyone breathing who belonged to Yorov’am, until he had wiped it out,in accordance with the word of YHWH which he had spoken by the hand of his servant Ahiyya the Shilonite,

verses.hebrew: עַל־חַטֹּאות יָרָבְעָם אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וַאֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכַעְסוֹ אֲשֶׁר הִכְעִיס אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: because of the sins of Yorov’am which he sinned and by which he had caused Israel to sin,in his provocation by which he provoked YHWH, the God of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי נָדָב וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Nadav, and all that he did—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Israel?

verses.hebrew: וּמִלְחָמָה הָיְתָה בֵּין אָסָא וּבֵין בַּעְשָׁא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּל־יְמֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: And there was war between Asa and Ba’sha king of Israel all their days.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שָׁלֹשׁ לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ בַּעְשָׁא בֶן־אֲחִיָּה עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתִרְצָה עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבַּע שָׁנָה׃
verses.english: In year three of Asa king of Judah,Ba’sha son of Ahiyya became king over all Israel in Tirtza, for twenty-four years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ יָרָבְעָם וּבְחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: He did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH:he walked in the way of Yorov’am and in his sin, by which he had caused Israel to sin.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֶל־יֵהוּא בֶן־חֲנָנִי עַל־בַּעְשָׁא לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: And the word of YHWH [came] to Yehu trad. English “Jehu.” The name means “YHWH Is He,” appropriate given Yehu’s purge of the idolatrous house of Omri. son of Hanani regarding Ba’sha, saying:

verses.hebrew: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר הֲרִימֹתִיךָ מִן־הֶעָפָר וָאֶתֶּנְךָ נָגִיד עַל עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ יָרָבְעָם וַתַּחֲטִא אֶת־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכְעִיסֵנִי בְּחַטֹּאתָם׃
verses.english: Because I elevated you from the dust and made you Nagid over my people Israel,but you have walked in the way of Yorov’am and have caused my people Israel to sin,provoking me by their sins—

verses.hebrew: הִנְנִי מַבְעִיר אַחֲרֵי בַעְשָׁא וְאַחֲרֵי בֵיתוֹ וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־בֵּיתְךָ כְּבֵית יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט׃
verses.english: here, I will eradicate [those coming] after Ba’sha and after his House;I will make your house like the House of Yorov’am son of Nevat:

verses.hebrew: הַמֵּת לְבַעְשָׁא בָּעִיר יֹאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים וְהַמֵּת לוֹ בַּשָּׂדֶה יֹאכְלוּ עוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם׃
verses.english: he who dies of Ba’sha in the city, the dogs shall eat,while he who dies of him in the open-field, the birds of the heavens shall eat!

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי בַעְשָׁא וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Ba’sha, and what he did, and his mighty-deeds—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Israel?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב בַּעְשָׁא עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּתִרְצָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֵלָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Ba’sha lay beside his fathers;he was buried in Tirtza,and Ela his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם בְּיַד־יֵהוּא בֶן־חֲנָנִי הַנָּבִיא דְּבַר־יְהוָה הָיָה אֶל־בַּעְשָׁא וְאֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וְעַל כָּל־הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה לְהַכְעִיסוֹ בְּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו לִהְיוֹת כְּבֵית יָרָבְעָם וְעַל אֲשֶׁר־הִכָּה אֹתוֹ׃
verses.english: Then, too, by the hand of Yehu son of Hanani, the prophet,the word of YHWH [had come] concerning Ba’sha and concerning his house,regarding all the evil that he had done in the eyes of YHWH,provoking him with the doings of his hands, being like the House of Yorov’am,and because he had struck it down.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֵׁשׁ שָׁנָה לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ אֵלָה בֶן־בַּעְשָׁא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתִרְצָה שְׁנָתָיִם׃
verses.english: In year twenty-six of the years of Asa king of Judah,Ela son of Ba’sha became as king over Israel in Tirtza, for two years.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְשֹׁר עָלָיו עַבְדּוֹ זִמְרִי שַׂר מַחֲצִית הָרָכֶב וְהוּא בְתִרְצָה שֹׁתֶה שִׁכּוֹר בֵּית אַרְצָא אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַבַּיִת בְּתִרְצָה׃
verses.english: And his servant Zimri, commander of half the chariotry, conspired against him.Now he was in Tirtza, drinking himself drunk in the house of Artza, [The One] Over the Household in Tirtza,

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא זִמְרִי וַיַּכֵּהוּ וַיְמִיתֵהוּ בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֶׁבַע לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: and Zimri came and struck him down, putting him to death,in year twenty-seven of Asa king of Judah,and he became king in his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְמָלְכוֹ כְּשִׁבְתּוֹ עַל־כִּסְאוֹ הִכָּה אֶת־כָּל־בֵּית בַּעְשָׁא לֹא־הִשְׁאִיר לוֹ מַשְׁתִּין בְּקִיר וְגֹאֲלָיו וְרֵעֵהוּ׃
verses.english: And it was, when he became king, as soon as he sat on his throne,that he struck down the entire House of Ba’sha—he did not leave him one pissing against the wall,either his blood-redeemers or his friends.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁמֵד זִמְרִי אֵת כָּל־בֵּית בַּעְשָׁא כִּדְבַר יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֶל־בַּעְשָׁא בְּיַד יֵהוּא הַנָּבִיא׃
verses.english: So Zimri wiped out the entire House of Ba’sha,in accordance with the word of YHWH which he had spoken regarding Ba’sha, by the hand of Yehu the prophet,

verses.hebrew: אֶל כָּל־חַטֹּאות בַּעְשָׁא וְחַטֹּאות אֵלָה בְנוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטְאוּ וַאֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיאוּ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכְעִיס אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַבְלֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: because of all of Ba’sha’s sins and the sins of Ela his sonwhich they had sinned and which they had caused Israel to sin,provoking YHWH, the God of Israel, with their futilities, “vapor,” referring to other gods, who were viewed by the writers as insubstantial. The Heb. word hevel is used at the famous opening of Ecclesiastes, “Vanity of vanities” (KJV)..

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אֵלָה וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Ela, and all that he did—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Israel?

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ זִמְרִי שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בְּתִרְצָה וְהָעָם חֹנִים עַל־גִּבְּתוֹן אֲשֶׁר לַפְּלִשְׁתִּים׃
verses.english: In year twenty-seven of the years of Asa king of Judah,Zimri became king, for seven days in Tirtza.Now the fighting-people were encamped against Gibbeton, which belonged to the Philistines.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע הָעָם הַחֹנִים לֵאמֹר קָשַׁר זִמְרִי וְגַם הִכָּה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּמְלִכוּ כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־עָמְרִי שַׂר־צָבָא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃
verses.english: And the fighting-people who were encamped heard [tell], saying:Zimri has made a conspiracy, and he has even struck down the king!So all Israel made Omri, Commander of the Armed-Forces, king on that day in the camp.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלֶה עָמְרִי וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִגִּבְּתוֹן וַיָּצֻרוּ עַל־תִּרְצָה׃
verses.english: And Omri came up, and all Israel with him, from Gibbeton,and they besieged Tirtza.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת זִמְרִי כִּי־נִלְכְּדָה הָעִיר וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אַרְמוֹן בֵּית־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׂרֹף עָלָיו אֶת־בֵּית־מֶלֶךְ בָּאֵשׁ וַיָּמֹת׃
verses.english: It was, when Zimri saw that the city was taken,that he went to the citadel of the king’s house,and he burned down the king’s house with fire over himself, and so he died—

verses.hebrew: עַל־חטאתו [חַטֹּאתָיו] אֲשֶׁר חָטָא לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה לָלֶכֶת בְּדֶרֶךְ יָרָבְעָם וּבְחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְהַחֲטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: for the sins which he had sinned,doing what was evil in the eyes of YHWH,walking in the way of Yorov’am and in his sin which he did, to cause Israel to sin.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי זִמְרִי וְקִשְׁרוֹ אֲשֶׁר קָשָׁר הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Zimri, and his conspiracy that he conspired—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Israel?

verses.hebrew: אָז יֵחָלֵק הָעָם יִשְׂרָאֵל לַחֵצִי חֲצִי הָעָם הָיָה אַחֲרֵי תִבְנִי בֶן־גִּינַת לְהַמְלִיכוֹ וְהַחֲצִי אַחֲרֵי עָמְרִי׃
verses.english: Then the people Israel were split in half:half of the people were [following] after Tivni son of Ginat, to make him king,while half were after Omri.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּחֱזַק הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵי עָמְרִי אֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵי תִּבְנִי בֶן־גִּינַת וַיָּמָת תִּבְנִי וַיִּמְלֹךְ עָמְרִי׃
verses.english: But the people who were [following] after Omri were stronger than the people who were [following] after Tivni son of Ginat.Then Tivni died, and Omri became king.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ עָמְרִי עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בְּתִרְצָה מָלַךְ שֵׁשׁ־שָׁנִים׃
verses.english: In year thirty-one of the years of Asa king of Judah,Omri became king over Israel, for twelve years;in Tirtza he reigned as king for six years.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקֶן אֶת־הָהָר שֹׁמְרוֹן מֵאֶת שֶׁמֶר בְּכִכְּרַיִם כָּסֶף וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הָהָר וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שֵׁם הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה עַל שֶׁם־שֶׁמֶר אֲדֹנֵי הָהָר שֹׁמְרוֹן׃
verses.english: He acquired the Hill Shomeron from Shemer, for two talents of silverand built up the hilland called the name of the city that he built after the name of Shemer, owner of the Hill Shomeron.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשֶׂה עָמְרִי הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וַיָּרַע מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר לְפָנָיו׃
verses.english: And Omri did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH;he did evil more than all who were before him:

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכָל־דֶּרֶךְ יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט ובחטאתיו [וּבְחַטָּאתוֹ] אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכְעִיס אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַבְלֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: he walked in all the way of Yorov’am son of Nevat, and in his sin which he caused Israel to sin,provoking YHWH, the God of Israel, with their futilities.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי עָמְרִי אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Omri that he did, and his mighty-deeds that he did—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Israel?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב עָמְרִי עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ אַחְאָב בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Omri lay beside his fathers;they buried him in Shomeron,and Ah’av trad. English “Ahab.” The name combines two words that mean “father” and “brother,” or “kinsman,” but which in proper names often are taken to indicate a god. his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחְאָב בֶּן־עָמְרִי מָלַךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ אַחְאָב בֶּן־עָמְרִי עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה׃
verses.english: Now Ah’av son of Omri became king over Israelin year thirty-eight of the years of Asa king of Judah;Ah’av son of Omri reigned as king over Israel in Shomeron for twenty-two years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אַחְאָב בֶּן־עָמְרִי הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר לְפָנָיו׃
verses.english: And Ah’av son of Omri did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH,more than all who were before him.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הֲנָקֵל לֶכְתּוֹ בְּחַטֹּאות יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט וַיִּקַּח אִשָּׁה אֶת־אִיזֶבֶל בַּת־אֶתְבַּעַל מֶלֶךְ צִידֹנִים וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַבַּעַל וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לוֹ׃
verses.english: And as if it were a light matter, his walking in the sins of Yorov’am son of Nevat,he took as wife Izevel), like I-Khavod in I Sam. 4:21, may be a negative judgment in Hebrew (lit., “Where is the Exalted One?”). Cogan (2001) understands it as a standard West Semitic “Zebul [Baal] Exists.” The trad. English is “Jezebel.” daughter of Etbaal king of the Sidonians,and he went and served Baal, bowing down to him;

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם מִזְבֵּחַ לַבָּעַל בֵּית הַבַּעַל אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃
verses.english: he raised up a sacrificial-altar to Baalat the House of Baal, which he built in Shomeron.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אַחְאָב אֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרָה וַיּוֹסֶף אַחְאָב לַעֲשׂוֹת לְהַכְעִיס אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לְפָנָיו׃
verses.english: And Ah’av made the Ashera-pole.Ah’av continued to do [much] to provoke YHWH, the God of Israel,more than all the kings of Israel who were before him.

verses.hebrew: בְּיָמָיו בָּנָה חִיאֵל בֵּית הָאֱלִי אֶת־יְרִיחֹה בַּאֲבִירָם בְּכֹרוֹ יִסְּדָהּ ובשגיב [וּבִשְׂגוּב] צְעִירוֹ הִצִּיב דְּלָתֶיהָ כִּדְבַר יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן׃
verses.english: In his days, Hi’el the Bet-Elite rebuilt Jericho—with Aviram his firstborn he laid-its-foundation,and with Seguv his youngest he set up its doors,in accordance with the word of YHWH that he had spoken by the hand of Yehoshua son of Nun.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּי מִתֹּשָׁבֵי גִלְעָד אֶל־אַחְאָב חַי־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר עָמַדְתִּי לְפָנָיו אִם־יִהְיֶה הַשָּׁנִים הָאֵלֶּה טַל וּמָטָר כִּי אִם־לְפִי דְבָרִי׃
verses.english: Eliyyahu trad. English “Elijah.” /YHWH Is My God, the Tishbite, of the settled-folk of Gil’ad (“Tishbite”) also resembles toshavei, the “settled-folk” of the verse. , said to Ah’av:By the life of YHWH, the God of Israel, before whom I stand,if there be dew or rain during these years except at my word … !

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: And the word of YHWH [came] to him, saying:

verses.hebrew: לֵךְ מִזֶּה וּפָנִיתָ לְּךָ קֵדְמָה וְנִסְתַּרְתָּ בְּנַחַל כְּרִית אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן׃
verses.english: Go from hereand face you eastward;you are to hide in Wadi Kerit/ Cut Off which faces the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה מֵהַנַּחַל תִּשְׁתֶּה וְאֶת־הָעֹרְבִים צִוִּיתִי לְכַלְכֶּלְךָ שָׁם׃
verses.english: And it will be: from the wadi you will drink,while I have charged ravens to sustain you there.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּעַשׂ כִּדְבַר יְהוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּנַחַל כְּרִית אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן׃
verses.english: So he went and did according to the word of YHWH:he went and stayed in the Wadi Kerit which faces the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וְהָעֹרְבִים מְבִיאִים לוֹ לֶחֶם וּבָשָׂר בַּבֹּקֶר וְלֶחֶם וּבָשָׂר בָּעָרֶב וּמִן־הַנַּחַל יִשְׁתֶּה׃
verses.english: And the ravens were bringing him bread and meat in the morningand bread and meat in the evening,while from the wadi he would drink.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ יָמִים וַיִּיבַשׁ הַנָּחַל כִּי לֹא־הָיָה גֶשֶׁם בָּאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: But it was at the end of some days that the wadi dried up,for there had been no rain-showers in the land.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: Then the word of YHWH [came] to him, saying:

verses.hebrew: קוּם לֵךְ צָרְפַתָה אֲשֶׁר לְצִידוֹן וְיָשַׁבְתָּ שָׁם הִנֵּה צִוִּיתִי שָׁם אִשָּׁה אַלְמָנָה לְכַלְכְּלֶךָ׃
verses.english: Arise, go to Tzarefat. A town located a few miles south of Sidon, today in Lebanon. that belongs to Sidon:you are to stay there,[for] here, I have charged a widow woman there to sustain you.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם וַיֵּלֶךְ צָרְפַתָה וַיָּבֹא אֶל־פֶּתַח הָעִיר וְהִנֵּה־שָׁם אִשָּׁה אַלְמָנָה מְקֹשֶׁשֶׁת עֵצִים וַיִּקְרָא אֵלֶיהָ וַיֹּאמַר קְחִי־נָא לִי מְעַט־מַיִם בַּכְּלִי וְאֶשְׁתֶּה׃
verses.english: So he arose and went to Tzarefat;he came to the entrance of the town,and here: a widow woman there was gathering [pieces of] wood.He called to her and said:Pray fetch me a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶךְ לָקַחַת וַיִּקְרָא אֵלֶיהָ וַיֹּאמַר לִקְחִי־נָא לִי פַּת־לֶחֶם בְּיָדֵךְ׃
verses.english: She went to fetch it,and he called to her and said:Pray fetch me a bit of bread in your hand.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר חַי־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אִם־יֶשׁ־לִי מָעוֹג כִּי אִם־מְלֹא כַף־קֶמַח בַּכַּד וּמְעַט־שֶׁמֶן בַּצַּפָּחַת וְהִנְנִי מְקֹשֶׁשֶׁת שְׁנַיִם עֵצִים וּבָאתִי וַעֲשִׂיתִיהוּ לִי וְלִבְנִי וַאֲכַלְנֻהוּ וָמָתְנוּ׃
verses.english: She said:By the life of YHWH your God,if I have anything bakedexcept a palmful of meal in a jarand a little oil in a jug …,for here, I have been gathering two pieces-of-wood;I will come home and make it for me and for my son,and we will eat it and die.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ אֵלִיָּהוּ אַל־תִּירְאִי בֹּאִי עֲשִׂי כִדְבָרֵךְ אַךְ עֲשִׂי־לִי מִשָּׁם עֻגָה קְטַנָּה בָרִאשֹׁנָה וְהוֹצֵאתְ לִי וְלָךְ וְלִבְנֵךְ תַּעֲשִׂי בָּאַחֲרֹנָה׃
verses.english: Eliyyahu said to her:Do not be afraid;go, do according to your words,but make me a small baked-cake from there first, and bring it out to me,while for you and for your son, make [some] afterward.

verses.hebrew: כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּד הַקֶּמַח לֹא תִכְלָה וְצַפַּחַת הַשֶּׁמֶן לֹא תֶחְסָר עַד יוֹם תתן־[תֵּת־] יְהוָה גֶּשֶׁם עַל־פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃
verses.english: For thus says YHWH, the God of Israel:The jar of meal will not be finishedand the jug of oil will not be lackinguntil the day of YHWH’s giving showers upon the face of the ground!

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתַּעֲשֶׂה כִּדְבַר אֵלִיָּהוּ וַתֹּאכַל הוא־והיא [הִיא־] [וָהוּא] וּבֵיתָהּ יָמִים׃
verses.english: She went and did according to the word of Eliyyahu,and she ate, she and he and her household, for some days.

verses.hebrew: כַּד הַקֶּמַח לֹא כָלָתָה וְצַפַּחַת הַשֶּׁמֶן לֹא חָסֵר כִּדְבַר יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד אֵלִיָּהוּ׃
verses.english: The jar of meal was not finishedand the jug of oil was not lacking,according to the word of YHWH that he had spoken by the hand of Eliyyahu.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה חָלָה בֶּן־הָאִשָּׁה בַּעֲלַת הַבָּיִת וַיְהִי חָלְיוֹ חָזָק מְאֹד עַד אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נוֹתְרָה־בּוֹ נְשָׁמָה׃
verses.english: Now after these events it wasthat he became sick,the son of the woman, the mistress of the house.And his sickness was exceedingly strong,until no breath was left in him here, it is neshama)..

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ מַה־לִּי וָלָךְ אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים בָּאתָ אֵלַי לְהַזְכִּיר אֶת־עֲוֺנִי וּלְהָמִית אֶת־בְּנִי׃
verses.english: She said to Eliyyahu:What have I to do with you, O man of God?You have come to me to bring my iniquity to mind, to cause the death of my son!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ תְּנִי־לִי אֶת־בְּנֵךְ וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ מֵחֵיקָהּ וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ אֶל־הָעֲלִיָּה אֲשֶׁר־הוּא יֹשֵׁב שָׁם וַיַּשְׁכִּבֵהוּ עַל־מִטָּתוֹ׃
verses.english: He said to her:Give me your son.And he took him from her bosom and brought him up to the upper room, where he was staying,and had him lie on his bed;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי הֲגַם עַל־הָאַלְמָנָה אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי מִתְגּוֹרֵר עִמָּהּ הֲרֵעוֹתָ לְהָמִית אֶת־בְּנָהּ׃
verses.english: then he called out to YHWH, and said:O YHWH my God,upon the very widow with whom I am lodgingwill you bring evil, to cause the death of her son?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְמֹדֵד עַל־הַיֶּלֶד שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי תָּשָׁב נָא נֶפֶשׁ־הַיֶּלֶד הַזֶּה עַל־קִרְבּוֹ׃
verses.english: And he measured himself out upon the child, three times,and called out to YHWH, and said:O YHWH my God,pray let the life of this child return within him!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהוָה בְּקוֹל אֵלִיָּהוּ וַתָּשָׁב נֶפֶשׁ־הַיֶּלֶד עַל־קִרְבּוֹ וַיֶּחִי׃
verses.english: And YHWH hearkened to the voice of Eliyyahu;the life of the child returned within him, so that he lived.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶת־הַיֶּלֶד וַיֹּרִדֵהוּ מִן־הָעֲלִיָּה הַבַּיְתָה וַיִּתְּנֵהוּ לְאִמּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ רְאִי חַי בְּנֵךְ׃
verses.english: Then Eliyyahu took the childand brought him down from the upper-room into the house,and gave him to his mother.Eliyyahu said:See, your son is alive!

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ עַתָּה זֶה יָדַעְתִּי כִּי אִישׁ אֱלֹהִים אָתָּה וּדְבַר־יְהוָה בְּפִיךָ אֱמֶת׃
verses.english: The woman said to Eliyyahu:Now indeed I knowthat you are a man of God,and that the word of YHWH in your mouth is truth!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי יָמִים רַבִּים וּדְבַר־יְהוָה הָיָה אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ בַּשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁלִישִׁית לֵאמֹר לֵךְ הֵרָאֵה אֶל־אַחְאָב וְאֶתְּנָה מָטָר עַל־פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃
verses.english: Now it was many days [later]that the word of YHWH [came] to Eliyyahuin the third year, saying,Go, appear to Ah’av,that I may give rain upon the face of the ground.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ אֵלִיָּהוּ לְהֵרָאוֹת אֶל־אַחְאָב וְהָרָעָב חָזָק בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃
verses.english: So Eliyyahu went to appear to Ah’av.—Now the famine was strong in Shomeron.—

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אַחְאָב אֶל־עֹבַדְיָהוּ אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַבָּיִת וְעֹבַדְיָהוּ הָיָה יָרֵא אֶת־יְהוָה מְאֹד׃
verses.english: And Ah’av called for Ovadyahu trad. English “Obadiah.” /Servant of YHWH, [The One] Over the Household,—now Ovadyahu held YHWH in awe exceedingly;

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּהַכְרִית אִיזֶבֶל אֵת נְבִיאֵי יְהוָה וַיִּקַּח עֹבַדְיָהוּ מֵאָה נְבִאִים וַיַּחְבִּיאֵם חֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ בַּמְּעָרָה וְכִלְכְּלָם לֶחֶם וָמָיִם׃
verses.english: it was, when Izevel cut off the prophets of YHWH,that Ovadyahu had taken a hundred prophetsand had hidden them, fifty men in a cave, and sustained them with bread and water—

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַחְאָב אֶל־עֹבַדְיָהוּ לֵךְ בָּאָרֶץ אֶל־כָּל־מַעְיְנֵי הַמַּיִם וְאֶל כָּל־הַנְּחָלִים אוּלַי נִמְצָא חָצִיר וּנְחַיֶּה סוּס וָפֶרֶד וְלוֹא נַכְרִית מֵהַבְּהֵמָה׃
verses.english: and Ah’av said to Ovadyahu:Come, let us cross through the land, to all the springs of water and to all the wadis.Perhaps we will find some green grass, that we may keep horse and mule alive,and will not have to cut off [any] of the animals.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחַלְּקוּ לָהֶם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לַעֲבָר־בָּהּ אַחְאָב הָלַךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אֶחָד לְבַדּוֹ וְעֹבַדְיָהוּ הָלַךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ־אֶחָד לְבַדּוֹ׃
verses.english: So they divided the land between them, to cross through it:Ah’av went on one road alone,and Ovadyahu went on another road alone.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי עֹבַדְיָהוּ בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְהִנֵּה אֵלִיָּהוּ לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיַּכִּרֵהוּ וַיִּפֹּל עַל־פָּנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הַאַתָּה זֶה אֲדֹנִי אֵלִיָּהוּ׃
verses.english: Now when Ovadyahu was on the road:here was Eliyyahu, [coming] to meet him!He recognized him, flung himself on his face and said:Is it really you, my lord Eliyyahu?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אָנִי לֵךְ אֱמֹר לַאדֹנֶיךָ הִנֵּה אֵלִיָּהוּ׃
verses.english: He said to him:[It is] I.Go, say to your lord: Eliyyahu is here!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה חָטָאתִי כִּי־אַתָּה נֹתֵן אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ בְּיַד־אַחְאָב לַהֲמִיתֵנִי׃
verses.english: But he said:How have I sinned,that you are giving your servant into the hand of Ah’av, to cause my death?

verses.hebrew: חַי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אִם־יֶשׁ־גּוֹי וּמַמְלָכָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁלַח אֲדֹנִי שָׁם לְבַקֶּשְׁךָ וְאָמְרוּ אָיִן וְהִשְׁבִּיעַ אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה וְאֶת־הַגּוֹי כִּי לֹא יִמְצָאֶכָּה׃
verses.english: By the life of YHWH your God,if there be a nation or a kingdom where my lord has not sent there to seek you … ,and when they say: He is not [here],he makes the kingdom or the nation swear that they did not find you.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אַתָּה אֹמֵר לֵךְ אֱמֹר לַאדֹנֶיךָ הִנֵּה אֵלִיָּהוּ׃
verses.english: But now you say:Go, say to your lord: Eliyyahu is here!

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אֲנִי אֵלֵךְ מֵאִתָּךְ וְרוּחַ יְהוָה יִשָּׂאֲךָ עַל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־אֵדָע וּבָאתִי לְהַגִּיד לְאַחְאָב וְלֹא יִמְצָאֲךָ וַהֲרָגָנִי וְעַבְדְּךָ יָרֵא אֶת־יְהוָה מִנְּעֻרָי׃
verses.english: It will bethat I will go from you,and the rushing-spirit can mean both “spirit” and “wind,” so the concept is quite a physical one. Eliyyahu appears to move about quickly, “like the wind.” of YHWH will carry you to I know not where,and I will come to tell Ah’av, and he will not find you—so he will kill me!Yet your servant has held YHWH in awe since my youth.

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־הֻגַּד לַאדֹנִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתִי בַּהֲרֹג אִיזֶבֶל אֵת נְבִיאֵי יְהוָה וָאַחְבִּא מִנְּבִיאֵי יְהוָה מֵאָה אִישׁ חֲמִשִּׁים חֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ בַּמְּעָרָה וָאֲכַלְכְּלֵם לֶחֶם וָמָיִם׃
verses.english: Has it not been told to my lord what I did when Izevel was killing the prophets of YHWH:how I hid a hundred men of the prophets of YHWH,fifty men, fifty men [each] in a cave,and sustained them with bread and water?

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אַתָּה אֹמֵר לֵךְ אֱמֹר לַאדֹנֶיךָ הִנֵּה אֵלִיָּהוּ וַהֲרָגָנִי׃
verses.english: But now you say:Go, say to your lord: Eliyyahu is here!So he will kill me!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ חַי יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָמַדְתִּי לְפָנָיו כִּי הַיּוֹם אֵרָאֶה אֵלָיו׃
verses.english: Eliyyahu said:By the life of YHWH of the Forces-On-High, before whom I stand,indeed, today I will appear to him!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ עֹבַדְיָהוּ לִקְרַאת אַחְאָב וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחְאָב לִקְרַאת אֵלִיָּהוּ׃
verses.english: So Ovadyahu went to meet Ah’av, and he told him,and Ah’av went to meet Eliyyahu.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת אַחְאָב אֶת־אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אַחְאָב אֵלָיו הַאַתָּה זֶה עֹכֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And it was, when Ah’av saw Eliyyahu,that Ah’av said to him:Is this you, bringer-of-disaster on Israel?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא עָכַרְתִּי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי אִם־אַתָּה וּבֵית אָבִיךָ בַּעֲזָבְכֶם אֶת־מִצְוֺת יְהוָה וַתֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵי הַבְּעָלִים׃
verses.english: He said:I have not brought-disaster on Israel,but rather you and your Father’s House,in that you have abandoned YHWH’s commandmentsand have walked after the Baals!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שְׁלַח קְבֹץ אֵלַי אֶת־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַר הַכַּרְמֶל וְאֶת־נְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים וּנְבִיאֵי הָאֲשֵׁרָה אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אֹכְלֵי שֻׁלְחַן אִיזָבֶל׃
verses.english: So-now,send [messengers], gather all Israel to me at Mount Carmel,along with the prophets of Baal, four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of Ashera, four hundred,those eating at Izevel’s table.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַחְאָב בְּכָל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּקְבֹּץ אֶת־הַנְּבִיאִים אֶל־הַר הַכַּרְמֶל׃
verses.english: Ah’av sent [messengers] among all the Children of Israeland gathered the prophets at Mount Carmel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּשׁ אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶל־כָּל־הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר עַד־מָתַי אַתֶּם פֹּסְחִים עַל־שְׁתֵּי הַסְּעִפִּים אִם־יְהוָה הָאֱלֹהִים לְכוּ אַחֲרָיו וְאִם־הַבַּעַל לְכוּ אַחֲרָיו וְלֹא־עָנוּ הָעָם אֹתוֹ דָּבָר׃
verses.english: And Eliyyahu came close to all the people and said:How long will you hop on two branches?If YHWH is God, walk after him,and if Baal, walk after him!But the people did not answer him a word.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶל־הָעָם אֲנִי נוֹתַרְתִּי נָבִיא לַיהוָה לְבַדִּי וּנְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל אַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ׃
verses.english: Eliyyahu said to the people:I am left of the prophets of YHWH, myself alone,while the prophets of Baal are four hundred and fifty men.

verses.hebrew: וְיִתְּנוּ־לָנוּ שְׁנַיִם פָּרִים וְיִבְחֲרוּ לָהֶם הַפָּר הָאֶחָד וִינַתְּחֻהוּ וְיָשִׂימוּ עַל־הָעֵצִים וְאֵשׁ לֹא יָשִׂימוּ וַאֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה אֶת־הַפָּר הָאֶחָד וְנָתַתִּי עַל־הָעֵצִים וְאֵשׁ לֹא אָשִׂים׃
verses.english: Let two bulls be given us,and let them choose one bull for themselves,and let them section it and put it atop the wood,but fire they shall not put [on it].I will prepare the other bulland place it atop the wood,but fire I will not put [on it].

verses.hebrew: וּקְרָאתֶם בְּשֵׁם אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וַאֲנִי אֶקְרָא בְשֵׁם־יְהוָה וְהָיָה הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲנֶה בָאֵשׁ הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַן כָּל־הָעָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ טוֹב הַדָּבָר׃
verses.english: And you are to call on the name of your god,while I will call on the name of YHWH.And it will be:the god who answers with fire, he is God.All the people answered, they said: The matter is good!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לִנְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל בַּחֲרוּ לָכֶם הַפָּר הָאֶחָד וַעֲשׂוּ רִאשֹׁנָה כִּי אַתֶּם הָרַבִּים וְקִרְאוּ בְּשֵׁם אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְאֵשׁ לֹא תָשִׂימוּ׃
verses.english: Then Eliyyahu said to the prophets of Baal:Choose yourselves the one bull and prepare [it] first, for you are the many,and call upon the name of your god,but fire you are not to put [on it].

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־הַפָּר אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן לָהֶם וַיַּעֲשׂוּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְשֵׁם־הַבַּעַל מֵהַבֹּקֶר וְעַד־הַצָּהֳרַיִם לֵאמֹר הַבַּעַל עֲנֵנוּ וְאֵין קוֹל וְאֵין עֹנֶה וַיְפַסְּחוּ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃
verses.english: So they took the bull that he gave them and prepared [it],and they called upon the name of Baal, from daybreak until noon, saying:O Baal, answer us!But there was no voice, and no one answering.And they hopped all around the altar that they had prepared.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַצָּהֳרַיִם וַיְהַתֵּל בָּהֶם אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר קִרְאוּ בְקוֹל־גָּדוֹל כִּי־אֱלֹהִים הוּא כִּי שִׂיחַ וְכִי־שִׂיג לוֹ וְכִי־דֶרֶךְ לוֹ אוּלַי יָשֵׁן הוּא וְיִקָץ׃
verses.english: Now it was at noon, that Eliyyahu taunted them; he said:Call out in a great voice, for he is a god!Maybe he is busy—maybe “doing his business”— is thus understood as scatological, and fits nicely with the rest of the taunt.or maybe on the road for himself;perhaps he is asleep and will wake up!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל וַיִּתְגֹּדְדוּ כְּמִשְׁפָּטָם בַּחֲרָבוֹת וּבָרְמָחִים עַד־שְׁפָךְ־דָּם עֲלֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: So they called out in a great voiceand gashed themselves after their practice with swords and lances,until blood spilled out over them.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּעֲבֹר הַצָּהֳרַיִם וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ עַד לַעֲלוֹת הַמִּנְחָה וְאֵין־קוֹל וְאֵין־עֹנֶה וְאֵין קָשֶׁב׃
verses.english: And it was, when noon had passed, that they ranted on until the [time of the] offering up of the grain-gift,but there was no voice is also used as the conventional word for thunder (see the “voice of YHWH” in Ps. 29), and since Baal was worshipped as a storm/rain god, the wording here may be sarcastic (Fishbane)., no one answering, and no attention.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לְכָל־הָעָם גְּשׁוּ אֵלַי וַיִּגְּשׁוּ כָל־הָעָם אֵלָיו וַיְרַפֵּא אֶת־מִזְבַּח יְהוָה הֶהָרוּס׃
verses.english: Then Eliyyahu said to all the people:Come close to me!And all the people came close to him.He mended the wrecked altar of YHWH;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֵלִיָּהוּ שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה אֲבָנִים כְּמִסְפַּר שִׁבְטֵי בְנֵי־יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר הָיָה דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל יִהְיֶה שְׁמֶךָ׃
verses.english: then Eliyyahu took twelve stones, like the number of tribes of the Children of Yaakov,to whom the word of YHWH had [come], saying:Israel shall be your name!,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְנֶה אֶת־הָאֲבָנִים מִזְבֵּחַ בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה וַיַּעַשׂ תְּעָלָה כְּבֵית סָאתַיִם זֶרַע סָבִיב לַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃
verses.english: and he built the stones [into] an altar, to the name of YHWH,and made a channel [big enough] to house two sei’as The sei’a was a fairly large dry measure. of seed all around the altar;

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲרֹךְ אֶת־הָעֵצִים וַיְנַתַּח אֶת־הַפָּר וַיָּשֶׂם עַל־הָעֵצִים׃
verses.english: then he arranged the woodand sectioned the bulland placed it atop the wood,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מִלְאוּ אַרְבָּעָה כַדִּים מַיִם וְיִצְקוּ עַל־הָעֹלָה וְעַל־הָעֵצִים וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁנוּ וַיִּשְׁנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר שַׁלֵּשׁוּ וַיְשַׁלֵּשׁוּ׃
verses.english: and said:Fill four jugs with waterand pour it on the offering-up and on the wood.And he said:Double it! And they doubled it.And he said:Triple it! And they tripled it,

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ הַמַּיִם סָבִיב לַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְגַם אֶת־הַתְּעָלָה מִלֵּא־מָיִם׃
verses.english: so that water went all around the altar,and also the channel filled up with water.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּעֲלוֹת הַמִּנְחָה וַיִּגַּשׁ אֵלִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא וַיֹּאמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיִשְׂרָאֵל הַיּוֹם יִוָּדַע כִּי־אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַאֲנִי עַבְדֶּךָ ובדבריך [וּבִדְבָרְךָ] עָשִׂיתִי אֵת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃
verses.english: And it was, at the [time of] offering-up the grain-gift,that Eliyyahu the prophet came close and said:YHWH, God of Avraham, Yitzhak, and Yisrael,today let it be knownthat you are God in Israel, and that I am your servant,and that it is by your word that I have done all these things.

verses.hebrew: עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה עֲנֵנִי וְיֵדְעוּ הָעָם הַזֶּה כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה הָאֱלֹהִים וְאַתָּה הֲסִבֹּתָ אֶת־לִבָּם אֲחֹרַנִּית׃
verses.english: Answer me, O YHWH, answer me,that this people may know that you, O YHWH, are God,that you yourself have reversed their heart!

verses.hebrew: וַתִּפֹּל אֵשׁ־יְהוָה וַתֹּאכַל אֶת־הָעֹלָה וְאֶת־הָעֵצִים וְאֶת־הָאֲבָנִים וְאֶת־הֶעָפָר וְאֶת־הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר־בַּתְּעָלָה לִחֵכָה׃
verses.english: And fire of YHWH felland consumed the offering-up and the woodand the stones and the dust,and the water that was in the channel it licked up.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא כָּל־הָעָם וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ יְהוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים יְהוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: All the people saw,and they fell upon their faces, and said:YHWH, he is God! YHWH, he is God!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לָהֶם תִּפְשׂוּ אֶת־נְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל אִישׁ אַל־יִמָּלֵט מֵהֶם וַיִּתְפְּשׂוּם וַיּוֹרִדֵם אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶל־נַחַל קִישׁוֹן וַיִּשְׁחָטֵם שָׁם׃
verses.english: Eliyyahu said to them:Seize the prophets of Baal!Let not one of them escape!They seized them,and Eliyyahu brought them down to Wadi Kishonand slaughtered them there.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לְאַחְאָב עֲלֵה אֱכֹל וּשְׁתֵה כִּי־קוֹל הֲמוֹן הַגָּשֶׁם׃
verses.english: Then Eliyyahu said to Ah’av:Go up, eat and drink,for hark! here as in the Kayin and Hevel (Cain and Abel) story in Gen. 4:10, and elsewhere. Roaring showers!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלֶה אַחְאָב לֶאֱכֹל וְלִשְׁתּוֹת וְאֵלִיָּהוּ עָלָה אֶל־רֹאשׁ הַכַּרְמֶל וַיִּגְהַר אַרְצָה וַיָּשֶׂם פָּנָיו בֵּין ברכו [בִּרְכָּיו׃]
verses.english: So Ah’av went up to eat and to drink,while Eliyyahu went up to the top of the Carmel and crouched down to the groundand put his face between his knees.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־נַעֲרוֹ עֲלֵה־נָא הַבֵּט דֶּרֶךְ־יָם וַיַּעַל וַיַּבֵּט וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין מְאוּמָה וַיֹּאמֶר שֻׁב שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים׃
verses.english: Then he said to his serving-lad:Now go up and look in the direction of the sea.He went up and looked, and said:There is nothing.He said:Again, seven times.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּשְּׁבִעִית וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה־עָב קְטַנָּה כְּכַף־אִישׁ עֹלָה מִיָּם וַיֹּאמֶר עֲלֵה אֱמֹר אֶל־אַחְאָב אֱסֹר וָרֵד וְלֹא יַעַצָרְכָה הַגָּשֶׁם׃
verses.english: And it was, at the seventh, that he said:Here, a small cloud like a man’s palm is coming up from the sea!He said: Go up, say to Ah’av: Get harnessed and go down, so that the showers do not stop you!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי עַד־כֹּה וְעַד־כֹּה וְהַשָּׁמַיִם הִתְקַדְּרוּ עָבִים וְרוּחַ וַיְהִי גֶּשֶׁם גָּדוֹל וַיִּרְכַּב אַחְאָב וַיֵּלֶךְ יִזְרְעֶאלָה׃
verses.english: And it was by then, by thenthat the heavens became gloomy with clouds and wind,and there were heavy showers;so Ah’av mounted up and went to Yizre’el.

verses.hebrew: וְיַד־יְהוָה הָיְתָה אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיְשַׁנֵּס מָתְנָיו וַיָּרָץ לִפְנֵי אַחְאָב עַד־בֹּאֲכָה יִזְרְעֶאלָה׃
verses.english: And the hand of YHWH was upon Eliyyahu:he bound up his loins and ran ahead of Ah’avas far as where you come to Yizre’el.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֵּד אַחְאָב לְאִיזֶבֶל אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֵלִיָּהוּ וְאֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר הָרַג אֶת־כָּל־הַנְּבִיאִים בֶּחָרֶב׃
verses.english: And Ah’av told Izevelall that Eliyyahu had done,and above all, that he had killed all the prophets with the sword.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּשְׁלַח אִיזֶבֶל מַלְאָךְ אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ לֵאמֹר כֹּה־יַעֲשׂוּן אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִפוּן כִּי־כָעֵת מָחָר אָשִׂים אֶת־נַפְשְׁךָ כְּנֶפֶשׁ אַחַד מֵהֶם׃
verses.english: So Izevel sent a messenger to Eliyyahu, saying:Thus may the gods do, and thus may they add,for by this time tomorrow I will make your life like the life of one of them!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא וַיָּקָם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־נַפְשׁוֹ וַיָּבֹא בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה וַיַּנַּח אֶת־נַעֲרוֹ שָׁם׃
verses.english: He was afraid, so he arose and went away for his life,and he came to Be’er-Sheva that belongs to Judah,and left his serving-lad there,

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא־הָלַךְ בַּמִּדְבָּר דֶּרֶךְ יוֹם וַיָּבֹא וַיֵּשֶׁב תַּחַת רֹתֶם אחת [אֶחָד] וַיִּשְׁאַל אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ לָמוּת וַיֹּאמֶר רַב עַתָּה יְהוָה קַח נַפְשִׁי כִּי־לֹא־טוֹב אָנֹכִי מֵאֲבֹתָי׃
verses.english: while he himself went into the wilderness, a day’s journey.He came and sat down under a broom tree may simply be the indefinite article in northern biblical speech. As for the tree, commentators differ over whether this is a different bush than the one above, or some kind of textual error.,and wished for his life to die;he said:Enough!Now, O YHWH,take my life,for I am no better than my fathers!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב וַיִּישַׁן תַּחַת רֹתֶם אֶחָד וְהִנֵּה־זֶה מַלְאָךְ נֹגֵעַ בּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ קוּם אֱכוֹל׃
verses.english: He lay down and fell asleep under a broom tree.And here, there was a messenger, “messenger.” touching him!He said to him:Get up, eat!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּבֵּט וְהִנֵּה מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו עֻגַת רְצָפִים וְצַפַּחַת מָיִם וַיֹּאכַל וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַיָּשָׁב וַיִּשְׁכָּב׃
verses.english: He looked,and here, at his head was a cake [baked on] glowing coals, and a jug of water.So he ate and drank, and returned to lie down.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה שֵׁנִית וַיִּגַּע־בּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר קוּם אֱכֹל כִּי רַב מִמְּךָ הַדָּרֶךְ׃
verses.english: And the messenger of YHWH returned a second-time and touched him,and said: Arise, eat!For the journey is too much for you.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם וַיֹּאכַל וַיִּשְׁתֶּה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכֹחַ הָאֲכִילָה הַהִיא אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לַיְלָה עַד הַר הָאֱלֹהִים חֹרֵב׃
verses.english: So he arose and ate and drank,and walked in the strength of that eating for forty days and forty nights,as far as the Mountain of God, Horev.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא־שָׁם אֶל־הַמְּעָרָה וַיָּלֶן שָׁם וְהִנֵּה דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מַה־לְּךָ פֹה אֵלִיָּהוּ׃
verses.english: He came there, to a cave cave of revelation to Moshe (see the “cleft of the rock” in Exod. 33:22)., and spent the night there.And here, the word of YHWH [came] to him;he said to him:What [brings] you here, Eliyyahu?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר קַנֹּא קִנֵּאתִי לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת כִּי־עָזְבוּ בְרִיתְךָ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתֶיךָ הָרָסוּ וְאֶת־נְבִיאֶיךָ הָרְגוּ בֶחָרֶב וָאִוָּתֵר אֲנִי לְבַדִּי וַיְבַקְשׁוּ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי לְקַחְתָּהּ׃
verses.english: He said:I have been zealous, yes, zealous for YHWH, the God of the Forces-On-High,for the Children of Israel have abandoned your covenant:your altars they have wreckedand your prophets they have killed with sword—while I am left, myself alone,and they have sought my life, to take it!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר צֵא וְעָמַדְתָּ בָהָר לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וְהִנֵּה יְהוָה עֹבֵר וְרוּחַ גְּדוֹלָה וְחָזָק מְפָרֵק הָרִים וּמְשַׁבֵּר סְלָעִים לִפְנֵי יְהוָה לֹא בָרוּחַ יְהוָה וְאַחַר הָרוּחַ רַעַשׁ לֹא בָרַעַשׁ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: He said:Go out and stand on the mountain, in the presence of YHWH.And here, YHWH was crossing by:now a great and strong wind was crushing mountains and smashing boulders in the presence of YHWH—YHWH was not in the wind;and after the wind, an earthquake—YHWH was not in the earthquake;

verses.hebrew: וְאַחַר הָרַעַשׁ אֵשׁ לֹא בָאֵשׁ יְהוָה וְאַחַר הָאֵשׁ קוֹל דְּמָמָה דַקָּה׃
verses.english: and after the earthquake, fire—YHWH was not in the fire;but after the fire,a still, small voice Levine suggests a usage of d-m-m that describes mourning or the like, and Simon (1997) notes a similar meaning in ancient versions; I therefore contemplated using “a mild murmuring voice.” But the King James Version’s “a still, small voice” has never been surpassed, and retains much of the mystery and ambiguity of the Hebrew, in which the prophetic experience encompasses both awestruck silence and speech. The genius of the King James translators is also on display here, since what they inherited from their great predecessor, WilliamTyndale (whose translation informs the bulk of their text), was “a small, still voice.”.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיָּלֶט פָּנָיו בְּאַדַּרְתּוֹ וַיֵּצֵא וַיַּעֲמֹד פֶּתַח הַמְּעָרָה וְהִנֵּה אֵלָיו קוֹל וַיֹּאמֶר מַה־לְּךָ פֹה אֵלִיָּהוּ׃
verses.english: It was, when Eliyyahu heard,that he wrapped his face in his mantleand went out and stood at the entrance to the cave.And here, there [came] to him a voice;it said: What [brings] you here, Eliyyahu?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר קַנֹּא קִנֵּאתִי לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת כִּי־עָזְבוּ בְרִיתְךָ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתֶיךָ הָרָסוּ וְאֶת־נְבִיאֶיךָ הָרְגוּ בֶחָרֶב וָאִוָּתֵר אֲנִי לְבַדִּי וַיְבַקְשׁוּ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי לְקַחְתָּהּ׃
verses.english: He said:I have been zealous, yes, zealous for YHWH, God of the Forces-On-High,for the Children of Israel have abandoned your covenant:your altars they have wreckedand your prophets they have killed with the sword—while I am left, myself alone,and they have sought my life, to take it!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלָיו לֵךְ שׁוּב לְדַרְכְּךָ מִדְבַּרָה דַמָּשֶׂק וּבָאתָ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת־חֲזָאֵל לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־אֲרָם׃
verses.english: YHWH said to him:Go, return on your way, toward the Wilderness of Damascus;when you come [there], you are to anoint Hazael as king over Aram,

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת יֵהוּא בֶן־נִמְשִׁי תִּמְשַׁח לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת־אֱלִישָׁע בֶּן־שָׁפָט מֵאָבֵל מְחוֹלָה תִּמְשַׁח לְנָבִיא תַּחְתֶּיךָ׃
verses.english: and Yehu son of Nimshi you are to anoint The name means “My God Delivers.” as king over Israel,while Elisha son of Shafat, from Evel-Mehola, you are to anoint as prophet in your place.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הַנִּמְלָט מֵחֶרֶב חֲזָאֵל יָמִית יֵהוּא וְהַנִּמְלָט מֵחֶרֶב יֵהוּא יָמִית אֱלִישָׁע׃
verses.english: Now it shall be: he who escapes from the sword of Hazael, Yehu will put to death,and he who escapes from the sword of Yehu, Elisha will put to death!

verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁאַרְתִּי בְיִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים כָּל־הַבִּרְכַּיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־כָרְעוּ לַבַּעַל וְכָל־הַפֶּה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נָשַׁק לוֹ׃
verses.english: But I will allow seven thousand to remain in Israel—every [one of] the knees that has not bent to Baaland every mouth that has not kissed him!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם וַיִּמְצָא אֶת־אֱלִישָׁע בֶּן־שָׁפָט וְהוּא חֹרֵשׁ שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר צְמָדִים לְפָנָיו וְהוּא בִּשְׁנֵים הֶעָשָׂר וַיַּעֲבֹר אֵלִיָּהוּ אֵלָיו וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ אַדַּרְתּוֹ אֵלָיו׃
verses.english: He went from there and found Elisha son of Shafat,—now he was plowing with twelve teams [of oxen] in front of him,while he was with the twelfth—and Eliyyahu crossed over to him and threw his mantle over him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲזֹב אֶת־הַבָּקָר וַיָּרָץ אַחֲרֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶשְּׁקָה־נָּא לְאָבִי וּלְאִמִּי וְאֵלְכָה אַחֲרֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֵךְ שׁוּב כִּי מֶה־עָשִׂיתִי לָךְ׃
verses.english: He left the oxen and ran after Eliyyahu,and said:Now let me kiss my father and my mother [good-bye];then I will go after you.He said to him:Go, turn back!For what have I done to you?

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב מֵאַחֲרָיו וַיִּקַּח אֶת־צֶמֶד הַבָּקָר וַיִּזְבָּחֵהוּ וּבִכְלִי הַבָּקָר בִּשְּׁלָם הַבָּשָׂר וַיִּתֵּן לָעָם וַיֹּאכֵלוּ וַיָּקָם וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיְשָׁרְתֵהוּ׃
verses.english: He turned back from [going] after himand took a team of oxen and slaughtered it,and in the vessel [intended] for the oxen he boiled them, the meat;he gave it to the people and they ate it.Then he arose and went after Eliyyahu, and attended him.

verses.hebrew: וּבֶן־הֲדַד מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם קָבַץ אֶת־כָּל־חֵילוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁנַיִם מֶלֶךְ אִתּוֹ וְסוּס וָרָכֶב וַיַּעַל וַיָּצַר עַל־שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּלָּחֶם בָּהּ׃
verses.english: Now Ben-Hadad king of Aram gathered his entire army—thirty-two kings with him, and horses and chariots—and went up and besieged Shomeron, and did battle against it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל־אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל הָעִירָה׃
verses.english: He sent messengers to Ah’av king of Israel in the city;

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ כֹּה אָמַר בֶּן־הֲדַד כַּסְפְּךָ וּזְהָבְךָ לִי־הוּא וְנָשֶׁיךָ וּבָנֶיךָ הַטּוֹבִים לִי־הֵם׃
verses.english: he said to him:Thus says Ben-Hadad:Your silver and your gold—it is mine,your women and your children, the best ones—they are mine!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר כִּדְבָרְךָ אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ לְךָ אֲנִי וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־לִי׃
verses.english: The king of Israel answered, he said:According to your word, my lord king:I am yours and all that I have.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים וַיֹּאמְרוּ כֹּה־אָמַר בֶּן־הֲדַד לֵאמֹר כִּי־שָׁלַחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר כַּסְפְּךָ וּזְהָבְךָ וְנָשֶׁיךָ וּבָנֶיךָ לִי תִתֵּן׃
verses.english: The messengers returned and said:Thus says Ben-Hadad, saying:Indeed, I sent to you, saying:Your silver and your gold, your women and your children, to me you must give them!

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־כָּעֵת מָחָר אֶשְׁלַח אֶת־עֲבָדַי אֵלֶיךָ וְחִפְּשׂוּ אֶת־בֵּיתְךָ וְאֵת בָּתֵּי עֲבָדֶיךָ וְהָיָה כָּל־מַחְמַד עֵינֶיךָ יָשִׂימוּ בְיָדָם וְלָקָחוּ׃
verses.english: But at this time tomorrow I will send my servants to you;they will search your house and the houses of your servants,and it will be: everything delightful in your eyesthey will put in their hand and they will take.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְכָל־זִקְנֵי הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּאמֶר דְּעוּ־נָא וּרְאוּ כִּי רָעָה זֶה מְבַקֵּשׁ כִּי־שָׁלַח אֵלַי לְנָשַׁי וּלְבָנַי וּלְכַסְפִּי וְלִזְהָבִי וְלֹא מָנַעְתִּי מִמֶּנּוּ׃
verses.english: The king of Israel called for all the elders of the landand said:Now know and take-note that this one is seeking evil,for he sent to me for my women and for my children, for my silver and for my gold,yet I kept back nothing from him!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו כָּל־הַזְּקֵנִים וְכָל־הָעָם אַל־תִּשְׁמַע וְלוֹא תֹאבֶה׃
verses.english: Then all the elders and all the people said to him:Do not listen,you must not consent!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְמַלְאֲכֵי בֶן־הֲדַד אִמְרוּ לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַחְתָּ אֶל־עַבְדְּךָ בָרִאשֹׁנָה אֶעֱשֶׂה וְהַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לֹא אוּכַל לַעֲשׂוֹת וַיֵּלְכוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים וַיְשִׁבֻהוּ דָּבָר׃
verses.english: So he said to the messengers of Ben-Hadad:Say to my lord king:Every matter about which you first sent to your servant, I will do,but this matter I am not able to do!So the messengers went off, and returned word to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵלָיו בֶּן־הֲדַד וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־יַעֲשׂוּן לִי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִפוּ אִם־יִשְׂפֹּק עֲפַר שֹׁמְרוֹן לִשְׁעָלִים לְכָל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר בְּרַגְלָי׃
verses.english: And Ben-Hadad sent to himand said:Thus may the gods do to me, and thus may they add,if the dust of Shomeron suffices for handfuls for all the fighting-people who are behind me!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר דַּבְּרוּ אַל־יִתְהַלֵּל חֹגֵר כִּמְפַתֵּחַ׃
verses.english: The king of Israel answered,he said: Speak on;let not the one who buckles on boast like the one who strips off!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְהוּא שֹׁתֶה הוּא וְהַמְּלָכִים בַּסֻּכּוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־עֲבָדָיו שִׂימוּ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עַל־הָעִיר׃
verses.english: Now it was, when he heard this word—he was drinking, he and the [other] kings at Sukkot—that he said to his servants: Set [the attack]!So they set upon the city.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה נָבִיא אֶחָד נִגַּשׁ אֶל־אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה הְרָאִיתָ אֵת כָּל־הֶהָמוֹן הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה הִנְנִי נֹתְנוֹ בְיָדְךָ הַיּוֹם וְיָדַעְתָּ כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Now here, a prophet came close to Ah’av king of Israel, and said:Thus says YHWH:Do you see all this great throng?Here, I am giving it into your hand today,so that you may know that I am YHWH!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַחְאָב בְּמִי וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה בְּנַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר מִי־יֶאְסֹר הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיֹּאמֶר אָתָּה׃
verses.english: Ah’av said:Through whom?He said:Thus says YHWH:Through the squire-lads of the district commanders.He said:Who will bind up the battle-array?He said:You.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְקֹד אֶת־נַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת וַיִּהְיוּ מָאתַיִם שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וְאַחֲרֵיהֶם פָּקַד אֶת־כָּל־הָעָם כָּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים׃
verses.english: So he counted [for war] the squire-lads of the provincial commanders—they were two hundred two and thirty—and after them he counted all the fighting-people, all the Children of Israel, which LXX understands as benei hayil, “valiant ones.” : seven thousand.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ בַּצָּהֳרָיִם וּבֶן־הֲדַד שֹׁתֶה שִׁכּוֹר בַּסֻּכּוֹת הוּא וְהַמְּלָכִים שְׁלֹשִׁים־וּשְׁנַיִם מֶלֶךְ עֹזֵר אֹתוֹ׃
verses.english: And they went out at noon.Now Ben-Hadad was drinking himself drunk at Sukkot,he and the kings, thirty-two kings helping him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ נַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת בָּרִאשֹׁנָה וַיִּשְׁלַח בֶּן־הֲדַד וַיַּגִּידוּ לוֹ לֵאמֹר אֲנָשִׁים יָצְאוּ מִשֹּׁמְרוֹן׃
verses.english: And the squire-lads of the provincial commanders went out first;they sent [to] Ben-Hadadand told him, saying:Men have gone out from Shomeron!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם־לְשָׁלוֹם יָצָאוּ תִּפְשׂוּם חַיִּים וְאִם לְמִלְחָמָה יָצָאוּ חַיִּים תִּפְשׂוּם׃
verses.english: He said:If they have gone out for peace, seize them alive,and if it is for battle that they have gone out, alive seize them [too]!

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה יָצְאוּ מִן־הָעִיר נַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת וְהַחַיִל אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: But these went out from the city, the squires of the provincial commanders,along with the army that was behind them;

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכּוּ אִישׁ אִישׁוֹ וַיָּנֻסוּ אֲרָם וַיִּרְדְּפֵם יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמָּלֵט בֶּן־הֲדַד מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם עַל־סוּס וּפָרָשִׁים׃
verses.english: each man struck his man down,and they fled to Aram, while Israel pursued them.And Ben-Hadad king of Aram escaped on a horse, with cavalry.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַסּוּס וְאֶת־הָרָכֶב וְהִכָּה בַאֲרָם מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה׃
verses.english: The king of Israel went out and struck down horse and chariot;he struck Aram, a great striking-down.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּשׁ הַנָּבִיא אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֵךְ הִתְחַזַּק וְדַע וּרְאֵה אֵת אֲשֶׁר־תַּעֲשֶׂה כִּי לִתְשׁוּבַת הַשָּׁנָה מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם עֹלֶה עָלֶיךָ׃
verses.english: And the prophet came close to the king of Israel and said to him:Go, strengthen yourself;know and take-note of what you must do,for at the turn of the year, the king of Aram will go up against you.

verses.hebrew: וְעַבְדֵי מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם אָמְרוּ אֵלָיו אֱלֹהֵי הָרִים אֱלֹהֵיהֶם עַל־כֵּן חָזְקוּ מִמֶּנּוּ וְאוּלָם נִלָּחֵם אִתָּם בַּמִּישׁוֹר אִם־לֹא נֶחֱזַק מֵהֶם׃
verses.english: Now the servants of the king of Aram said to him:A god of the hills is their god,therefore they were stronger than we;but we should do battle with them in the plain[and see] if we aren’t stronger than they!

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה עֲשֵׂה הָסֵר הַמְּלָכִים אִישׁ מִמְּקֹמוֹ וְשִׂים פַּחוֹת תַּחְתֵּיהֶם׃
verses.english: And this thing, do:Remove the kings, each one from his place,and put governors in their steads;

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה תִמְנֶה־לְךָ חַיִל כַּחַיִל הַנֹּפֵל מֵאוֹתָךְ וְסוּס כַּסּוּס וְרֶכֶב כָּרֶכֶב וְנִלָּחֲמָה אוֹתָם בַּמִּישׁוֹר אִם־לֹא נֶחֱזַק מֵהֶם וַיִּשְׁמַע לְקֹלָם וַיַּעַשׂ כֵּן׃
