verses.english: while you, you are to number yourself an armylike the army fell away from you,horse like horse, chariot like chariot,that we may battle them in the plain,[and see] if we aren’t stronger than they!He hearkened to their voice, and did thus.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לִתְשׁוּבַת הַשָּׁנָה וַיִּפְקֹד בֶּן־הֲדַד אֶת־אֲרָם וַיַּעַל אֲפֵקָה לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: So it was, at the turn of the year,that Ben-Hadad counted Aram [for war],and he went up to Afek The name of several towns in the Bible. Gray (1970) understands this particular reference as a place east of Lake Tiberias, on the road to Damascus. for battle with Israel,

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָתְפָּקְדוּ וְכָלְכְּלוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ לִקְרָאתָם וַיַּחֲנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶגְדָּם כִּשְׁנֵי חֲשִׂפֵי עִזִּים וַאֲרָם מִלְאוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: while the Children of Israel were mustered and provided [with food]and went to meet them;the Children of Israel encamped over against themlike two bare flocks of goats,while Aram filled up the land.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּשׁ אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ אֲרָם אֱלֹהֵי הָרִים יְהוָה וְלֹא־אֱלֹהֵי עֲמָקִים הוּא וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־כָּל־הֶהָמוֹן הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה בְּיָדֶךָ וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And the man of God came close and said to the king of Israel, he said:Thus says YHWH:Because Aram said: A god of the hills is YHWH,he is not a god of the valleys—I will give all this great throng into your hand,so that you may know that I am YHWH!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲנוּ אֵלֶּה נֹכַח אֵלֶּה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַתִּקְרַב הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיַּכּוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־אֲרָם מֵאָה־אֶלֶף רַגְלִי בְּיוֹם אֶחָד׃
verses.english: They encamped, these opposite those, for seven days,and it was on the seventh day, that the battle came near;the Children of Israel struck down of Aram a hundred thousand foot-soldiers in one day.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּנֻסוּ הַנּוֹתָרִים אֲפֵקָה אֶל־הָעִיר וַתִּפֹּל הַחוֹמָה עַל־עֶשְׂרִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֶלֶף אִישׁ הַנּוֹתָרִים וּבֶן־הֲדַד נָס וַיָּבֹא אֶל־הָעִיר חֶדֶר בְּחָדֶר׃
verses.english: Those left fled to Afek, to the town,and the wall fell upon the twenty-seven thousand fighting-men who were left.Ben-Hadad [too] had fled, and he came into the town, into a room within a room.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו עֲבָדָיו הִנֵּה־נָא שָׁמַעְנוּ כִּי מַלְכֵי בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־מַלְכֵי חֶסֶד הֵם נָשִׂימָה נָּא שַׂקִּים בְּמָתְנֵינוּ וַחֲבָלִים בְּרֹאשֵׁנוּ וְנֵצֵא אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אוּלַי יְחַיֶּה אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ׃
verses.english: His servants said to him:Now here, we have heard that the kings of the House of Israel—indeed, they are kings [who keep] loyalty;now let us put sackcloth on our loins and cords on our heads,and let us go out [to surrender] to the king of Israel—perhaps he will spare your life.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחְגְּרוּ שַׂקִּים בְּמָתְנֵיהֶם וַחֲבָלִים בְּרָאשֵׁיהֶם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדְּךָ בֶן־הֲדַד אָמַר תְּחִי־נָא נַפְשִׁי וַיֹּאמֶר הַעוֹדֶנּוּ חַי אָחִי הוּא׃
verses.english: So they girded sackcloth on their loins and cords on their headsand came to the king of Israeland said:Your servant Ben-Hadad says:Pray spare my life!He said:Is he still alive? He is my brother!

verses.hebrew: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים יְנַחֲשׁוּ וַיְמַהֲרוּ וַיַּחְלְטוּ הֲמִמֶּנּוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אָחִיךָ בֶן־הֲדַד וַיֹּאמֶר בֹּאוּ קָחֻהוּ וַיֵּצֵא אֵלָיו בֶּן־הֲדַד וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ עַל־הַמֶּרְכָּבָה׃
verses.english: Now the men were practicing divination and quickly seized upon it,and said:Ben-Hadad is your brother!And he said:Come, fetch him!So Ben-Hadad went out to him, and he pulled him up into the chariot.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר־לָקַח־אָבִי מֵאֵת אָבִיךָ אָשִׁיב וְחוּצוֹת תָּשִׂים לְךָ בְדַמֶּשֶׂק כַּאֲשֶׁר־שָׂם אָבִי בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַאֲנִי בַּבְּרִית אֲשַׁלְּחֶךָּ וַיִּכְרָת־לוֹ בְרִית וַיְשַׁלְּחֵהוּ׃
verses.english: He said to him:The towns that my father took from your father, I return,and you may put bazaars in operation for yourself in Damascus,just as my father put in operation in Shomeron;while I, under [this] covenant I will send you free.So he cut a covenant with him, and sent him off.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֶחָד מִבְּנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים אָמַר אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ בִּדְבַר יְהוָה הַכֵּינִי נָא וַיְמָאֵן הָאִישׁ לְהַכֹּתוֹ׃
verses.english: Now a man from the Sons of the Prophets said to his neighbor:By the word of YHWH, pray strike me!But the man refused to strike him,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהוָה הִנְּךָ הוֹלֵךְ מֵאִתִּי וְהִכְּךָ הָאַרְיֵה וַיֵּלֶךְ מֵאֶצְלוֹ וַיִּמְצָאֵהוּ הָאַרְיֵה וַיַּכֵּהוּ׃
verses.english: so he said to him:Because you did not hearken to the voice of YHWH,here, when you go from me, a lion will strike you down!He went from beside him, and a lion found him and struck him down.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצָא אִישׁ אַחֵר וַיֹּאמֶר הַכֵּינִי נָא וַיַּכֵּהוּ הָאִישׁ הַכֵּה וּפָצֹעַ׃
verses.english: Then he found another man and said: Pray strike me!And the man struck him, striking and wounding [him].

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַנָּבִיא וַיַּעֲמֹד לַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הַדָּרֶךְ וַיִּתְחַפֵּשׂ בָּאֲפֵר עַל־עֵינָיו׃
verses.english: Then the prophet went and stood [waiting] for the king, by the road,and he disguised himself with a covering over his eyes.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַמֶּלֶךְ עֹבֵר וְהוּא צָעַק אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר עַבְדְּךָ יָצָא בְקֶרֶב־הַמִּלְחָמָה וְהִנֵּה־אִישׁ סָר וַיָּבֵא אֵלַי אִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמֹר אֶת־הָאִישׁ הַזֶּה אִם־הִפָּקֵד יִפָּקֵד וְהָיְתָה נַפְשְׁךָ תַּחַת נַפְשׁוֹ אוֹ כִכַּר־כֶּסֶף תִּשְׁקוֹל׃
verses.english: It was, as the king was crossing by,that he cried out to the king;he said:Your servant went out into the midst of the battle,when here, a man turned aside and brought a man to me,and he said: Guard this man—if he is counted-missing, yes, missing [later],it will be your life in place of his life,or else you will have to weigh out a talent of silver!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי עַבְדְּךָ עֹשֵׂה הֵנָּה וָהֵנָּה וְהוּא אֵינֶנּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל כֵּן מִשְׁפָּטֶךָ אַתָּה חָרָצְתָּ׃
verses.english: Now it was: your servant was facing here and there,and then he was no more!The king of Israel said to him:Correct is your judgment: you yourself have decided.

verses.hebrew: וַיְמַהֵר וַיָּסַר אֶת־הָאֲפֵר מעל [מֵעֲלֵי] עֵינָיו וַיַּכֵּר אֹתוֹ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי מֵהַנְּבִאִים הוּא׃
verses.english: Quickly he removed the covering from over his eyes,and the king of Israel recognized him,that he was of the prophets.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה יַעַן שִׁלַּחְתָּ אֶת־אִישׁ־חֶרְמִי מִיָּד וְהָיְתָה נַפְשְׁךָ תַּחַת נַפְשׁוֹ וְעַמְּךָ תַּחַת עַמּוֹ׃
verses.english: He said to him:Thus says YHWH:Because you sent free the man, one devoted-to-destruction by me, from [your] hand,it will be your life in place of his life,and your people in place of his people!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל־בֵּיתוֹ סַר וְזָעֵף וַיָּבֹא שֹׁמְרוֹנָה׃
verses.english: The king of Israel went back to his house sullen and enraged;thus he came to Shomeron.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה כֶּרֶם הָיָה לְנָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי אֲשֶׁר בְּיִזְרְעֶאל אֵצֶל הֵיכַל אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ שֹׁמְרוֹן׃
verses.english: Now after these events it was:A vineyard belonged to Navot trad. English “Naboth.” It may mean “shoot” (of a plant). The Bible frequently compares human mortality to the transitory nature of plant growth. the Yizre’elite that was in Yizre’el,next to the Great-House of Ah’av king in Shomeron.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אַחְאָב אֶל־נָבוֹת לֵאמֹר תְּנָה־לִּי אֶת־כַּרְמְךָ וִיהִי־לִי לְגַן־יָרָק כִּי הוּא קָרוֹב אֵצֶל בֵּיתִי וְאֶתְּנָה לְךָ תַּחְתָּיו כֶּרֶם טוֹב מִמֶּנּוּ אִם טוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֶתְּנָה־לְךָ כֶסֶף מְחִיר זֶה׃
verses.english: And Ah’av spoke to Navot, saying:Give me your vineyard, that it may be a garden of greens for me—for it is nearby, next to my house—and I will give you, in its place, a vineyard better than it;[or] if it is better in your eyes,I will give you silver for the price of this one.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר נָבוֹת אֶל־אַחְאָב חָלִילָה לִּי מֵיהוָה מִתִּתִּי אֶת־נַחֲלַת אֲבֹתַי לָךְ׃
verses.english: But Navot said to Ah’av:YHWH forbid for mefrom my giving over the inheritance of my fathers to you!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אַחְאָב אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ סַר וְזָעֵף עַל־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר אֵלָיו נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא־אֶתֵּן לְךָ אֶת־נַחֲלַת אֲבוֹתָי וַיִּשְׁכַּב עַל־מִטָּתוֹ וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־פָּנָיו וְלֹא־אָכַל לָחֶם׃
verses.english: Ah’av came back to his house sullen and enragedover the word that Navot the Yizre’elite had spoken to himwhen he said: I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers!He lay down on his couch and turned away his face and would not eat food.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא אֵלָיו אִיזֶבֶל אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלָיו מַה־זֶּה רוּחֲךָ סָרָה וְאֵינְךָ אֹכֵל לָחֶם׃
verses.english: And Izevel his wife came to himand spoke to him:Now why is your spirit so sullenthat you do not eat food?

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלֶיהָ כִּי־אֲדַבֵּר אֶל־נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי וָאֹמַר לוֹ תְּנָה־לִּי אֶת־כַּרְמְךָ בְּכֶסֶף אוֹ אִם־חָפֵץ אַתָּה אֶתְּנָה־לְךָ כֶרֶם תַּחְתָּיו וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא־אֶתֵּן לְךָ אֶת־כַּרְמִי׃
verses.english: He spoke to her:Because I spoke to Navot the Yizre’elite;I said to him:Give me your vineyard for silver,or, if you like,I will give you a vineyard in its place—yet he said: I will not give you my vineyard!

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אִיזֶבֶל אִשְׁתּוֹ אַתָּה עַתָּה תַּעֲשֶׂה מְלוּכָה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל קוּם אֱכָל־לֶחֶם וְיִטַב לִבֶּךָ אֲנִי אֶתֵּן לְךָ אֶת־כֶּרֶם נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי׃
verses.english: Izevel his wife said to him:Do you, now, exercise kingship over Israel?, now, exercise kingship over Israel?: JPS reads, “Now is the time to show yourself king,” but the Hebrew seems to imply a more sarcastic tone.Arise, eat food, that your heart may be in good-humor;I will give you the vineyard of Navot the Yizre’elite!

verses.hebrew: וַתִּכְתֹּב סְפָרִים בְּשֵׁם אַחְאָב וַתַּחְתֹּם בְּחֹתָמוֹ וַתִּשְׁלַח הספרים [סְפָרִים] אֶל־הַזְקֵנִים וְאֶל־הַחֹרִים אֲשֶׁר בְּעִירוֹ הַיֹּשְׁבִים אֶת־נָבוֹת׃
verses.english: So she wrote letters in Ah’av’s nameand sealed [them] with his seal,and sent the letters to the elders and the freemen who were in his town, those settled with Navot.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּכְתֹּב בַּסְּפָרִים לֵאמֹר קִרְאוּ־צוֹם וְהוֹשִׁיבוּ אֶת־נָבוֹת בְּרֹאשׁ הָעָם׃
verses.english: And she wrote in the letters, saying:Proclaim a fastand seat Navot at the head of the people;

verses.hebrew: וְהוֹשִׁיבוּ שְׁנַיִם אֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי־בְלִיַּעַל נֶגְדּוֹ וִיעִדֻהוּ לֵאמֹר בֵּרַכְתָּ אֱלֹהִים וָמֶלֶךְ וְהוֹצִיאֻהוּ וְסִקְלֻהוּ וְיָמֹת׃
verses.english: then seat two base men in front of him;have them testify against him, saying:You cursed God and the king!Then bring him out and pelt him, so that he dies.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אַנְשֵׁי עִירוֹ הַזְּקֵנִים וְהַחֹרִים אֲשֶׁר הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּעִירוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁלְחָה אֲלֵיהֶם אִיזָבֶל כַּאֲשֶׁר כָּתוּב בַּסְּפָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלְחָה אֲלֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: So they did, the men of his town—the elders and the freemen that were settled in his town—as Izevel had sent to them,as was written in the letters that she had sent to them:

verses.hebrew: קָרְאוּ צוֹם וְהֹשִׁיבוּ אֶת־נָבוֹת בְּרֹאשׁ הָעָם׃
verses.english: they proclaimed a fastand seated Navot at the head of the people,

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ שְׁנֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי־בְלִיַּעַל וַיֵּשְׁבוּ נֶגְדּוֹ וַיְעִדֻהוּ אַנְשֵׁי הַבְּלִיַּעַל אֶת־נָבוֹת נֶגֶד הָעָם לֵאמֹר בֵּרַךְ נָבוֹת אֱלֹהִים וָמֶלֶךְ וַיֹּצִאֻהוּ מִחוּץ לָעִיר וַיִּסְקְלֻהוּ בָאֲבָנִים וַיָּמֹת׃
verses.english: and the two base men came and sat in front of him;the base men testified against Navot, in front of the people,saying:Navot cursed God and the king!So they took him outside the townand pelted him with stones, and he died.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אֶל־אִיזֶבֶל לֵאמֹר סֻקַּל נָבוֹת וַיָּמֹת׃
verses.english: Then they sent to Izevel, saying:Navot has been pelted, and has died.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ אִיזֶבֶל כִּי־סֻקַּל נָבוֹת וַיָּמֹת וַתֹּאמֶר אִיזֶבֶל אֶל־אַחְאָב קוּם רֵשׁ אֶת־כֶּרֶם נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי אֲשֶׁר מֵאֵן לָתֶת־לְךָ בְכֶסֶף כִּי אֵין נָבוֹת חַי כִּי־מֵת׃
verses.english: Now it was, when Izevel heard that Navot had been pelted, and had died,that Izevel said to Ah’av:Arise, take possessionof the vineyard of Navot the Yizre’elitewhich he refused to give to you for silver,for Navot is not alive,for he is dead!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ אַחְאָב כִּי מֵת נָבוֹת וַיָּקָם אַחְאָב לָרֶדֶת אֶל־כֶּרֶם נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי לְרִשְׁתּוֹ׃
verses.english: It was, when Ah’av heard that Navot was dead,that Ah’av arose to go down to the vineyard of Navot the Yizre’elite, to take possession of it.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהוָה אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּי לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: But the word of YHWH [came] to Eliyyahu the Tishbite, saying:

verses.hebrew: קוּם רֵד לִקְרַאת אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן הִנֵּה בְּכֶרֶם נָבוֹת אֲשֶׁר־יָרַד שָׁם לְרִשְׁתּוֹ׃
verses.english: Arise, go downto meet Ah’av king of Israel who is in Shomeron:here, [he is] at the vineyard of Navot,where he has gone down to take possession of it.

verses.hebrew: וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה הֲרָצַחְתָּ וְגַם־יָרָשְׁתָּ וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר לָקְקוּ הַכְּלָבִים אֶת־דַּם נָבוֹת יָלֹקּוּ הַכְּלָבִים אֶת־דָּמְךָ גַּם־אָתָּה׃
verses.english: You are to speak to him, saying:Thus says YHWH:Murdered have you, and dispossessed too? I could not find a compact rhyme to echo the Hebrew. Note that y-r-sh, connoting possession, is a key root in the narrative (vv.15, 16, 18, and 26 as well).And you are to speak to him, saying:Thus says YHWH:In the place where the dogs have licked up the blood of Navotthe dogs will lick up your blood, even yours!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַחְאָב אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ הַמְצָאתַנִי אֹיְבִי וַיֹּאמֶר מָצָאתִי יַעַן הִתְמַכֶּרְךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Ah’av said to Eliyyahu:Have you found me, my enemy?He said:I have found [you]!Because you have sold yourselfto do what is evil in the eyes of YHWH,

verses.hebrew: הִנְנִי מבי [מֵבִיא] אֵלֶיךָ רָעָה וּבִעַרְתִּי אַחֲרֶיךָ וְהִכְרַתִּי לְאַחְאָב מַשְׁתִּין בְּקִיר וְעָצוּר וְעָזוּב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: here, I will bring evil upon youand will eradicate [those coming] after youand will cut off from Ah’av he who pisses against the wall,[even] the fettered and forsaken in Israel!

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־בֵּיתְךָ כְּבֵית יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט וּכְבֵית בַּעְשָׁא בֶן־אֲחִיָּה אֶל־הַכַּעַס אֲשֶׁר הִכְעַסְתָּ וַתַּחֲטִא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: I will give your house to belike the House of Yorov’am son of Nevat,like the House of Ba’sha son of Ahiyya,because of the provocation by which you have provoked [me]and caused Israel to sin.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם־לְאִיזֶבֶל דִּבֶּר יְהוָה לֵאמֹר הַכְּלָבִים יֹאכְלוּ אֶת־אִיזֶבֶל בְּחֵל יִזְרְעֶאל׃
verses.english: And also about Izevel YHWH has spoken, saying:The dogs will eat Izevelat the rampart as be-helek, “in the district,” with ancient versions. of Yizre’el!

verses.hebrew: הַמֵּת לְאַחְאָב בָּעִיר יֹאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים וְהַמֵּת בַּשָּׂדֶה יֹאכְלוּ עוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם׃
verses.english: He who dies of Ah’av in the townthe dogs shall eat,while he who dies in the open-fieldthe birds of the heavens shall eat!

verses.hebrew: רַק לֹא־הָיָה כְאַחְאָב אֲשֶׁר הִתְמַכֵּר לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר־הֵסַתָּה אֹתוֹ אִיזֶבֶל אִשְׁתּוֹ׃
verses.english: —Surely there was never [another] like Ah’av,who sold himself to do what was evil in the eyes of YHWH,whom Izevel his wife incited;

verses.hebrew: וַיַּתְעֵב מְאֹד לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרֵי הַגִּלֻּלִים כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: he did exceedingly abominably in walking after the Illicit-Things,exactly as the Amorites had done,whom YHWH had dispossessed before the Children of Israel.—

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ אַחְאָב אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיִּקְרַע בְּגָדָיו וַיָּשֶׂם־שַׂק עַל־בְּשָׂרוֹ וַיָּצוֹם וַיִּשְׁכַּב בַּשָּׂק וַיְהַלֵּךְ אַט׃
verses.english: Now it was, when Ah’av heard these words,that he tore his garments and put sackcloth upon his fleshand fasted,and lay down in sackcloth,and went around softly.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהוָה אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּי לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: And the word of YHWH [came] to Eliyyahu the Tishbite, saying:

verses.hebrew: הֲ‍רָאִיתָ כִּי־נִכְנַע אַחְאָב מִלְּפָנָי יַעַן כִּי־נִכְנַע מִפָּנַי לֹא־אבי [אָבִיא] הָרָעָה בְּיָמָיו בִּימֵי בְנוֹ אָבִיא הָרָעָה עַל־בֵּיתוֹ׃
verses.english: Do you see that Ah’av is humbling himself before me?Because he is humbling himself before me,I will not bring the evil in his days;in the days of his son I will bring the evil on his house.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים אֵין מִלְחָמָה בֵּין אֲרָם וּבֵין יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: They stayed put for three years,[since] there was no war between Aram and Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁלִישִׁית וַיֵּרֶד יְהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: But it was in the third yearthat Yehoshafat king of Judah went down to the king of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הַיְדַעְתֶּם כִּי־לָנוּ רָמֹת גִּלְעָד וַאֲנַחְנוּ מַחְשִׁים מִקַּחַת אֹתָהּ מִיַּד מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם׃
verses.english: The king of Israel said to his servants:Do you know that Ramot-Gil’ad is ours?Yet we keep silent about taking it from the king of Aram!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט הֲתֵלֵךְ אִתִּי לַמִּלְחָמָה רָמֹת גִּלְעָד וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּמוֹנִי כָמוֹךָ כְּעַמִּי כְעַמֶּךָ כְּסוּסַי כְּסוּסֶיךָ׃
verses.english: So he said to Yehoshafat:Will you go with me in battle to Ramot-Gil’ad?Yehoshafat said to the king of Israel:I am as you are: my fighting-people as your fighting-people, my horses as your horses!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל דְּרָשׁ־נָא כַיּוֹם אֶת־דְּבַר יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And Yehoshafat said to the king of Israel:Pray inquire of the word of YHWH here-and-now.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבֹּץ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַנְּבִיאִים כְּאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם הַאֵלֵךְ עַל־רָמֹת גִּלְעָד לַמִּלְחָמָה אִם־אֶחְדָּל וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֲלֵה וְיִתֵּן אֲדֹנָי בְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: So the king of Israel gathered the prophets, some four hundred men,and said to them:Shall I go against Ramot-Gil’ad in battle, or shall I refrain?They said:Go up—YHWH will give it into the hand of the king!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט הַאֵין פֹּה נָבִיא לַיהוָה עוֹד וְנִדְרְשָׁה מֵאוֹתוֹ׃
verses.english: Yehoshafat said:Is there not a prophet of YHWH here, yet another, that we may inquire through him?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט עוֹד אִישׁ־אֶחָד לִדְרֹשׁ אֶת־יְהוָה מֵאֹתוֹ וַאֲנִי שְׂנֵאתִיו כִּי לֹא־יִתְנַבֵּא עָלַי טוֹב כִּי אִם־רָע מִיכָיְהוּ בֶּן־יִמְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט אַל־יֹאמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ כֵּן׃
verses.english: The king of Israel said to Yehoshafat:There is yet another man through whom one may inquire of YHWH,but I myself hate him,for he never prophesies for good concerning me, but only for evil, with Agamemnon complaining about Calchas’s prophecies. :Mikhayhu son of Yimla trad. English “Micaiah son of Imlah.” His name means “Who Is Like YHWH?”.Yehoshafat said:Let not the king say thus!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־סָרִיס אֶחָד וַיֹּאמֶר מַהֲרָה מִיכָיְהוּ בֶן־יִמְלָה׃
verses.english: So the king of Israel called an officer and said:Quickly! Mikhayhu son of Yimla!

verses.hebrew: וּמֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה יֹשְׁבִים אִישׁ עַל־כִּסְאוֹ מְלֻבָּשִׁים בְּגָדִים בְּגֹרֶן פֶּתַח שַׁעַר שֹׁמְרוֹן וְכָל־הַנְּבִיאִים מִתְנַבְּאִים לִפְנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Now the king of Israel and Yehoshafat king of Judah were sitting, each one on his throneclothed in [royal] garments,at the threshing floor at the entrance to the Gate of Shomeron,while all the prophets were prophesying before them.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ צִדְקִיָּה בֶן־כְּנַעֲנָה קַרְנֵי בַרְזֶל וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה בְּאֵלֶּה תְּנַגַּח אֶת־אֲרָם עַד־כַּלֹּתָם׃
verses.english: And Tzidkiyya son of Kenaana made himself horns of ironand said:Thus says YHWH:With these you shall gore Aram, until they are finished off!

verses.hebrew: וְכָל־הַנְּבִאִים נִבְּאִים כֵּן לֵאמֹר עֲלֵה רָמֹת גִּלְעָד וְהַצְלַח וְנָתַן יְהוָה בְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: And all the prophets prophesied thus, saying:Go up to Ramot-Gil’ad, and triumph,for YHWH will give [it] into the hand of the king!

verses.hebrew: וְהַמַּלְאָךְ אֲשֶׁר־הָלַךְ לִקְרֹא מִיכָיְהוּ דִּבֶּר אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה־נָא דִּבְרֵי הַנְּבִיאִים פֶּה־אֶחָד טוֹב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהִי־נָא דבריך [דְבָרְךָ] כִּדְבַר אַחַד מֵהֶם וְדִבַּרְתָּ טּוֹב׃
verses.english: Then the messenger who had gone to call Mikhayhu spoke to him, saying:Now here, the words of the prophets are as one mouth for good regarding the king;pray may your word be like the word of one of them, so that you speak for good!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָיְהוּ חַי־יְהוָה כִּי אֶת־אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר יְהוָה אֵלַי אֹתוֹ אֲדַבֵּר׃
verses.english: But Mikhayhu said:As YHWH lives!Indeed, whatever YHWH says to me, that [alone] may I speak.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלָיו מִיכָיְהוּ הֲנֵלֵךְ אֶל־רָמֹת גִּלְעָד לַמִּלְחָמָה אִם־נֶחְדָּל וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו עֲלֵה וְהַצְלַח וְנָתַן יְהוָה בְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: He came to the king, and the king said to him:Mikhayhu, shall we go to Ramot-Gil’ad in battle,or shall we refrain?He said to him:Go up and triumph;YHWH will give it into the hand of the king.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הַמֶּלֶךְ עַד־כַּמֶּה פְעָמִים אֲנִי מַשְׁבִּעֶךָ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־תְדַבֵּר אֵלַי רַק־אֱמֶת בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה׃
verses.english: The king said to him:How many times must I make you swearthat you are not to speak to me anything but truth in the name of YHWH?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר רָאִיתִי אֶת־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל נְפֹצִים אֶל־הֶהָרִים כַּצֹּאן אֲשֶׁר אֵין־לָהֶם רֹעֶה וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה לֹא־אֲדֹנִים לָאֵלֶּה יָשׁוּבוּ אִישׁ־לְבֵיתוֹ בְּשָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: So he said:I saw all Israel scattered on the hillslike sheep that have no herder,and YHWH said: There are no masters for these.Let each return to his house in peace!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט הֲלוֹא אָמַרְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לוֹא־יִתְנַבֵּא עָלַי טוֹב כִּי אִם־רָע׃
verses.english: The king of Israel said to Yehoshafat:Did I not say to you:He never prophesies for good concerning me, but only for evil?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָכֵן שְׁמַע דְּבַר־יְהוָה רָאִיתִי אֶת־יְהוָה יֹשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאוֹ וְכָל־צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם עֹמֵד עָלָיו מִימִינוֹ וּמִשְּׂמֹאלוֹ׃
verses.english: He said:Therefore, hearken to the word of YHWH:I saw YHWH sitting on his throne,with all the Forces of the Heavens The image of a heavenly council is alluded to many times in the Bible; here it is somewhat spelled out. Elsewhere in the ancient world it would have referred to a council of the gods themselves. standing over against him, on his right and on his left;

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה מִי יְפַתֶּה אֶת־אַחְאָב וְיַעַל וְיִפֹּל בְּרָמֹת גִּלְעָד וַיֹּאמֶר זֶה בְּכֹה וְזֶה אֹמֵר בְּכֹה׃
verses.english: and YHWH said:Who will entice Ah’avso that he will go up and fall at Ramot-Gil’ad?And this one said thusly, while that one said thusly.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הָרוּחַ וַיַּעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֲנִי אֲפַתֶּנּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלָיו בַּמָּה׃
verses.english: Then a spirit came out and stood in the presence of YHWHand said:I will entice him.YHWH said to him:In what [way]?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵצֵא וְהָיִיתִי רוּחַ שֶׁקֶר בְּפִי כָּל־נְבִיאָיו וַיֹּאמֶר תְּפַתֶּה וְגַם־תּוּכָל צֵא וַעֲשֵׂה־כֵן׃
verses.english: He said:I will go out and be a false spiritin the mouth of all his prophets.He said:You will entice [him], aye, you will prevail.Go out and do thus!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה נָתַן יְהוָה רוּחַ שֶׁקֶר בְּפִי כָּל־נְבִיאֶיךָ אֵלֶּה וַיהוָה דִּבֶּר עָלֶיךָ רָעָה׃
verses.english: So-now, here: YHWH has placed a false spiritin the mouth of all these your prophets,for YHWH has spoken evil regarding you!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּשׁ צִדְקִיָּהוּ בֶן־כְּנַעֲנָה וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־מִיכָיְהוּ עַל־הַלֶּחִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֵי־זֶה עָבַר רוּחַ־יְהוָה מֵאִתִּי לְדַבֵּר אוֹתָךְ׃
verses.english: Then Tzidkiyyahu son of Kenaana approached and struck Mikhayhu on the cheek,and said:Which way did the spirit of YHWH cross over from me to speak with you?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָיְהוּ הִנְּךָ רֹאֶה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֲשֶׁר תָּבֹא חֶדֶר בְּחֶדֶר לְהֵחָבֵה׃
verses.english: Mikhayhu said:Here, you will see on that day,when you enter a room within a room to hide!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל קַח אֶת־מִיכָיְהוּ וַהֲשִׁיבֵהוּ אֶל־אָמֹן שַׂר־הָעִיר וְאֶל־יוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: The king of Israel said:Take Mikhayhuand turn him over to Amon, commander of the town, and to Yoash trad. English “Joash.” , the son of the king;

verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ כֹּה אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ שִׂימוּ אֶת־זֶה בֵּית הַכֶּלֶא וְהַאֲכִילֻהוּ לֶחֶם לַחַץ וּמַיִם לַחַץ עַד בֹּאִי בְשָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: you are to say:Thus says the king:Put this one in the prison house and have him eat meager bread and meager water,until I return in peace.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָיְהוּ אִם־שׁוֹב תָּשׁוּב בְּשָׁלוֹם לֹא־דִבֶּר יְהוָה בִּי וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְעוּ עַמִּים כֻּלָּם׃
verses.english: Mikhayhu said:If you return, yes, return in peace,YHWH has not spoken through me!And he said:Hearken, O peoples, all of them …

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה רָמֹת גִּלְעָד׃
verses.english: The king of Israel and Yehoshafat king of Judah went up to Ramot-Gil’ad.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט הִתְחַפֵּשׂ וָבֹא בַמִּלְחָמָה וְאַתָּה לְבַשׁ בְּגָדֶיךָ וַיִּתְחַפֵּשׂ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּבוֹא בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃
verses.english: And the king of Israel said to Yehoshafat:[I] will disguise [myself] and come to battle,but you, clothe yourself in your [royal] garments.So the king of Israel disguised himself and came to battle.

verses.hebrew: וּמֶלֶךְ אֲרָם צִוָּה אֶת־שָׂרֵי הָרֶכֶב אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁנַיִם לֵאמֹר לֹא תִּלָּחֲמוּ אֶת־קָטֹן וְאֶת־גָּדוֹל כִּי אִם־אֶת־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבַדּוֹ׃
verses.english: Now the king of Aram had charged the chariot officers belonging to him,thirty-two, saying:You are not to engage in battle with anyone from small to great,except with the king of Israel alone!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת שָׂרֵי הָרֶכֶב אֶת־יְהוֹשָׁפָט וְהֵמָּה אָמְרוּ אַךְ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא וַיָּסֻרוּ עָלָיו לְהִלָּחֵם וַיִּזְעַק יְהוֹשָׁפָט׃
verses.english: And it was, when the chariot officers saw Yehoshafat,that they said:Surely he is the king of Israel!So they turned toward him, to do battle,and Yehoshafat cried out [for help].

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת שָׂרֵי הָרֶכֶב כִּי־לֹא־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא וַיָּשׁוּבוּ מֵאַחֲרָיו׃
verses.english: But it was, when the chariot officers saw that he was not the king of Israel,that they turned away from him.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ מָשַׁךְ בַּקֶּשֶׁת לְתֻמּוֹ וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל בֵּין הַדְּבָקִים וּבֵין הַשִּׁרְיָן וַיֹּאמֶר לְרַכָּבוֹ הֲפֹךְ יָדְךָ וְהוֹצִיאֵנִי מִן־הַמַּחֲנֶה כִּי הָחֳלֵיתִי׃
verses.english: Now a man drew his bow in his innocenceand struck the king of Israel between the connecting-plates and the armor.He said to his chariot driver:Reverse your hand and take me out of the camp, but others read as milhama, “battle,” which makes more sense. Walsh suggests that Ah’av’s wounds have made him disoriented.,for I have been wounded!

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲלֶה הַמִּלְחָמָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וְהַמֶּלֶךְ הָיָה מָעֳמָד בַּמֶּרְכָּבָה נֹכַח אֲרָם וַיָּמָת בָּעֶרֶב וַיִּצֶק דַּם־הַמַּכָּה אֶל־חֵיק הָרָכֶב׃
verses.english: The battle heightened on that day,and the king was stood up in the chariot, facing Aram.He died at sunset, with the blood of his wound pouring into the lap of the chariot.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר הָרִנָּה בַּמַּחֲנֶה כְּבֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ לֵאמֹר אִישׁ אֶל־עִירוֹ וְאִישׁ אֶל־אַרְצוֹ׃
verses.english: And a ringing-cry passed through the camp as the sun was coming in, saying:Each one to his town! Each one to his land!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיָּבוֹא שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃
verses.english: So the king died and was brought to Shomeron,and they buried the king in Shomeron.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁטֹף אֶת־הָרֶכֶב עַל בְּרֵכַת שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיָּלֹקּוּ הַכְּלָבִים אֶת־דָּמוֹ וְהַזֹּנוֹת רָחָצוּ כִּדְבַר יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר׃
verses.english: The chariot was rinsed off by the Pool of Shomeron;the dogs licked up his blood,and whores bathed [in it],according to the word of YHWH which he had spoken.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אַחְאָב וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּבֵית הַשֵּׁן אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה וְכָל־הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Ah’av, and all that he did,and the house of ivory that he builtand all the towns that he built—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Israel?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אַחְאָב עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֲחַזְיָהוּ בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Ah’av lay beside his fathers,and Ahazyahu his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: וִיהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־אָסָא מָלַךְ עַל־יְהוּדָה בִּשְׁנַת אַרְבַּע לְאַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now Yehoshafat son of Asa became king over Judahin year four of Ah’av king of Israel.

verses.hebrew: יְהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־שְׁלֹשִׁים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה בְּמָלְכוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ עֲזוּבָה בַּת־שִׁלְחִי׃
verses.english: Yehoshafat was thirty-five years old at his becoming king,and for twenty-five years he reigned as king in Jerusalem;his mother’s name was Azuva daughter of Shilhi.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכָל־דֶּרֶךְ אָסָא אָבִיו לֹא־סָר מִמֶּנּוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And he walked in all the way of Asa his father;he did not turn aside from it, doing what was right in the eyes of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ הַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת׃
verses.english: However, the sanctuaries were not removed—the people were still offering-sacrifices and sending-up-smoke at the sanctuaries.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁלֵם יְהוֹשָׁפָט עִם־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And Yehoshafat made peace with the king of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יְהוֹשָׁפָט וּגְבוּרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה וַאֲשֶׁר נִלְחָם הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Yehoshafat and his mighty-deeds that he did, and how he waged battle—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Judah?

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר הַקָּדֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁאַר בִּימֵי אָסָא אָבִיו בִּעֵר מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: And the rest of the [male] prostitutes who were left in the days of Asa his fatherhe eradicated from the land.

verses.hebrew: וּמֶלֶךְ אֵין בֶּאֱדוֹם נִצָּב מֶלֶךְ׃
verses.english: Now king there was none in Edom;a prefect reigned as king for melekh..

verses.hebrew: יְהוֹשָׁפָט עשר [עָשָׂה] אֳנִיּוֹת תַּרְשִׁישׁ לָלֶכֶת אוֹפִירָה לַזָּהָב וְלֹא הָלָךְ כִּי־נשברה [נִשְׁבְּרוּ] אֳנִיּוֹת בְּעֶצְיוֹן גָּבֶר׃
verses.english: And Yehoshafat had made ships of Tarshish for going to Ofir, for gold,but they did not go,because the ships broke apart at Etzyon-Gever.

verses.hebrew: אָז אָמַר אֲחַזְיָהוּ בֶן־אַחְאָב אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט יֵלְכוּ עֲבָדַי עִם־עֲבָדֶיךָ בָּאֳנִיּוֹת וְלֹא אָבָה יְהוֹשָׁפָט׃
verses.english: It was then that Ahazyahu son of Ah’av had said to Yehoshafat:Let my servants go with your servants aboard the ships!But Yehoshafat had not consented.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יְהוֹשָׁפָט עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד אָבִיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ יְהוֹרָם בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Yehoshafat lay beside his fathers;he was buried with his fathersin the city of David his father,and Yehoram trad. English “Jehoram.” his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: אֲחַזְיָהוּ בֶן־אַחְאָב מָלַךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן בִּשְׁנַת שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה לִיהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁנָתָיִם׃
verses.english: Ahazyahu son of Ah’av became king over Israel in Shomeronin year seventeen of Yehoshafat king of Judah;he reigned as king over Israel for two years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אָבִיו וּבְדֶרֶךְ אִמּוֹ וּבְדֶרֶךְ יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And he did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH:he walked in the way of his father and in the way of his mother,and in the way of Yorov’am son of Nevat,who had caused Israel to sin;

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַבַּעַל וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לוֹ וַיַּכְעֵס אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אָבִיו׃
verses.english: he served Baal and bowed down to himand provoked YHWH the God of Israel,exactly as his father had done.
